การจัด: a 30x25 m area with a mini-goal at each end, 5 against 5 inside it
อุปกรณ์: four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines
เส้นทางบอล: A → E → C → ประตู
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: A จ่ายให้ E E ขยับไปทางซ้ายเพื่อถอยลงมารับบอล X5 ขยับไปทางซ้ายเพื่อตามประกบคนวิ่ง • ขั้นที่ 2: E จ่ายให้ C C ขยับไปข้างหน้าเพื่อวิ่งทะลุหลังแนวรับ • ขั้นที่ 3: C ยิงประตู
การต่อเนื่อง: หลังเสียประตู ฝ่ายที่เสียเริ่มจากเส้นหลังของตัวเอง บอลออกให้ฝ่ายตรงข้ามนำเข้าเล่นตรงจุดที่ออก โค้ชเตรียมบอลสำรองไว้เพื่อไม่ให้เกมหยุด เกมละ 4 นาที แล้วสลับแดนหรือคู่แข่ง
กติกา: A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground; head height and above does not count. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones, and it restarts from where it went out.
จุดเน้น: คนน้อยแปลว่าไม่มีใครหลบได้ ทุกคนห่างจากบอลแค่หนึ่งจังหวะจ่าย
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Trò chơi sân nhỏ: ít người hơn nên bóng và mọi quyết định đến nhanh hơn, không ai trốn khỏi trận đấu được.
Tần suất: Kết thúc buổi tập gần như mỗi ngày — trò chơi sân nhỏ là nơi mọi thứ đã tập được thể hiện dưới áp lực.
Bố trí: a 30x25 m area with a mini-goal at each end, 5 against 5 inside it.
Dụng cụ: four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
Đường bóng: A → E → C → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: A chuyền cho E, E di chuyển sang trái để lùi xuống nhận bóng, X5 di chuyển sang trái để theo kèm người chạy chỗ; Bước 2: E chuyền cho C, C di chuyển lên phía trước để chạy ra sau hàng thủ; Bước 3: C dứt điểm.
Tiếp nối: Sau bàn thua, đội thủng lưới phát bóng từ vạch cuối sân của mình; bóng ra ngoài thì đội kia ném vào ngay chỗ bóng ra, huấn luyện viên có bóng dự phòng để không bị gián đoạn. Mỗi trận bốn phút rồi đổi sân hoặc đổi đối thủ.
Luật: A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground; head height and above does not count. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones, and it restarts from where it went out.
Điểm chính: Ít người thì không ai trốn được. Ai cũng chỉ cách bóng một đường chuyền.

note.en:
Purpose: A small-sided game: fewer players, so the ball and every decision arrive faster and nobody can hide from the play.
Frequency: A session-ender used most days — the small-sided game is where everything trained gets played out under pressure.
Setup: a 36x30 m area with a mini-goal at each end, 6 against 6 inside it.
Equipment: four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
Ball path: A → F → C → goal
Sequence: Step 1: A passes to F, F moves left to drop to receive, X6 moves left to track the runner; Step 2: F passes to C, C moves up the board to run in behind the defence; Step 3: C shoots.
How it continues: After a goal the team that conceded restarts from its own end line; when the ball goes out the other team brings it in from where it left, and the coach has spares ready so nothing stops. Four-minute games, then swap ends or opponents.
Rules: A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground; head height and above does not count. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones, and it restarts from where it went out.
Coaching point: Small numbers mean nobody hides. Every player is one pass from the ball, so every player is in the game.

note.en:
Purpose: A small-sided game: fewer players, so the ball and every decision arrive faster and nobody can hide from the play.
Frequency: A session-ender used most days — the small-sided game is where everything trained gets played out under pressure.
Setup: a 42x35 m area with a mini-goal at each end, 7 against 7 inside it.
Equipment: four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
Ball path: A → G → D → goal
Sequence: Step 1: A passes to G, G moves left to drop to receive, X7 moves left to track the runner; Step 2: G passes to D, D moves up the board to run in behind the defence; Step 3: D shoots.
How it continues: After a goal the team that conceded restarts from its own end line; when the ball goes out the other team brings it in from where it left, and the coach has spares ready so nothing stops. Four-minute games, then swap ends or opponents.
Rules: A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground; head height and above does not count. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones, and it restarts from where it went out.
Coaching point: Small numbers mean nobody hides. Every player is one pass from the ball, so every player is in the game.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】小场比赛：人少场地小，球来得快、决定也快，每个人都得参与，没法躲。
【频度】几乎每天用来收尾——小场比赛让练过的一切在压力下落地。
【组织】约 42×35 米的场地，两端各放一个小球门，7 对 7 在里面比赛。
【器材】四个锥标标出场地四角（尺寸见【组织】），两个方块是两端线上各 2 米宽的小球门。
【球路】A → G → D → 球门
【流程】第1步：A把球传给G，G向左移动（回撤接球），X7向左移动（盯住跑动的人）；第2步：G把球传给D，D向前移动（插入防线身后）；第3步：D射门。
【连贯】进球后由失球方从本方端线开球；球出界由对方在出界处发球，教练备好几个球随时补上，比赛不停。每局 4 分钟，局间换边或换对手。
【规则】球贴地整体穿过小球门算进球，高于头部不算。球越过两个角上锥标之间的连线算出界，从出界处重新开始。
【要点】人少就没人能躲。每个人离球都只有一脚传球的距离，所以每个人都在比赛里。

note.en:
Purpose: Break a set defence: create and use an overload, commit a defender, and play the pass his movement opens.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week, as the team sharpens how it creates and takes chances.
Setup: half a pitch, one goal; 2 attackers break out of their own half at 1 recovering defenders.
Ball path: A → B → goal
Sequence: Step 1: A carries the ball on the move, X1 moves left to delay and jockey; Step 2: A passes to B, B moves up the board to run in behind the defence; Step 3: B shoots.
How it continues: A rep ends on a shot, a tackle or the ball going out. The attackers rejoin the queue and the next go straight in; the defenders hold for four reps, then swap with the attackers.
Rules: The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.
Coaching point: Carry until a defender commits, then release. The extra man only exists while they are still deciding.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】进攻：练怎么打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出来，再传他让出的那条线。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——磨合球队制造和把握机会的方式。
【组织】半场一个球门；2 名进攻者从本方半场发起反击，冲击 1 名回追的防守者。
【球路】A → B → 球门
【流程】第1步：A带球推进，X1向左移动（拖延，不轻易上抢）；第2步：A把球传给B，B向前移动（插入防线身后）；第3步：B射门。
【连贯】一球结束——射门、断球或球出界——进攻方回到队尾，下一组马上进攻；防守方连守四球后与进攻互换。
【规则】反击把球打进球门算得分；进球、被防守者断下、球出底线或边线，本次反击即结束。从出球那一刻起判越位。
【要点】带球逼到有人上抢再出球。人数优势只在对方还没做决定的那几秒里存在。
note.zh-TW:

【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——磨合球隊製造和把握機會的方式。
【組織】half a pitch, one goal; 2 attackers break out of their own half at 1 recovering defenders。

【連貫】一球結束——射門、斷球或球出界——進攻方回到隊尾，下一組馬上進攻；防守方連守四球後與進攻互換。
【規則】反擊把球打進球門算得分；進球、被防守者斷下、球出底線或邊線，本次反擊即結束。從出球那一刻起判越位。
【要點】帶球逼到有人上搶再出球。人數優勢只在對方還沒做決定的那幾秒裡存在。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】整った守備を崩す。数的優位を作って使い、守備者に決断を迫り、その動きが空けたパスを通す。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。チャンスの作り方と決め方を磨く。
【準備】half a pitch, one goal; 2 attackers break out of their own half at 1 recovering defenders。
【ボールの道筋】A → B → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：Aがボールを運ぶ、X1が左へ移動し、遅らせて間合いを取る。ステップ2：AがBへパス、Bが前方へ移動し、最終ラインの裏へ抜ける。ステップ3：Bがシュート。
【続け方】シュート、ボール奪取、ボールアウトで1本終了。攻撃側は列に戻り次の組がすぐ入る。守備側は4本続けてから攻守交代。
【ルール】The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.
【ポイント】相手が食いつくまで運んでから出す。数的優位は相手が迷っている間だけ。
note.ko-KR:

【빈도】주 몇 회 진행하는 전술 블록 — 팀이 기회를 만들고 살리는 법을 다듬는다.

【이어가기】슈팅, 태클, 아웃으로 한 세트가 끝난다. 공격은 줄로 돌아가고 다음 조가 바로 들어온다. 수비는 네 번을 막은 뒤 공격과 교대한다.
【규칙】The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.

note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana, para afinar cómo crea y aprovecha ocasiones.
Montaje: half a pitch, one goal; 2 attackers break out of their own half at 1 recovering defenders.

Secuencia: Paso 1: A conduce el balón, X1 se desplaza a la izquierda para temporizar sin entrar; Paso 2: A pasa a B, B se desplaza hacia delante para desmarcarse a la espalda de la defensa; Paso 3: B remata.
Continuidad: La repetición termina con un tiro, un robo o el balón fuera. Los atacantes vuelven a la fila y entran los siguientes; los defensores aguantan cuatro y luego cambian con los atacantes.
Reglas: The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.

Enchaînement : La séquence s'arrête sur un tir, une récupération ou une sortie de balle. Les attaquants rejoignent la file et les suivants enchaînent ; les défenseurs tiennent quatre séquences puis permutent.
Règles : The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.

note.en:
Purpose: Break a set defence: create and use an overload, commit a defender, and play the pass his movement opens.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week, as the team sharpens how it creates and takes chances.
Setup: half a pitch, one goal; 4 attackers break out of their own half at 3 recovering defenders.
Ball path: C → D → goal
Sequence: Step 1: C carries the ball on the move, X3 moves left to delay and jockey; Step 2: C passes to D, A, B, D move up the board to run in behind the defence, X1, X2 move back to recover goal-side; Step 3: D shoots.
How it continues: A rep ends on a shot, a tackle or the ball going out. The attackers rejoin the queue and the next go straight in; the defenders hold for four reps, then swap with the attackers.
Rules: The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.
Coaching point: Carry until a defender commits, then release. The extra man only exists while they are still deciding.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】进攻：练怎么打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出来，再传他让出的那条线。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——磨合球队制造和把握机会的方式。
【组织】半场一个球门；4 名进攻者从本方半场发起反击，冲击 3 名回追的防守者。
【球路】C → D → 球门
【流程】第1步：C带球推进，X3向左移动（拖延，不轻易上抢）；第2步：C把球传给D，A、B、D向前移动（插入防线身后），X1、X2向后移动（回追到球门一侧）；第3步：D射门。
【连贯】一球结束——射门、断球或球出界——进攻方回到队尾，下一组马上进攻；防守方连守四球后与进攻互换。
【规则】反击把球打进球门算得分；进球、被防守者断下、球出底线或边线，本次反击即结束。从出球那一刻起判越位。
【要点】带球逼到有人上抢再出球。人数优势只在对方还没做决定的那几秒里存在。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】進攻：練怎麼打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出來，再傳他讓出的那條線。
【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——磨合球隊製造和把握機會的方式。
【組織】half a pitch, one goal; 4 attackers break out of their own half at 3 recovering defenders。
【球路】C → D → 球門
【流程】第1步：C帶球推進，X3向左移動（拖延，不輕易上搶）；第2步：C把球傳給D，A、B、D向前移動（插入防線身後），X1、X2向後移動（回追到球門一側）；第3步：D射門。
【連貫】一球結束——射門、斷球或球出界——進攻方回到隊尾，下一組馬上進攻；防守方連守四球後與進攻互換。
【規則】反擊把球打進球門算得分；進球、被防守者斷下、球出底線或邊線，本次反擊即結束。從出球那一刻起判越位。
【要點】帶球逼到有人上搶再出球。人數優勢只在對方還沒做決定的那幾秒裡存在。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】整った守備を崩す。数的優位を作って使い、守備者に決断を迫り、その動きが空けたパスを通す。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。チャンスの作り方と決め方を磨く。
【準備】half a pitch, one goal; 4 attackers break out of their own half at 3 recovering defenders。
【ボールの道筋】C → D → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：Cがボールを運ぶ、X3が左へ移動し、遅らせて間合いを取る。ステップ2：CがDへパス、A・B・Dが前方へ移動し、最終ラインの裏へ抜ける、X1・X2が後方へ移動し、ゴール側へ戻る。ステップ3：Dがシュート。
【続け方】シュート、ボール奪取、ボールアウトで1本終了。攻撃側は列に戻り次の組がすぐ入る。守備側は4本続けてから攻守交代。
【ルール】The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.
【ポイント】相手が食いつくまで運んでから出す。数的優位は相手が迷っている間だけ。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】정돈된 수비를 깬다. 수적 우위를 만들고 이용하며, 수비수에게 결정을 강요하고 그 움직임이 여는 패스를 넣는다.
【빈도】주 몇 회 진행하는 전술 블록 — 팀이 기회를 만들고 살리는 법을 다듬는다.
【준비】half a pitch, one goal; 4 attackers break out of their own half at 3 recovering defenders.
【볼 경로】C → D → 골문
【진행】1단계: C가 공을 몰고 이동, X3는 왼쪽으로 이동해 지연시키며 거리를 유지한다; 2단계: C가 D에게 패스, A, B, D는 앞으로 이동해 수비 뒷공간으로 침투한다, X1, X2는 뒤로 이동해 골 쪽으로 복귀한다; 3단계: D 슛.
【이어가기】슈팅, 태클, 아웃으로 한 세트가 끝난다. 공격은 줄로 돌아가고 다음 조가 바로 들어온다. 수비는 네 번을 막은 뒤 공격과 교대한다.
【규칙】The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.
【포인트】수비가 달려들 때까지 몰고 가서 내줘라. 수적 우위는 그들이 망설이는 동안만 존재한다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana, para afinar cómo crea y aprovecha ocasiones.
Montaje: half a pitch, one goal; 4 attackers break out of their own half at 3 recovering defenders.
Recorrido del balón: C → D → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: C conduce el balón, X3 se desplaza a la izquierda para temporizar sin entrar; Paso 2: C pasa a D, A, B, D se desplaza hacia delante para desmarcarse a la espalda de la defensa, X1, X2 se desplaza hacia atrás para recuperar la posición entre balón y portería; Paso 3: D remata.
Continuidad: La repetición termina con un tiro, un robo o el balón fuera. Los atacantes vuelven a la fila y entran los siguientes; los defensores aguantan cuatro y luego cambian con los atacantes.
Reglas: The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.
Punto clave: Conduce hasta que un defensa se comprometa. La superioridad dura lo que dura su duda.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Casser une défense en place : créer et exploiter le surnombre, engager un défenseur et jouer la passe que son mouvement ouvre.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine, pour affiner la création et la finition des occasions.
Mise en place : half a pitch, one goal; 4 attackers break out of their own half at 3 recovering defenders.
Trajet du ballon : C → D → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : C conduit le ballon, X3 se déplace à gauche pour temporiser sans se jeter ; Étape 2 : C passe à D, A, B, D se déplace vers l'avant pour prendre la profondeur, X1, X2 se déplace vers l'arrière pour revenir côté but ; Étape 3 : D frappe.
Enchaînement : La séquence s'arrête sur un tir, une récupération ou une sortie de balle. Les attaquants rejoignent la file et les suivants enchaînent ; les défenseurs tiennent quatre séquences puis permutent.
Règles : The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.
Point clé : Conduis jusqu'à l'engagement du défenseur. Le surnombre n'existe que pendant leur hésitation.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Membongkar pertahanan yang tersusun: buat dan manfaatkan overload, paksa bek memutuskan, lalu mainkan umpan yang terbuka.
Frekuensi: Blok taktis beberapa kali seminggu, saat tim mengasah cara menciptakan dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persiapan: half a pitch, one goal; 4 attackers break out of their own half at 3 recovering defenders.
Jalur bola: C → D → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: C menggiring bola, X3 bergerak ke kiri untuk memperlambat tanpa terburu-buru; Langkah 2: C mengoper ke D, A, B, D bergerak ke depan untuk berlari ke belakang pertahanan, X1, X2 bergerak ke belakang untuk kembali ke sisi gawang; Langkah 3: D menembak.
Kelanjutan: Satu ulangan berakhir dengan tembakan, rebutan, atau bola keluar. Penyerang kembali ke antrean dan yang berikutnya langsung masuk; bek bertahan empat ulangan lalu bertukar dengan penyerang.
Aturan: The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.
Poin utama: Giring sampai bek maju, baru lepaskan. Keunggulan hanya ada selama mereka ragu.
note.ms-MY:

Kekerapan: Blok taktikal beberapa kali seminggu, ketika pasukan mengasah cara mencipta dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persediaan: half a pitch, one goal; 4 attackers break out of their own half at 3 recovering defenders.

Kesinambungan: Satu ulangan tamat dengan rembatan, rampasan, atau bola keluar. Penyerang kembali ke barisan dan yang seterusnya terus masuk; pemain bertahan kekal empat ulangan kemudian bertukar dengan penyerang.
Peraturan: The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.

【流程】第1步：C带球推进，X2向右移动（拖延，不轻易上抢）；第2步：C把球传给E，A、B、D、E向前移动（插入防线身后），X1、X3、X4向后移动（回追到球门一侧）；第3步：E射门。
【连贯】一球结束——射门、断球或球出界——进攻方回到队尾，下一组马上进攻；防守方连守四球后与进攻互换。
【规则】反击把球打进球门算得分；进球、被防守者断下、球出底线或边线，本次反击即结束。从出球那一刻起判越位。
【要点】带球逼到有人上抢再出球。人数优势只在对方还没做决定的那几秒里存在。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】進攻：練怎麼打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出來，再傳他讓出的那條線。
【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——磨合球隊製造和把握機會的方式。
【組織】half a pitch, one goal; 5 attackers break out of their own half at 4 recovering defenders。
【球路】C → E → 球門

【規則】反擊把球打進球門算得分；進球、被防守者斷下、球出底線或邊線，本次反擊即結束。從出球那一刻起判越位。
【要點】帶球逼到有人上搶再出球。人數優勢只在對方還沒做決定的那幾秒裡存在。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】整った守備を崩す。数的優位を作って使い、守備者に決断を迫り、その動きが空けたパスを通す。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。チャンスの作り方と決め方を磨く。
【準備】half a pitch, one goal; 5 attackers break out of their own half at 4 recovering defenders。

note.ko-KR:

note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana, para afinar cómo crea y aprovecha ocasiones.
Montaje: half a pitch, one goal; 5 attackers break out of their own half at 4 recovering defenders.
Recorrido del balón: C → E → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: C conduce el balón, X2 se desplaza a la derecha para temporizar sin entrar; Paso 2: C pasa a E, A, B, D, E se desplaza hacia delante para desmarcarse a la espalda de la defensa, X1, X3, X4 se desplaza hacia atrás para recuperar la posición entre balón y portería; Paso 3: E remata.
Continuidad: La repetición termina con un tiro, un robo o el balón fuera. Los atacantes vuelven a la fila y entran los siguientes; los defensores aguantan cuatro y luego cambian con los atacantes.
Reglas: The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.
Punto clave: Conduce hasta que un defensa se comprometa. La superioridad dura lo que dura su duda.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Casser une défense en place : créer et exploiter le surnombre, engager un défenseur et jouer la passe que son mouvement ouvre.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine, pour affiner la création et la finition des occasions.
Mise en place : half a pitch, one goal; 5 attackers break out of their own half at 4 recovering defenders.
Trajet du ballon : C → E → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : C conduit le ballon, X2 se déplace à droite pour temporiser sans se jeter ; Étape 2 : C passe à E, A, B, D, E se déplace vers l'avant pour prendre la profondeur, X1, X3, X4 se déplace vers l'arrière pour revenir côté but ; Étape 3 : E frappe.
Enchaînement : La séquence s'arrête sur un tir, une récupération ou une sortie de balle. Les attaquants rejoignent la file et les suivants enchaînent ; les défenseurs tiennent quatre séquences puis permutent.
Règles : The break scores by putting the ball in the goal; it ends there, or when a defender wins it or the ball crosses the goal line or the touchline. Offside is played from the moment the ball is released.
Point clé : Conduis jusqu'à l'engagement du défenseur. Le surnombre n'existe que pendant leur hésitation.
note.id-ID:

note.en:
Purpose: Keep the ball under pressure — support angles, first touch and the pass that beats a line rather than just the nearest man.
Frequency: A staple of nearly every session — keeping the ball is the base everything else is built on.
Setup: a goalkeeper and a back 3 on the edge of their own box with a 6 in front of them, against 1 pressing.
Ball path: GK → 5 → 6 → the open space
Sequence: Step 1: GK passes to 5, 5, 4, 2 move back to hold the width, A moves up the board to press the ball carrier; Step 2: 5 passes to 6, 6 moves left to drop to receive; Step 3: 6 plays the ball into space, 6 moves up the board to turn and face forward.
How it continues: Getting the ball over halfway counts as a success; a turnover or the ball out counts for the pressers. Either way it goes back to the keeper and starts again; six reps, then the sides swap.
Rules: Getting the ball under control past the halfway line is a point for the back line; winning it, forcing it out over a touchline, or forcing a long clearance is a point for the pressers.
Coaching point: One more player than they press with. Find the free man before the ball reaches you, or he stops being free.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】控球：在有人抢的情况下把球留住。练接应跑位、第一脚停球，以及敢往前穿防线，而不是只往安全的方向传。
【频度】几乎每堂课都练——控球是其他一切的基础。
【组织】门将加 3 名后卫站在本方禁区线上，身前一名后腰，对方 1 人上抢。
【球路】GK → 5 → 6 → 空当
【流程】第1步：GK把球传给5号球员，5号球员、4号球员、2号球员向后移动（保持宽度），A向前移动（上抢持球人）；第2步：5号球员把球传给6号球员，6号球员向左移动（回撤接球）；第3步：6号球员把球送进空当，6号球员向前移动（转身面向前方）。
【连贯】球过中线算出球成功，被断或出界算压迫方得分；无论哪种，球回门将重新开始，连做 6 次后攻守互换。
【规则】把球控住带过中线算后场一分；断球、把球逼出边线、或逼得对方大脚解围算压迫方一分。
【要点】永远比对方压迫人数多一个。在球到你脚下之前就找到那个空位的人，否则他就不空了。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】控球：在有人搶的情況下把球留住。練接應跑位、第一腳停球，以及敢往前穿防線，而不是只往安全的方向傳。
【頻度】幾乎每堂課都練——控球是其他一切的基礎。
【組織】a goalkeeper and a back 3 on the edge of their own box with a 6 in front of them, against 1 pressing。
【球路】GK → 5 → 6 → 空當
【流程】第1步：GK把球傳給5號球員，5號球員、4號球員、2號球員向後移動（保持寬度），A向前移動（上搶持球人）；第2步：5號球員把球傳給6號球員，6號球員向左移動（回撤接球）；第3步：6號球員把球送進空當，6號球員向前移動（轉身面向前方）。
【連貫】球過中線算出球成功，被斷或出界算壓迫方得分；無論哪種，球回門將重新開始，連做 6 次後攻守互換。
【規則】把球控住帶過中線算後場一分；斷球、把球逼出邊線、或逼得對方大腳解圍算壓迫方一分。
【要點】永遠比對方壓迫人數多一個。在球到你腳下之前就找到那個空位的人，否則他就不空了。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】プレッシャー下でボールを保持する。サポートの角度、ファーストタッチ、そして最も近い味方ではなくラインを破るパス。
【頻度】ほぼ毎回の定番。ボール保持は他のすべての土台になる。
【準備】a goalkeeper and a back 3 on the edge of their own box with a 6 in front of them, against 1 pressing。
【ボールの道筋】GK → 5 → 6 → スペース

【続け方】ハーフウェーを越えれば成功、奪われるかアウトならプレス側の得点。どちらでもキーパーに戻して再開。6本で攻守交代。
【ルール】Getting the ball under control past the halfway line is a point for the back line; winning it, forcing it out over a touchline, or forcing a long clearance is a point for the pressers.
【ポイント】相手のプレス人数より1人多く。ボールが来る前にフリーマンを見つける。
note.ko-KR:

【빈도】거의 모든 세션의 기본 — 볼 소유가 나머지 모든 것의 토대다.

note.en:
Purpose: Keep the ball under pressure — support angles, first touch and the pass that beats a line rather than just the nearest man.
Frequency: A staple of nearly every session — keeping the ball is the base everything else is built on.
Setup: a goalkeeper and a back 4 on the edge of their own box with a 6 in front of them, against 2 pressing.
Ball path: GK → 5 → 6 → the open space
Sequence: Step 1: GK passes to 5, 3, 5, 4, 2 move back to hold the width, A, B move up the board to press the ball carrier; Step 2: 5 passes to 6, 6 moves left to drop to receive; Step 3: 6 plays the ball into space, 6 moves up the board to turn and face forward.
How it continues: Getting the ball over halfway counts as a success; a turnover or the ball out counts for the pressers. Either way it goes back to the keeper and starts again; six reps, then the sides swap.
Rules: Getting the ball under control past the halfway line is a point for the back line; winning it, forcing it out over a touchline, or forcing a long clearance is a point for the pressers.
Coaching point: One more player than they press with. Find the free man before the ball reaches you, or he stops being free.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】控球：在有人抢的情况下把球留住。练接应跑位、第一脚停球，以及敢往前穿防线，而不是只往安全的方向传。
【频度】几乎每堂课都练——控球是其他一切的基础。
【组织】门将加 4 名后卫站在本方禁区线上，身前一名后腰，对方 2 人上抢。
【球路】GK → 5 → 6 → 空当
【流程】第1步：GK把球传给5号球员，3号球员、5号球员、4号球员、2号球员向后移动（保持宽度），A、B向前移动（上抢持球人）；第2步：5号球员把球传给6号球员，6号球员向左移动（回撤接球）；第3步：6号球员把球送进空当，6号球员向前移动（转身面向前方）。
【连贯】球过中线算出球成功，被断或出界算压迫方得分；无论哪种，球回门将重新开始，连做 6 次后攻守互换。
【规则】把球控住带过中线算后场一分；断球、把球逼出边线、或逼得对方大脚解围算压迫方一分。
【要点】永远比对方压迫人数多一个。在球到你脚下之前就找到那个空位的人，否则他就不空了。

note.en:
Purpose: Keep the ball under pressure — support angles, first touch and the pass that beats a line rather than just the nearest man.
Frequency: A staple of nearly every session — keeping the ball is the base everything else is built on.
Setup: a goalkeeper and a back 5 on the edge of their own box with a 6 in front of them, against 3 pressing.
Ball path: GK → 4 → 6 → the open space
Sequence: Step 1: GK passes to 4, 3 moves left to hold the width, 5, 4, 2 move back to hold the width, 7 moves right to hold the width, A, B, C move up the board to press the ball carrier; Step 2: 4 passes to 6, 6 moves left to drop to receive; Step 3: 6 plays the ball into space, 6 moves up the board to turn and face forward.
How it continues: Getting the ball over halfway counts as a success; a turnover or the ball out counts for the pressers. Either way it goes back to the keeper and starts again; six reps, then the sides swap.
Rules: Getting the ball under control past the halfway line is a point for the back line; winning it, forcing it out over a touchline, or forcing a long clearance is a point for the pressers.
Coaching point: One more player than they press with. Find the free man before the ball reaches you, or he stops being free.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】控球：在有人抢的情况下把球留住。练接应跑位、第一脚停球，以及敢往前穿防线，而不是只往安全的方向传。
【频度】几乎每堂课都练——控球是其他一切的基础。
【组织】门将加 5 名后卫站在本方禁区线上，身前一名后腰，对方 3 人上抢。
【球路】GK → 4 → 6 → 空当
【流程】第1步：GK把球传给4号球员，3号球员向左移动（保持宽度），5号球员、4号球员、2号球员向后移动（保持宽度），7号球员向右移动（保持宽度），A、B、C向前移动（上抢持球人）；第2步：4号球员把球传给6号球员，6号球员向左移动（回撤接球）；第3步：6号球员把球送进空当，6号球员向前移动（转身面向前方）。
【连贯】球过中线算出球成功，被断或出界算压迫方得分；无论哪种，球回门将重新开始，连做 6 次后攻守互换。
【规则】把球控住带过中线算后场一分；断球、把球逼出边线、或逼得对方大脚解围算压迫方一分。
【要点】永远比对方压迫人数多一个。在球到你脚下之前就找到那个空位的人，否则他就不空了。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】控球：在有人搶的情況下把球留住。練接應跑位、第一腳停球，以及敢往前穿防線，而不是只往安全的方向傳。
【頻度】幾乎每堂課都練——控球是其他一切的基礎。
【組織】a goalkeeper and a back 5 on the edge of their own box with a 6 in front of them, against 3 pressing。
【球路】GK → 4 → 6 → 空當
【流程】第1步：GK把球傳給4號球員，3號球員向左移動（保持寬度），5號球員、4號球員、2號球員向後移動（保持寬度），7號球員向右移動（保持寬度），A、B、C向前移動（上搶持球人）；第2步：4號球員把球傳給6號球員，6號球員向左移動（回撤接球）；第3步：6號球員把球送進空當，6號球員向前移動（轉身面向前方）。
【連貫】球過中線算出球成功，被斷或出界算壓迫方得分；無論哪種，球回門將重新開始，連做 6 次後攻守互換。
【規則】把球控住帶過中線算後場一分；斷球、把球逼出邊線、或逼得對方大腳解圍算壓迫方一分。
【要點】永遠比對方壓迫人數多一個。在球到你腳下之前就找到那個空位的人，否則他就不空了。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】プレッシャー下でボールを保持する。サポートの角度、ファーストタッチ、そして最も近い味方ではなくラインを破るパス。
【頻度】ほぼ毎回の定番。ボール保持は他のすべての土台になる。
【準備】a goalkeeper and a back 5 on the edge of their own box with a 6 in front of them, against 3 pressing。
【ボールの道筋】GK → 4 → 6 → スペース
【流れ】ステップ1：GKが4番へパス、3番が左へ移動し、幅を取る、5番・4番・2番が後方へ移動し、幅を取る、7番が右へ移動し、幅を取る、A・B・Cが前方へ移動し、ボールホルダーに寄せる。ステップ2：4番が6番へパス、6番が左へ移動し、下りて受ける。ステップ3：6番が次のポイントへ送る、6番が前方へ移動し、前を向く。
【続け方】ハーフウェーを越えれば成功、奪われるかアウトならプレス側の得点。どちらでもキーパーに戻して再開。6本で攻守交代。
【ルール】Getting the ball under control past the halfway line is a point for the back line; winning it, forcing it out over a touchline, or forcing a long clearance is a point for the pressers.
【ポイント】相手のプレス人数より1人多く。ボールが来る前にフリーマンを見つける。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】압박 속에서 공을 지킨다. 지원 각도, 첫 터치, 그리고 가까운 동료가 아니라 수비 라인을 깨는 패스.
【빈도】거의 모든 세션의 기본 — 볼 소유가 나머지 모든 것의 토대다.
【준비】a goalkeeper and a back 5 on the edge of their own box with a 6 in front of them, against 3 pressing.
【볼 경로】GK → 4 → 6 → 빈 자리
【진행】1단계: GK가 4번에게 패스, 3번는 왼쪽으로 이동해 폭을 유지한다, 5번, 4번, 2번는 뒤로 이동해 폭을 유지한다, 7번는 오른쪽으로 이동해 폭을 유지한다, A, B, C는 앞으로 이동해 볼 소유자를 압박한다; 2단계: 4번가 6번에게 패스, 6번는 왼쪽으로 이동해 내려와서 공을 받는다; 3단계: 6번가 다음 지점으로 보낸다, 6번는 앞으로 이동해 돌아서 앞을 본다.
【이어가기】하프라인을 넘기면 성공, 빼앗기거나 아웃되면 압박하는 쪽의 득점이다. 어느 쪽이든 공은 골키퍼에게 돌아가 다시 시작한다. 6회 후 공수 교대.
【규칙】Getting the ball under control past the halfway line is a point for the back line; winning it, forcing it out over a touchline, or forcing a long clearance is a point for the pressers.
【포인트】상대 압박보다 한 명 더. 공이 오기 전에 자유로운 선수를 찾아라.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Conservar el balón bajo presión: ángulos de apoyo, control y el pase que rompe una línea, no solo al más cercano.
Frecuencia: Un básico de casi cada sesión: conservar el balón es la base de todo lo demás.
Montaje: a goalkeeper and a back 5 on the edge of their own box with a 6 in front of them, against 3 pressing.
Recorrido del balón: GK → 4 → 6 → el espacio libre
Secuencia: Paso 1: GK pasa a 4, 3 se desplaza a la izquierda para dar amplitud, 5, 4, 2 se desplaza hacia atrás para dar amplitud, 7 se desplaza a la derecha para dar amplitud, A, B, C se desplaza hacia delante para presionar al poseedor; Paso 2: 4 pasa a 6, 6 se desplaza a la izquierda para bajar a recibir; Paso 3: 6 envía el balón al siguiente punto, 6 se desplaza hacia delante para girarse y encarar.
Continuidad: Superar el medio campo es un éxito; una pérdida o el balón fuera puntúa para los presionadores. En ambos casos vuelve al portero y se reinicia; seis repeticiones y cambio de roles.
Reglas: Getting the ball under control past the halfway line is a point for the back line; winning it, forcing it out over a touchline, or forcing a long clearance is a point for the pressers.
Punto clave: Un jugador más de los que presionan. Encuentra al libre antes de recibir.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Conserver le ballon sous pression : angles de soutien, première touche et la passe qui casse une ligne.
Fréquence : Un incontournable de presque chaque séance : garder le ballon est la base de tout le reste.
Mise en place : a goalkeeper and a back 5 on the edge of their own box with a 6 in front of them, against 3 pressing.
Trajet du ballon : GK → 4 → 6 → l'espace libre
Déroulé : Étape 1 : GK passe à 4, 3 se déplace à gauche pour garder la largeur, 5, 4, 2 se déplace vers l'arrière pour garder la largeur, 7 se déplace à droite pour garder la largeur, A, B, C se déplace vers l'avant pour presser le porteur ; Étape 2 : 4 passe à 6, 6 se déplace à gauche pour décrocher pour recevoir ; Étape 3 : 6 envoie le ballon au point suivant, 6 se déplace vers l'avant pour se retourner face au jeu.
Enchaînement : Passer la ligne médiane, c'est réussi ; une perte ou une sortie, c'est un point pour le pressing. Dans les deux cas retour au gardien et on repart ; six fois, puis on inverse les rôles.
Règles : Getting the ball under control past the halfway line is a point for the back line; winning it, forcing it out over a touchline, or forcing a long clearance is a point for the pressers.
Point clé : Un joueur de plus qu'eux. Trouve l'homme libre avant de recevoir.

ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: GK จ่ายให้ 4 3 ขยับไปทางซ้ายเพื่อรักษาความกว้าง 5, 4, 2 ขยับถอยหลังเพื่อรักษาความกว้าง 7 ขยับไปทางขวาเพื่อรักษาความกว้าง A, B, C ขยับไปข้างหน้าเพื่อเพรสคนถือบอล • ขั้นที่ 2: 4 จ่ายให้ 6 6 ขยับไปทางซ้ายเพื่อถอยลงมารับบอล • ขั้นที่ 3: 6 ส่งบอลไปจุดถัดไป 6 ขยับไปข้างหน้าเพื่อหมุนตัวหันหน้าไปข้างหน้า
การต่อเนื่อง: บอลข้ามเส้นกลางสนามนับว่าสำเร็จ ถ้าโดนแย่งหรือบอลออกฝ่ายเพรสได้แต้ม ไม่ว่าแบบไหนบอลกลับไปที่ผู้รักษาประตูแล้วเริ่มใหม่ ทำ 6 รอบแล้วสลับฝ่าย
กติกา: Getting the ball under control past the halfway line is a point for the back line; winning it, forcing it out over a touchline, or forcing a long clearance is a point for the pressers.
จุดเน้น: มีคนมากกว่าฝ่ายกดดันหนึ่งคน หาคนว่างก่อนบอลจะมาถึง
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Giữ bóng dưới áp lực — góc hỗ trợ, xử lý chạm đầu, và đường chuyền xuyên tuyến.
Tần suất: Bài chủ lực gần như mỗi buổi — giữ bóng là nền tảng của mọi thứ khác.
Bố trí: a goalkeeper and a back 5 on the edge of their own box with a 6 in front of them, against 3 pressing.
Đường bóng: GK → 4 → 6 → vị trí trống
Trình tự: Bước 1: GK chuyền cho 4, 3 di chuyển sang trái để giữ chiều rộng, 5, 4, 2 di chuyển lùi lại để giữ chiều rộng, 7 di chuyển sang phải để giữ chiều rộng, A, B, C di chuyển lên phía trước để áp sát người cầm bóng; Bước 2: 4 chuyền cho 6, 6 di chuyển sang trái để lùi xuống nhận bóng; Bước 3: 6 đưa bóng tới điểm kế tiếp, 6 di chuyển lên phía trước để xoay người hướng lên phía trước.
Tiếp nối: Đưa bóng qua giữa sân là thành công; mất bóng hoặc bóng ra ngoài tính điểm cho bên pressing. Dù thế nào bóng cũng về thủ môn và bắt đầu lại; 6 lượt rồi đổi bên.
Luật: Getting the ball under control past the halfway line is a point for the back line; winning it, forcing it out over a touchline, or forcing a long clearance is a point for the pressers.
Điểm chính: Hơn họ một người. Tìm người trống trước khi bóng đến chân.

note.en:
Purpose: Turn a chance into a goal: arrive with the feet set, strike early and low, and hit the space rather than the shirt.
Frequency: A technical block coaches run often — the finish is what the whole attack is for, so it is rehearsed regularly.
Setup: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts left wing, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Ball path: 7 → 9 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 carries the ball on the move; Step 2: 7 passes to 9, 9, 10, GK move up the board; Step 3: 9 shoots.
How it continues: Back to the end of the line when your rep is done and the next player goes; six to eight each, then switch sides or roles.
Coaching point: Shoot across the keeper, low and early. The pattern only exists to arrive with your feet already set.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】射门：练怎么把机会打进。跑到位时脚要站好，早点出脚、打低平球，瞄空当不瞄人。
【频度】技术训练，教练常练——终结是整个进攻的目的，所以要反复练。
【组织】一个球门带门将；传中人从左边路启动，9 号和 10 号在禁区前沿。
【球路】7 → 9 → 球门
【流程】第1步：7号球员带球推进；第2步：7号球员把球传给9号球员，9号球员、10号球员、GK向前移动；第3步：9号球员射门。
【连贯】做完一次回到队尾，下一人出发；每人 6–8 次后换边或换角色。
【要点】打门将远角，低平球，早出脚。整套跑位的意义就是让你到位时脚步已经站好。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】射門：練怎麼把機會打進。跑到位時腳要站好，早點出腳、打低平球，瞄空檔不瞄人。
【頻度】技術訓練，教練常練——終結是整個進攻的目的，所以要反覆練。
【組織】one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts left wing, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box。
【球路】7 → 9 → 球門
【流程】第1步：7號球員帶球推進；第2步：7號球員把球傳給9號球員，9號球員、10號球員、GK向前移動；第3步：9號球員射門。
【連貫】做完一次回到隊尾，下一人出發；每人 6–8 次後換邊或換角色。
【要點】打門將遠角，低平球，早出腳。整套跑位的意義就是讓你到位時腳步已經站好。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】チャンスを得点に変える。足を作って到達し、早く低く打ち、人ではなくスペースを狙う。
【頻度】指導者が頻繁に行う技術ブロック。フィニッシュは攻撃全体の目的なので、繰り返し反復する。
【準備】one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts left wing, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box。
【ボールの道筋】7 → 9 → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：7番がボールを運ぶ。ステップ2：7番が9番へパス、9番・10番・GKが前方へ移動。ステップ3：9番がシュート。
【続け方】1本終えたら列の最後尾へ戻り、次の選手が出る。1人6〜8本で左右か役割を交代。
【ポイント】GKの逆へ低く早く。パターンの目的は、到達した時に足が作れていること。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】기회를 골로 바꾼다. 발을 갖춰 도착하고, 빠르고 낮게 슛하며, 사람이 아니라 공간을 노린다.
【빈도】지도자가 자주 하는 기술 블록 — 마무리는 공격 전체의 목적이라 정기적으로 반복한다.
【준비】one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts left wing, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
【볼 경로】7 → 9 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 7번가 공을 몰고 이동; 2단계: 7번가 9번에게 패스, 9번, 10번, GK는 앞으로 이동; 3단계: 9번 슛.
【이어가기】한 번 마치면 줄 맨 뒤로 가고 다음 선수가 출발한다. 한 사람당 6~8회 후 방향이나 역할을 바꾼다.
【포인트】골키퍼 반대편으로 낮고 빠르게. 패턴의 목적은 도착했을 때 발이 준비돼 있는 것이다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Convertir la ocasión en gol: llegar con los apoyos puestos, rematar pronto y raso, y buscar el espacio, no la camiseta.
Frecuencia: Un bloque técnico que se entrena a menudo: la definición es el fin de todo el ataque, así que se ensaya con regularidad.
Montaje: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts left wing, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Recorrido del balón: 7 → 9 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 7 conduce el balón; Paso 2: 7 pasa a 9, 9, 10, GK se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 3: 9 remata.
Continuidad: Al terminar tu repetición vuelves al final de la fila y sale el siguiente; seis a ocho cada uno, luego cambio de lado o de rol.
Punto clave: Dispara cruzado, raso y pronto. El patrón existe para llegar con los pies colocados.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Transformer l'occasion en but : arriver appuis posés, frapper tôt et à ras de terre, viser l'espace et non le maillot.
Fréquence : Un bloc technique travaillé souvent : la finition est le but de toute l'attaque, donc on la répète régulièrement.
Mise en place : one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts left wing, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Trajet du ballon : 7 → 9 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 7 conduit le ballon ; Étape 2 : 7 passe à 9, 9, 10, GK se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 3 : 9 frappe.
Enchaînement : Ta répétition finie, tu retournes en fin de file et le suivant part ; six à huit chacun, puis on change de côté ou de rôle.
Point clé : Frappe croisée, à ras de terre, tôt. La combinaison sert à arriver appuis posés.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Mengubah peluang jadi gol: tiba dengan kaki siap, tembak cepat dan rendah, arahkan ke ruang bukan ke pemain.
Frekuensi: Blok teknis yang sering dilatih — penyelesaian adalah tujuan seluruh serangan, jadi diulang teratur.
Persiapan: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts left wing, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Jalur bola: 7 → 9 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 menggiring bola; Langkah 2: 7 mengoper ke 9, 9, 10, GK bergerak ke depan; Langkah 3: 9 menembak.
Kelanjutan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain berikutnya berangkat; enam sampai delapan kali tiap orang, lalu ganti sisi atau peran.
Poin utama: Tembak menyilang, rendah dan cepat. Pola ini agar kaki sudah siap saat tiba.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Menukar peluang jadi gol: tiba dengan kaki bersedia, tembak awal dan rendah, arah ke ruang bukan pemain.
Kekerapan: Blok teknikal yang kerap dilatih — penamat ialah tujuan seluruh serangan, jadi diulang secara tetap.
Persediaan: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts left wing, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Laluan bola: 7 → 9 → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 membawa bola; Langkah 2: 7 menghantar kepada 9, 9, 10, GK bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 3: 9 menjaring.
Kesinambungan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain seterusnya bermula; enam hingga lapan kali setiap orang, kemudian tukar sisi atau peranan.
Poin utama: Tendang menyilang, rendah dan awal.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: เปลี่ยนโอกาสเป็นประตู: มาถึงโดยตั้งเท้าพร้อม ยิงเร็วและต่ำ เล็งพื้นที่ไม่ใช่ตัวคน
ความถี่: บล็อกทักษะที่ซ้อมบ่อย — การจบสกอร์คือเป้าหมายของการบุกทั้งหมด จึงซ้อมสม่ำเสมอ
การจัด: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts left wing, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box
เส้นทางบอล: 7 → 9 → ประตู
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: 7 พาบอลไป • ขั้นที่ 2: 7 จ่ายให้ 9 9, 10, GK ขยับไปข้างหน้า • ขั้นที่ 3: 9 ยิงประตู
การต่อเนื่อง: ทำเสร็จหนึ่งรอบกลับไปต่อท้ายแถว คนถัดไปออกตัว คนละ 6–8 รอบแล้วสลับข้างหรือสลับหน้าที่
จุดเน้น: ยิงตัดเสา ต่ำและเร็ว แพตเทิร์นมีไว้เพื่อให้ถึงบอลโดยตั้งเท้าพร้อมแล้ว
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Biến cơ hội thành bàn thắng: đến nơi với chân đã sẵn, dứt điểm sớm và sệt, nhắm khoảng trống chứ không nhắm người.
Tần suất: Khối kỹ thuật huấn luyện viên tập thường xuyên — dứt điểm là mục đích của cả đợt tấn công, nên được tập đều.
Bố trí: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts left wing, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Đường bóng: 7 → 9 → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 7 dẫn bóng di chuyển; Bước 2: 7 chuyền cho 9, 9, 10, GK di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 3: 9 dứt điểm.
Tiếp nối: Xong lượt của mình thì về cuối hàng, người tiếp theo xuất phát; mỗi người 6–8 lượt rồi đổi bên hoặc đổi vai.
Điểm chính: Sút chéo góc, sệt và sớm. Bài tập tồn tại để bạn đến nơi với chân đã sẵn sàng.

mistake.en-GB: Shooting off the wrong foot to save a step — the pattern exists to give you the right one.

mistake.zh-TW: 為省一步用錯誤腳射門——這套配合就是為了讓你用對的那隻腳。
mistake.ja-JP: 一歩を惜しんで逆足で撃つ——正しい足で撃つためのパターンだ。
mistake.ko-KR: 한 걸음 아끼려 반대발로 쏜다 — 패턴은 맞는 발을 주려고 있다.
mistake.es-ES: Tirar con la pierna mala por ahorrar un paso: el patrón existe para darte la buena.
mistake.fr-FR: Tirer du mauvais pied pour gagner un pas — le schéma existe pour donner le bon.
mistake.id-ID: Menembak dengan kaki salah demi hemat satu langkah.
mistake.ms-MY: Menembak dengan kaki salah untuk jimat selangkah.
mistake.th-TH: ยิงด้วยเท้าผิดข้างเพื่อประหยัดหนึ่งก้าว
mistake.vi-VN: Sút chân trái ý chỉ để đỡ một bước.

note.en:
Purpose: Turn a chance into a goal: arrive with the feet set, strike early and low, and hit the space rather than the shirt.
Frequency: A technical block coaches run often — the finish is what the whole attack is for, so it is rehearsed regularly.
Setup: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts left halfspace, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Ball path: 7 → 9 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 carries the ball on the move; Step 2: 7 passes to 9, 9, 10, GK move up the board; Step 3: 9 shoots.
How it continues: Back to the end of the line when your rep is done and the next player goes; six to eight each, then switch sides or roles.
Coaching point: Shoot across the keeper, low and early. The pattern only exists to arrive with your feet already set.

note.en:
Purpose: Turn a chance into a goal: arrive with the feet set, strike early and low, and hit the space rather than the shirt.
Frequency: A technical block coaches run often — the finish is what the whole attack is for, so it is rehearsed regularly.
Setup: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts right halfspace, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Ball path: 7 → 9 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 carries the ball on the move; Step 2: 7 passes to 9, 9, 10, GK move up the board; Step 3: 9 shoots.
How it continues: Back to the end of the line when your rep is done and the next player goes; six to eight each, then switch sides or roles.
Coaching point: Shoot across the keeper, low and early. The pattern only exists to arrive with your feet already set.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】射门：练怎么把机会打进。跑到位时脚要站好，早点出脚、打低平球，瞄空当不瞄人。
【频度】技术训练，教练常练——终结是整个进攻的目的，所以要反复练。
【组织】一个球门带门将；传中人从右肋部启动，9 号和 10 号在禁区前沿。
【球路】7 → 9 → 球门
【流程】第1步：7号球员带球推进；第2步：7号球员把球传给9号球员，9号球员、10号球员、GK向前移动；第3步：9号球员射门。
【连贯】做完一次回到队尾，下一人出发；每人 6–8 次后换边或换角色。
【要点】打门将远角，低平球，早出脚。整套跑位的意义就是让你到位时脚步已经站好。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】射門：練怎麼把機會打進。跑到位時腳要站好，早點出腳、打低平球，瞄空檔不瞄人。
【頻度】技術訓練，教練常練——終結是整個進攻的目的，所以要反覆練。
【組織】one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts right halfspace, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box。
【球路】7 → 9 → 球門
【流程】第1步：7號球員帶球推進；第2步：7號球員把球傳給9號球員，9號球員、10號球員、GK向前移動；第3步：9號球員射門。
【連貫】做完一次回到隊尾，下一人出發；每人 6–8 次後換邊或換角色。
【要點】打門將遠角，低平球，早出腳。整套跑位的意義就是讓你到位時腳步已經站好。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】チャンスを得点に変える。足を作って到達し、早く低く打ち、人ではなくスペースを狙う。
【頻度】指導者が頻繁に行う技術ブロック。フィニッシュは攻撃全体の目的なので、繰り返し反復する。
【準備】one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts right halfspace, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box。
【ボールの道筋】7 → 9 → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：7番がボールを運ぶ。ステップ2：7番が9番へパス、9番・10番・GKが前方へ移動。ステップ3：9番がシュート。
【続け方】1本終えたら列の最後尾へ戻り、次の選手が出る。1人6〜8本で左右か役割を交代。
【ポイント】GKの逆へ低く早く。パターンの目的は、到達した時に足が作れていること。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】기회를 골로 바꾼다. 발을 갖춰 도착하고, 빠르고 낮게 슛하며, 사람이 아니라 공간을 노린다.
【빈도】지도자가 자주 하는 기술 블록 — 마무리는 공격 전체의 목적이라 정기적으로 반복한다.
【준비】one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts right halfspace, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
【볼 경로】7 → 9 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 7번가 공을 몰고 이동; 2단계: 7번가 9번에게 패스, 9번, 10번, GK는 앞으로 이동; 3단계: 9번 슛.
【이어가기】한 번 마치면 줄 맨 뒤로 가고 다음 선수가 출발한다. 한 사람당 6~8회 후 방향이나 역할을 바꾼다.
【포인트】골키퍼 반대편으로 낮고 빠르게. 패턴의 목적은 도착했을 때 발이 준비돼 있는 것이다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Convertir la ocasión en gol: llegar con los apoyos puestos, rematar pronto y raso, y buscar el espacio, no la camiseta.
Frecuencia: Un bloque técnico que se entrena a menudo: la definición es el fin de todo el ataque, así que se ensaya con regularidad.
Montaje: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts right halfspace, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Recorrido del balón: 7 → 9 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 7 conduce el balón; Paso 2: 7 pasa a 9, 9, 10, GK se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 3: 9 remata.
Continuidad: Al terminar tu repetición vuelves al final de la fila y sale el siguiente; seis a ocho cada uno, luego cambio de lado o de rol.
Punto clave: Dispara cruzado, raso y pronto. El patrón existe para llegar con los pies colocados.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Transformer l'occasion en but : arriver appuis posés, frapper tôt et à ras de terre, viser l'espace et non le maillot.
Fréquence : Un bloc technique travaillé souvent : la finition est le but de toute l'attaque, donc on la répète régulièrement.
Mise en place : one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts right halfspace, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Trajet du ballon : 7 → 9 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 7 conduit le ballon ; Étape 2 : 7 passe à 9, 9, 10, GK se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 3 : 9 frappe.
Enchaînement : Ta répétition finie, tu retournes en fin de file et le suivant part ; six à huit chacun, puis on change de côté ou de rôle.
Point clé : Frappe croisée, à ras de terre, tôt. La combinaison sert à arriver appuis posés.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Mengubah peluang jadi gol: tiba dengan kaki siap, tembak cepat dan rendah, arahkan ke ruang bukan ke pemain.
Frekuensi: Blok teknis yang sering dilatih — penyelesaian adalah tujuan seluruh serangan, jadi diulang teratur.
Persiapan: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts right halfspace, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Jalur bola: 7 → 9 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 menggiring bola; Langkah 2: 7 mengoper ke 9, 9, 10, GK bergerak ke depan; Langkah 3: 9 menembak.
Kelanjutan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain berikutnya berangkat; enam sampai delapan kali tiap orang, lalu ganti sisi atau peran.
Poin utama: Tembak menyilang, rendah dan cepat. Pola ini agar kaki sudah siap saat tiba.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Menukar peluang jadi gol: tiba dengan kaki bersedia, tembak awal dan rendah, arah ke ruang bukan pemain.
Kekerapan: Blok teknikal yang kerap dilatih — penamat ialah tujuan seluruh serangan, jadi diulang secara tetap.
Persediaan: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts right halfspace, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Laluan bola: 7 → 9 → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 membawa bola; Langkah 2: 7 menghantar kepada 9, 9, 10, GK bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 3: 9 menjaring.
Kesinambungan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain seterusnya bermula; enam hingga lapan kali setiap orang, kemudian tukar sisi atau peranan.
Poin utama: Tendang menyilang, rendah dan awal.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: เปลี่ยนโอกาสเป็นประตู: มาถึงโดยตั้งเท้าพร้อม ยิงเร็วและต่ำ เล็งพื้นที่ไม่ใช่ตัวคน
ความถี่: บล็อกทักษะที่ซ้อมบ่อย — การจบสกอร์คือเป้าหมายของการบุกทั้งหมด จึงซ้อมสม่ำเสมอ
การจัด: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts right halfspace, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box
เส้นทางบอล: 7 → 9 → ประตู
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: 7 พาบอลไป • ขั้นที่ 2: 7 จ่ายให้ 9 9, 10, GK ขยับไปข้างหน้า • ขั้นที่ 3: 9 ยิงประตู
การต่อเนื่อง: ทำเสร็จหนึ่งรอบกลับไปต่อท้ายแถว คนถัดไปออกตัว คนละ 6–8 รอบแล้วสลับข้างหรือสลับหน้าที่
จุดเน้น: ยิงตัดเสา ต่ำและเร็ว แพตเทิร์นมีไว้เพื่อให้ถึงบอลโดยตั้งเท้าพร้อมแล้ว
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Biến cơ hội thành bàn thắng: đến nơi với chân đã sẵn, dứt điểm sớm và sệt, nhắm khoảng trống chứ không nhắm người.
Tần suất: Khối kỹ thuật huấn luyện viên tập thường xuyên — dứt điểm là mục đích của cả đợt tấn công, nên được tập đều.
Bố trí: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts right halfspace, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Đường bóng: 7 → 9 → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 7 dẫn bóng di chuyển; Bước 2: 7 chuyền cho 9, 9, 10, GK di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 3: 9 dứt điểm.
Tiếp nối: Xong lượt của mình thì về cuối hàng, người tiếp theo xuất phát; mỗi người 6–8 lượt rồi đổi bên hoặc đổi vai.
Điểm chính: Sút chéo góc, sệt và sớm. Bài tập tồn tại để bạn đến nơi với chân đã sẵn sàng.

Kekerapan: Blok teknikal yang kerap dilatih — penamat ialah tujuan seluruh serangan, jadi diulang secara tetap.
Persediaan: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts central, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Laluan bola: 7 → 9 → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 membawa bola; Langkah 2: 7 menghantar kepada 9, 9, 10, GK bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 3: 9 menjaring.
Kesinambungan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain seterusnya bermula; enam hingga lapan kali setiap orang, kemudian tukar sisi atau peranan.
Poin utama: Tendang menyilang, rendah dan awal.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: เปลี่ยนโอกาสเป็นประตู: มาถึงโดยตั้งเท้าพร้อม ยิงเร็วและต่ำ เล็งพื้นที่ไม่ใช่ตัวคน
ความถี่: บล็อกทักษะที่ซ้อมบ่อย — การจบสกอร์คือเป้าหมายของการบุกทั้งหมด จึงซ้อมสม่ำเสมอ
การจัด: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts central, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box
เส้นทางบอล: 7 → 9 → ประตู
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: 7 พาบอลไป • ขั้นที่ 2: 7 จ่ายให้ 9 9, 10, GK ขยับไปข้างหน้า • ขั้นที่ 3: 9 ยิงประตู
การต่อเนื่อง: ทำเสร็จหนึ่งรอบกลับไปต่อท้ายแถว คนถัดไปออกตัว คนละ 6–8 รอบแล้วสลับข้างหรือสลับหน้าที่
จุดเน้น: ยิงตัดเสา ต่ำและเร็ว แพตเทิร์นมีไว้เพื่อให้ถึงบอลโดยตั้งเท้าพร้อมแล้ว
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Biến cơ hội thành bàn thắng: đến nơi với chân đã sẵn, dứt điểm sớm và sệt, nhắm khoảng trống chứ không nhắm người.
Tần suất: Khối kỹ thuật huấn luyện viên tập thường xuyên — dứt điểm là mục đích của cả đợt tấn công, nên được tập đều.
Bố trí: one goal with a keeper; the crosser starts central, the 9 and 10 on the edge of the box.
Đường bóng: 7 → 9 → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 7 dẫn bóng di chuyển; Bước 2: 7 chuyền cho 9, 9, 10, GK di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 3: 9 dứt điểm.
Tiếp nối: Xong lượt của mình thì về cuối hàng, người tiếp theo xuất phát; mỗi người 6–8 lượt rồi đổi bên hoặc đổi vai.
Điểm chính: Sút chéo góc, sệt và sớm. Bài tập tồn tại để bạn đến nơi với chân đã sẵn sàng.

mistake.ko-KR: 한 걸음 아끼려 반대발로 쏜다 — 패턴은 맞는 발을 주려고 있다.
mistake.es-ES: Tirar con la pierna mala por ahorrar un paso: el patrón existe para darte la buena.
mistake.fr-FR: Tirer du mauvais pied pour gagner un pas — le schéma existe pour donner le bon.
mistake.id-ID: Menembak dengan kaki salah demi hemat satu langkah.
mistake.ms-MY: Menembak dengan kaki salah untuk jimat selangkah.
mistake.th-TH: ยิงด้วยเท้าผิดข้างเพื่อประหยัดหนึ่งก้าว
mistake.vi-VN: Sút chân trái ý chỉ để đỡ một bước.

note.en:
Purpose: Deny space as a unit — the whole line shifts with the ball, closes the pass on either side of the presser, and covers behind.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week — defensive shape is drilled regularly because it is the habit a match tests most.
Setup: a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
Ball path: B → A
Sequence: Step 1: B passes to A, the whole team moves up the board, A moves up the board.
How it continues: Getting the ball over halfway counts as a success; a turnover or the ball out counts for the pressers. Either way it goes back to the keeper and starts again; six reps, then the sides swap.
Rules: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
Coaching point: The shape decides who presses first. Whoever goes, the two beside him close the passes either side — one presser alone is just a gap.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】防守：练整条线一起动。球到哪边就往哪边压，上抢的人两侧有人封传球线，身后有人保护。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——防守站位要常练，因为它是比赛最常考验的习惯。
【组织】整队按阵型站位，对面三名出球队员；从对方后场开球。
【球路】B → A
【流程】第1步：B把球传给A，全队整体向前移动，A向前移动。
【连贯】球过中线算出球成功，被断或出界算压迫方得分；无论哪种，球回门将重新开始，连做 6 次后攻守互换。
【规则】压迫方在 10 秒内断下球或把球逼出界算一分；控球方把球穿过压迫、控住带过中线算一分。
【要点】阵型决定谁先上。谁上抢，旁边两个人就封掉他两侧的传球路线 —— 只有一个人压，那就只是个洞。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】防守：練整條線一起動。球到哪邊就往哪邊壓，上搶的人兩側有人封傳球線，身後有人保護。
【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——防守站位要常練，因為它是比賽最常考驗的習慣。
【組織】a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line。
【球路】B → A
【流程】第1步：B把球傳給A，全隊整體向前移動，A向前移動。
【連貫】球過中線算出球成功，被斷或出界算壓迫方得分；無論哪種，球回門將重新開始，連做 6 次後攻守互換。
【規則】壓迫方在 10 秒內斷下球或把球逼出界算一分；控球方把球穿過壓迫、控住帶過中線算一分。
【要點】陣型決定誰先上。誰上搶，旁邊兩個人就封掉他兩側的傳球路線 —— 只有一個人壓，那就只是個洞。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】組織として空間を消す。ラインが球に合わせてスライドし、プレスした選手の両脇のパスを封じ、背後をカバーする。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。守備の形は試合が最も試す習慣なので、定期的に反復する。
【準備】a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line。
【ボールの道筋】B → A
【流れ】ステップ1：BがAへパス、チーム全体が前方へスライド、Aが前方へ移動。
【続け方】ハーフウェーを越えれば成功、奪われるかアウトならプレス側の得点。どちらでもキーパーに戻して再開。6本で攻守交代。
【ルール】The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
【ポイント】陣形が最初に行く者を決める。行った選手の両隣がパスコースを閉じる。1人だけのプレスは穴。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】조직적으로 공간을 지운다. 라인 전체가 공을 따라 이동하고, 압박한 선수 양옆의 패스를 막고, 뒤를 커버한다.
【빈도】주 몇 회의 전술 블록 — 수비 형태는 경기가 가장 자주 시험하는 습관이라 정기적으로 훈련한다.
【준비】a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
【볼 경로】B → A
【진행】1단계: B가 A에게 패스, 팀 전체가 앞으로 이동, A는 앞으로 이동.
【이어가기】하프라인을 넘기면 성공, 빼앗기거나 아웃되면 압박하는 쪽의 득점이다. 어느 쪽이든 공은 골키퍼에게 돌아가 다시 시작한다. 6회 후 공수 교대.
【규칙】The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
【포인트】대형이 누가 먼저 나갈지를 정한다. 나간 선수의 양옆이 패스 길을 막는다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Negar el espacio como bloque: la línea bascula con el balón, cierra el pase a ambos lados del que presiona y cubre por detrás.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana: la estructura defensiva se ensaya a menudo porque es lo que más pone a prueba el partido.
Montaje: a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
Recorrido del balón: B → A
Secuencia: Paso 1: B pasa a A, todo el equipo bascula hacia delante, A se desplaza hacia delante.
Continuidad: Superar el medio campo es un éxito; una pérdida o el balón fuera puntúa para los presionadores. En ambos casos vuelve al portero y se reinicia; seis repeticiones y cambio de roles.
Reglas: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
Punto clave: La estructura decide quién sale. Los dos de al lado cierran los pases: un presionador solo es un hueco.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Refuser l'espace en bloc : la ligne coulisse avec le ballon, ferme la passe de chaque côté du presseur et couvre derrière.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine : la structure défensive se travaille souvent, car c'est l'habitude que le match teste le plus.
Mise en place : a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
Trajet du ballon : B → A
Déroulé : Étape 1 : B passe à A, tout le bloc coulisse vers l'avant, A se déplace vers l'avant.
Enchaînement : Passer la ligne médiane, c'est réussi ; une perte ou une sortie, c'est un point pour le pressing. Dans les deux cas retour au gardien et on repart ; six fois, puis on inverse les rôles.
Règles : The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
Point clé : La structure décide qui sort. Ses deux voisins ferment les passes : un presseur seul n'est qu'un trou.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Menutup ruang sebagai satu unit — seluruh garis bergeser mengikuti bola, menutup umpan di kedua sisi penekan, dan menutup di belakang.
Frekuensi: Blok taktis beberapa kali seminggu — bentuk bertahan dilatih rutin karena itu kebiasaan yang paling diuji pertandingan.
Persiapan: a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
Jalur bola: B → A
Urutan: Langkah 1: B mengoper ke A, seluruh tim bergerak ke depan, A bergerak ke depan.
Kelanjutan: Bola melewati garis tengah berarti berhasil; bola direbut atau keluar berarti poin untuk penekan. Apa pun hasilnya bola kembali ke kiper dan mulai lagi; enam ulangan, lalu tukar peran.
Aturan: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
Poin utama: Formasi menentukan siapa menekan lebih dulu; dua di sampingnya menutup jalur umpan.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Menafikan ruang sebagai satu unit — seluruh barisan bergerak mengikut bola, menutup hantaran di kedua-dua sisi penekan, dan melindungi di belakang.
Kekerapan: Blok taktikal beberapa kali seminggu — bentuk pertahanan dilatih kerap kerana itu tabiat yang paling diuji perlawanan.
Persediaan: a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
Laluan bola: B → A
Urutan: Langkah 1: B menghantar kepada A, seluruh pasukan bergerak ke hadapan, A bergerak ke hadapan.
Kesinambungan: Bola melepasi garisan tengah dikira berjaya; bola dirampas atau keluar dikira mata untuk penekan. Apa pun bola kembali kepada penjaga gol dan mula semula; enam ulangan, kemudian tukar peranan.
Peraturan: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
Poin utama: Formasi menentukan siapa menekan dahulu.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: ปิดพื้นที่เป็นทีม — ทั้งแนวขยับตามบอล ปิดบอลสองข้างของคนที่ขึ้นบีบ และคุมด้านหลัง
ความถี่: บล็อกแทคติกสัปดาห์ละไม่กี่ครั้ง — รูปแบบรับต้องซ้อมสม่ำเสมอเพราะเป็นสิ่งที่เกมทดสอบบ่อยที่สุด
การจัด: a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line
เส้นทางบอล: B → A
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: B จ่ายให้ A ทั้งทีมขยับไปข้างหน้า A ขยับไปข้างหน้า
การต่อเนื่อง: บอลข้ามเส้นกลางสนามนับว่าสำเร็จ ถ้าโดนแย่งหรือบอลออกฝ่ายเพรสได้แต้ม ไม่ว่าแบบไหนบอลกลับไปที่ผู้รักษาประตูแล้วเริ่มใหม่ ทำ 6 รอบแล้วสลับฝ่าย
กติกา: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
จุดเน้น: รูปแบบทีมกำหนดว่าใครขึ้นก่อน สองคนข้างๆ ต้องปิดเส้นทางจ่าย
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Bịt không gian như một khối — cả tuyến dịch theo bóng, chặn đường chuyền hai bên người áp sát, và bọc lót phía sau.
Tần suất: Khối chiến thuật vài lần mỗi tuần — thế phòng ngự cần tập đều vì đó là thói quen trận đấu thử thách nhiều nhất.
Bố trí: a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
Đường bóng: B → A
Trình tự: Bước 1: B chuyền cho A, cả đội di chuyển lên phía trước, A di chuyển lên phía trước.
Tiếp nối: Đưa bóng qua giữa sân là thành công; mất bóng hoặc bóng ra ngoài tính điểm cho bên pressing. Dù thế nào bóng cũng về thủ môn và bắt đầu lại; 6 lượt rồi đổi bên.
Luật: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
Điểm chính: Đội hình quyết định ai lao lên trước; hai người bên cạnh chặn hướng chuyền.

mistake.en: The first man sprints and the rest watch — a press of one is just a tired forward.
mistake.en-GB: The first man sprints and the rest watch — a press of one is just a tired forward.
mistake.zh-CN: 第一个人冲了，其他人在看——一个人的压迫只是一个跑累的前锋。
mistake.zh-TW: 第一個人衝了，其他人在看——一個人的壓迫只是一個跑累的前鋒。
mistake.ja-JP: 1人目だけ走って残りが見ている——1人のプレスはただの疲れたFWだ。
mistake.ko-KR: 첫 번째만 뛰고 나머지는 본다 — 혼자의 압박은 지친 공격수일 뿐.
mistake.es-ES: El primero esprinta y el resto mira: una presión de uno es un delantero cansado.
mistake.fr-FR: Le premier sprinte et les autres regardent — un pressing seul n'est qu'un attaquant fatigué.
mistake.id-ID: Orang pertama sprint, sisanya menonton.
mistake.ms-MY: Orang pertama pecut, yang lain menonton.
mistake.th-TH: คนแรกพุ่ง คนอื่นยืนดู
mistake.vi-VN: Người đầu lao lên, còn lại đứng nhìn.

Trajet du ballon : B → A

Aturan: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
Poin utama: Formasi menentukan siapa menekan lebih dulu; dua di sampingnya menutup jalur umpan.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Menafikan ruang sebagai satu unit — seluruh barisan bergerak mengikut bola, menutup hantaran di kedua-dua sisi penekan, dan melindungi di belakang.
Kekerapan: Blok taktikal beberapa kali seminggu — bentuk pertahanan dilatih kerap kerana itu tabiat yang paling diuji perlawanan.
Persediaan: a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.

Peraturan: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.

note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: ปิดพื้นที่เป็นทีม — ทั้งแนวขยับตามบอล ปิดบอลสองข้างของคนที่ขึ้นบีบ และคุมด้านหลัง
ความถี่: บล็อกแทคติกสัปดาห์ละไม่กี่ครั้ง — รูปแบบรับต้องซ้อมสม่ำเสมอเพราะเป็นสิ่งที่เกมทดสอบบ่อยที่สุด
การจัด: a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line
เส้นทางบอล: B → A
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: B จ่ายให้ A ทั้งทีมขยับไปข้างหน้า A ขยับไปข้างหน้า
การต่อเนื่อง: บอลข้ามเส้นกลางสนามนับว่าสำเร็จ ถ้าโดนแย่งหรือบอลออกฝ่ายเพรสได้แต้ม ไม่ว่าแบบไหนบอลกลับไปที่ผู้รักษาประตูแล้วเริ่มใหม่ ทำ 6 รอบแล้วสลับฝ่าย
กติกา: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.

note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Bịt không gian như một khối — cả tuyến dịch theo bóng, chặn đường chuyền hai bên người áp sát, và bọc lót phía sau.
Tần suất: Khối chiến thuật vài lần mỗi tuần — thế phòng ngự cần tập đều vì đó là thói quen trận đấu thử thách nhiều nhất.
Bố trí: a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
Đường bóng: B → A
Trình tự: Bước 1: B chuyền cho A, cả đội di chuyển lên phía trước, A di chuyển lên phía trước.
Tiếp nối: Đưa bóng qua giữa sân là thành công; mất bóng hoặc bóng ra ngoài tính điểm cho bên pressing. Dù thế nào bóng cũng về thủ môn và bắt đầu lại; 6 lượt rồi đổi bên.
Luật: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
Điểm chính: Đội hình quyết định ai lao lên trước; hai người bên cạnh chặn hướng chuyền.

note.en:
Purpose: Deny space as a unit — the whole line shifts with the ball, closes the pass on either side of the presser, and covers behind.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week — defensive shape is drilled regularly because it is the habit a match tests most.
Setup: a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
Ball path: B → A
Sequence: Step 1: B passes to A, the whole team moves up the board, A moves up the board.
How it continues: Getting the ball over halfway counts as a success; a turnover or the ball out counts for the pressers. Either way it goes back to the keeper and starts again; six reps, then the sides swap.
Rules: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
Coaching point: The shape decides who presses first. Whoever goes, the two beside him close the passes either side — one presser alone is just a gap.

note.en:
Purpose: Deny space as a unit — the whole line shifts with the ball, closes the pass on either side of the presser, and covers behind.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week — defensive shape is drilled regularly because it is the habit a match tests most.
Setup: a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
Ball path: B → A
Sequence: Step 1: B passes to A, the whole team moves up the board, A moves up the board.
How it continues: Getting the ball over halfway counts as a success; a turnover or the ball out counts for the pressers. Either way it goes back to the keeper and starts again; six reps, then the sides swap.
Rules: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
Coaching point: The shape decides who presses first. Whoever goes, the two beside him close the passes either side — one presser alone is just a gap.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】防守：练整条线一起动。球到哪边就往哪边压，上抢的人两侧有人封传球线，身后有人保护。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——防守站位要常练，因为它是比赛最常考验的习惯。
【组织】整队按阵型站位，对面三名出球队员；从对方后场开球。
【球路】B → A
【流程】第1步：B把球传给A，全队整体向前移动，A向前移动。
【连贯】球过中线算出球成功，被断或出界算压迫方得分；无论哪种，球回门将重新开始，连做 6 次后攻守互换。
【规则】压迫方在 10 秒内断下球或把球逼出界算一分；控球方把球穿过压迫、控住带过中线算一分。
【要点】阵型决定谁先上。谁上抢，旁边两个人就封掉他两侧的传球路线 —— 只有一个人压，那就只是个洞。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】防守：練整條線一起動。球到哪邊就往哪邊壓，上搶的人兩側有人封傳球線，身後有人保護。
【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——防守站位要常練，因為它是比賽最常考驗的習慣。
【組織】a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line。
【球路】B → A
【流程】第1步：B把球傳給A，全隊整體向前移動，A向前移動。
【連貫】球過中線算出球成功，被斷或出界算壓迫方得分；無論哪種，球回門將重新開始，連做 6 次後攻守互換。
【規則】壓迫方在 10 秒內斷下球或把球逼出界算一分；控球方把球穿過壓迫、控住帶過中線算一分。
【要點】陣型決定誰先上。誰上搶，旁邊兩個人就封掉他兩側的傳球路線 —— 只有一個人壓，那就只是個洞。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】組織として空間を消す。ラインが球に合わせてスライドし、プレスした選手の両脇のパスを封じ、背後をカバーする。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。守備の形は試合が最も試す習慣なので、定期的に反復する。
【準備】a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line。
【ボールの道筋】B → A
【流れ】ステップ1：BがAへパス、チーム全体が前方へスライド、Aが前方へ移動。
【続け方】ハーフウェーを越えれば成功、奪われるかアウトならプレス側の得点。どちらでもキーパーに戻して再開。6本で攻守交代。
【ルール】The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
【ポイント】陣形が最初に行く者を決める。行った選手の両隣がパスコースを閉じる。1人だけのプレスは穴。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】조직적으로 공간을 지운다. 라인 전체가 공을 따라 이동하고, 압박한 선수 양옆의 패스를 막고, 뒤를 커버한다.
【빈도】주 몇 회의 전술 블록 — 수비 형태는 경기가 가장 자주 시험하는 습관이라 정기적으로 훈련한다.
【준비】a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
【볼 경로】B → A
【진행】1단계: B가 A에게 패스, 팀 전체가 앞으로 이동, A는 앞으로 이동.
【이어가기】하프라인을 넘기면 성공, 빼앗기거나 아웃되면 압박하는 쪽의 득점이다. 어느 쪽이든 공은 골키퍼에게 돌아가 다시 시작한다. 6회 후 공수 교대.
【규칙】The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
【포인트】대형이 누가 먼저 나갈지를 정한다. 나간 선수의 양옆이 패스 길을 막는다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Negar el espacio como bloque: la línea bascula con el balón, cierra el pase a ambos lados del que presiona y cubre por detrás.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana: la estructura defensiva se ensaya a menudo porque es lo que más pone a prueba el partido.
Montaje: a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
Recorrido del balón: B → A
Secuencia: Paso 1: B pasa a A, todo el equipo bascula hacia delante, A se desplaza hacia delante.
Continuidad: Superar el medio campo es un éxito; una pérdida o el balón fuera puntúa para los presionadores. En ambos casos vuelve al portero y se reinicia; seis repeticiones y cambio de roles.
Reglas: The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
Punto clave: La estructura decide quién sale. Los dos de al lado cierran los pases: un presionador solo es un hueco.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Refuser l'espace en bloc : la ligne coulisse avec le ballon, ferme la passe de chaque côté du presseur et couvre derrière.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine : la structure défensive se travaille souvent, car c'est l'habitude que le match teste le plus.
Mise en place : a full team in its own shape against three of their build-up players; play starts from their back line.
Trajet du ballon : B → A
Déroulé : Étape 1 : B passe à A, tout le bloc coulisse vers l'avant, A se déplace vers l'avant.
Enchaînement : Passer la ligne médiane, c'est réussi ; une perte ou une sortie, c'est un point pour le pressing. Dans les deux cas retour au gardien et on repart ; six fois, puis on inverse les rôles.
Règles : The press scores by winning the ball inside ten seconds or forcing it out of play; the team on the ball scores by playing through the press and getting the ball under control past the halfway line.
Point clé : La structure décide qui sort. Ses deux voisins ferment les passes : un presseur seul n'est qu'un trou.

note.en:
Purpose: Rehearse a restart until it runs without a word — everyone knows the movement before the whistle, so the delivery, not the decision, is the hard part.
Frequency: Rehearsed weekly and hard before a match — set pieces decide a large share of goals, so the routines are drilled until automatic.
Setup: a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Ball path: 7 → 9 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 passes to 9, 9, 5, 6 move up the board; Step 2: 9 shoots, 8 moves up the board.
How it continues: After each delivery everyone resets to the starting positions and the next taker steps up; eight in a row, half from the left and half from the right.
Coaching point: Attack the ball moving, from outside the crowd inwards. A runner who is already standing there has been marked since the whistle.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】定位球：把套路练到不用喊、大家都知道往哪跑。难点只在传球质量，不在临场想。
【频度】每周练、赛前重点练——定位球贡献了很大比例的进球，所以套路要练到自动化。
【组织】右侧角球，四名进攻者进禁区，对三名盯人和一名站在门线上的门将。
【球路】7 → 9 → 球门
【流程】第1步：7号球员把球传给9号球员，9号球员、5号球员、6号球员向前移动；第2步：9号球员射门，8号球员向前移动。
【连贯】每罚一次，所有人回到起始站位，换下一名主罚；连续 8 次，一半从左边一半从右边。

Objetivo: Ensayar la jugada a balón parado hasta que salga sin hablar: todos saben el movimiento antes del pitido; lo difícil es el envío, no la decisión.
Frecuencia: Se ensaya semanalmente y a fondo antes del partido: el balón parado decide muchos goles, así que las jugadas se drillan hasta automatizarse.
Montaje: a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Recorrido del balón: 7 → 9 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 7 pasa a 9, 9, 5, 6 se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 2: 9 remata, 8 se desplaza hacia delante.
Continuidad: Tras cada saque todos vuelven a la posición inicial y lanza el siguiente; ocho seguidos, la mitad desde la izquierda y la mitad desde la derecha.
Punto clave: Ataca el balón en movimiento, de fuera hacia dentro. Al que ya está parado lo marcan desde el pitido.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Répéter le coup de pied arrêté jusqu'à ce qu'il tourne sans un mot : chacun connaît le mouvement avant le sifflet ; le difficile, c'est la transmission.
Fréquence : Répété chaque semaine et intensément avant un match : les coups de pied arrêtés décident une grande part des buts.
Mise en place : a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Trajet du ballon : 7 → 9 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 7 passe à 9, 9, 5, 6 se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 2 : 9 frappe, 8 se déplace vers l'avant.
Enchaînement : Après chaque frappe tout le monde se replace au départ et le tireur suivant s'avance ; huit d'affilée, moitié de gauche, moitié de droite.
Point clé : Attaque le ballon en mouvement, de l'extérieur vers l'intérieur. Celui qui attend est marqué depuis le coup de sifflet.

note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Tập bóng cố định đến khi chạy không cần nói — ai cũng biết di chuyển trước tiếng còi; cái khó là đường bóng, không phải quyết định.
Tần suất: Tập hàng tuần và kỹ trước trận — bóng cố định quyết định phần lớn bàn thắng, nên các bài được tập đến mức tự động.
Bố trí: a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Đường bóng: 7 → 9 → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 7 chuyền cho 9, 9, 5, 6 di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 2: 9 dứt điểm, 8 di chuyển lên phía trước.
Tiếp nối: Sau mỗi quả đá, mọi người về vị trí ban đầu và người đá tiếp theo bước lên; 8 quả liên tiếp, một nửa từ bên trái, một nửa từ bên phải.
Điểm chính: Đón bóng khi đang chạy, từ ngoài vào trong. Ai đứng sẵn thì đã bị kèm từ lúc còi thổi.

note.en:
Purpose: Rehearse a restart until it runs without a word — everyone knows the movement before the whistle, so the delivery, not the decision, is the hard part.
Frequency: Rehearsed weekly and hard before a match — set pieces decide a large share of goals, so the routines are drilled until automatic.
Setup: a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Ball path: 7 → 9 → 8 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 passes to 9, 9, 5, 6 move up the board; Step 2: 9 passes to 8, 8 moves up the board; Step 3: 8 shoots.
How it continues: After each delivery everyone resets to the starting positions and the next taker steps up; eight in a row, half from the left and half from the right.
Coaching point: Attack the ball moving, from outside the crowd inwards. A runner who is already standing there has been marked since the whistle.

note.en:
Purpose: Rehearse a restart until it runs without a word — everyone knows the movement before the whistle, so the delivery, not the decision, is the hard part.
Frequency: Rehearsed weekly and hard before a match — set pieces decide a large share of goals, so the routines are drilled until automatic.
Setup: a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Ball path: 7 → 9 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 passes to 9, 9, 5 move up the board; Step 2: 9 shoots, 8 moves left.
How it continues: After each delivery everyone resets to the starting positions and the next taker steps up; eight in a row, half from the left and half from the right.
Coaching point: Attack the ball moving, from outside the crowd inwards. A runner who is already standing there has been marked since the whistle.

【组织】右侧角球，四名进攻者进禁区，对三名盯人和一名站在门线上的门将。
【球路】7 → 9 → 球门
【流程】第1步：7号球员把球传给9号球员，9号球员、5号球员向前移动；第2步：9号球员射门，8号球员向左移动。
【连贯】每罚一次，所有人回到起始站位，换下一名主罚；连续 8 次，一半从左边一半从右边。
【要点】跑动中抢点，从人堆外面往里冲。早早站在那儿的人，从哨响就已经被盯死了。

【頻度】毎週、試合前は特に反復する。セットプレーは得点の多くを占めるので、型が自動化するまで仕込む。
【準備】a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line。
【ボールの道筋】7 → 9 → ゴール

【빈도】매주, 경기 전에는 집중적으로 반복 — 세트피스는 득점의 큰 비중을 차지하므로 자동화될 때까지 훈련한다.
【준비】a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
【볼 경로】7 → 9 → 골문

【이어가기】한 번 찰 때마다 모두 처음 위치로 돌아가고 다음 키커가 나선다. 연속 8회, 절반은 왼쪽에서 절반은 오른쪽에서.
【포인트】움직이면서 바깥에서 안으로 들어가라. 미리 서 있는 선수는 휘슬 때부터 마크된 것이다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Ensayar la jugada a balón parado hasta que salga sin hablar: todos saben el movimiento antes del pitido; lo difícil es el envío, no la decisión.
Frecuencia: Se ensaya semanalmente y a fondo antes del partido: el balón parado decide muchos goles, así que las jugadas se drillan hasta automatizarse.
Montaje: a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Recorrido del balón: 7 → 9 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 7 pasa a 9, 9, 5 se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 2: 9 remata, 8 se desplaza a la izquierda.
Continuidad: Tras cada saque todos vuelven a la posición inicial y lanza el siguiente; ocho seguidos, la mitad desde la izquierda y la mitad desde la derecha.
Punto clave: Ataca el balón en movimiento, de fuera hacia dentro. Al que ya está parado lo marcan desde el pitido.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Répéter le coup de pied arrêté jusqu'à ce qu'il tourne sans un mot : chacun connaît le mouvement avant le sifflet ; le difficile, c'est la transmission.
Fréquence : Répété chaque semaine et intensément avant un match : les coups de pied arrêtés décident une grande part des buts.
Mise en place : a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Trajet du ballon : 7 → 9 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 7 passe à 9, 9, 5 se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 2 : 9 frappe, 8 se déplace à gauche.
Enchaînement : Après chaque frappe tout le monde se replace au départ et le tireur suivant s'avance ; huit d'affilée, moitié de gauche, moitié de droite.
Point clé : Attaque le ballon en mouvement, de l'extérieur vers l'intérieur. Celui qui attend est marqué depuis le coup de sifflet.
note.id-ID:

Frekuensi: Dilatih mingguan dan intensif sebelum pertandingan — bola mati menentukan banyak gol, jadi rutinitas dilatih sampai otomatis.
Persiapan: a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Jalur bola: 7 → 9 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 mengoper ke 9, 9, 5 bergerak ke depan; Langkah 2: 9 menembak, 8 bergerak ke kiri.

Poin utama: Serang bola sambil bergerak, dari luar ke dalam.

Poin utama: Serang bola sambil bergerak, dari luar ke dalam.
