【빈도】매주, 경기 전에는 집중적으로 반복 — 세트피스는 득점의 큰 비중을 차지하므로 자동화될 때까지 훈련한다.
【준비】a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
【볼 경로】7 → 9 → 빈 자리 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 7번가 9번에게 패스, 9번, 5번, 6번는 앞으로 이동; 2단계: 9번가 다음 지점으로 보낸다, 8번는 앞으로 이동.
【이어가기】한 번 찰 때마다 모두 처음 위치로 돌아가고 다음 키커가 나선다. 연속 8회, 절반은 왼쪽에서 절반은 오른쪽에서.
【포인트】움직이면서 바깥에서 안으로 들어가라. 미리 서 있는 선수는 휘슬 때부터 마크된 것이다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Ensayar la jugada a balón parado hasta que salga sin hablar: todos saben el movimiento antes del pitido; lo difícil es el envío, no la decisión.
Frecuencia: Se ensaya semanalmente y a fondo antes del partido: el balón parado decide muchos goles, así que las jugadas se drillan hasta automatizarse.
Montaje: a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Recorrido del balón: 7 → 9 → el espacio libre → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 7 pasa a 9, 9, 5, 6 se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 2: 9 envía el balón al siguiente punto, 8 se desplaza hacia delante.
Continuidad: Tras cada saque todos vuelven a la posición inicial y lanza el siguiente; ocho seguidos, la mitad desde la izquierda y la mitad desde la derecha.
Punto clave: Ataca el balón en movimiento, de fuera hacia dentro. Al que ya está parado lo marcan desde el pitido.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Répéter le coup de pied arrêté jusqu'à ce qu'il tourne sans un mot : chacun connaît le mouvement avant le sifflet ; le difficile, c'est la transmission.
Fréquence : Répété chaque semaine et intensément avant un match : les coups de pied arrêtés décident une grande part des buts.
Mise en place : a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Trajet du ballon : 7 → 9 → l'espace libre → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 7 passe à 9, 9, 5, 6 se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 2 : 9 envoie le ballon au point suivant, 8 se déplace vers l'avant.
Enchaînement : Après chaque frappe tout le monde se replace au départ et le tireur suivant s'avance ; huit d'affilée, moitié de gauche, moitié de droite.
Point clé : Attaque le ballon en mouvement, de l'extérieur vers l'intérieur. Celui qui attend est marqué depuis le coup de sifflet.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Melatih bola mati sampai jalan tanpa kata — semua tahu pergerakan sebelum peluit; yang sulit adalah pengiriman, bukan keputusan.
Frekuensi: Dilatih mingguan dan intensif sebelum pertandingan — bola mati menentukan banyak gol, jadi rutinitas dilatih sampai otomatis.
Persiapan: a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Jalur bola: 7 → 9 → titik kosong → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 mengoper ke 9, 9, 5, 6 bergerak ke depan; Langkah 2: 9 memainkan bola ke titik berikutnya, 8 bergerak ke depan.
Kelanjutan: Setelah tiap eksekusi semua kembali ke posisi awal dan pengeksekusi berikutnya maju; delapan berturut-turut, separuh dari kiri dan separuh dari kanan.
Poin utama: Serang bola sambil bergerak, dari luar ke dalam.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Melatih bola mati sehingga berjalan tanpa sepatah kata — semua tahu pergerakan sebelum wisel; yang sukar ialah penghantaran, bukan keputusan.
Kekerapan: Dilatih mingguan dan intensif sebelum perlawanan — bola mati menentukan banyak gol, jadi rutin dilatih sehingga automatik.
Persediaan: a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Laluan bola: 7 → 9 → ruang kosong → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 menghantar kepada 9, 9, 5, 6 bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 2: 9 memainkan bola ke titik seterusnya, 8 bergerak ke hadapan.
Kesinambungan: Selepas setiap sepakan semua kembali ke posisi permulaan dan penyepak seterusnya maju; lapan berturut-turut, separuh dari kiri dan separuh dari kanan.
Poin utama: Serang bola sambil bergerak, dari luar ke dalam.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: ซ้อมลูกตั้งเตะจนเล่นได้โดยไม่ต้องพูด — ทุกคนรู้การเคลื่อนที่ก่อนเป่านกหวีด สิ่งที่ยากคือการจ่าย ไม่ใช่การตัดสินใจ
ความถี่: ซ้อมทุกสัปดาห์และเข้มก่อนแข่ง — ลูกตั้งเตะทำประตูสัดส่วนมาก จึงซ้อมจนเป็นอัตโนมัติ
การจัด: a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line
เส้นทางบอล: 7 → 9 → จุดว่าง → ประตู
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: 7 จ่ายให้ 9 9, 5, 6 ขยับไปข้างหน้า • ขั้นที่ 2: 9 ส่งบอลไปจุดถัดไป 8 ขยับไปข้างหน้า
การต่อเนื่อง: หลังเตะแต่ละครั้งทุกคนกลับไปตำแหน่งเริ่มต้นและเปลี่ยนคนเตะคนถัดไป ทำติดกัน 8 ครั้ง ครึ่งหนึ่งจากฝั่งซ้าย ครึ่งหนึ่งจากฝั่งขวา
จุดเน้น: เข้าชิงบอลขณะเคลื่อนที่ จากนอกกลุ่มเข้าใน คนที่ยืนรออยู่แล้วถูกประกบตั้งแต่เป่านกหวีด
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Tập bóng cố định đến khi chạy không cần nói — ai cũng biết di chuyển trước tiếng còi; cái khó là đường bóng, không phải quyết định.
Tần suất: Tập hàng tuần và kỹ trước trận — bóng cố định quyết định phần lớn bàn thắng, nên các bài được tập đến mức tự động.
Bố trí: a corner from the right, four attackers in the box against three markers and a keeper on his line.
Đường bóng: 7 → 9 → vị trí trống → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 7 chuyền cho 9, 9, 5, 6 di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 2: 9 đưa bóng tới điểm kế tiếp, 8 di chuyển lên phía trước.
Tiếp nối: Sau mỗi quả đá, mọi người về vị trí ban đầu và người đá tiếp theo bước lên; 8 quả liên tiếp, một nửa từ bên trái, một nửa từ bên phải.
Điểm chính: Đón bóng khi đang chạy, từ ngoài vào trong. Ai đứng sẵn thì đã bị kèm từ lúc còi thổi.

note.en:
Purpose: Break a set defence: create and use an overload, commit a defender, and play the pass his movement opens.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week, as the team sharpens how it creates and takes chances.
Setup: one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Ball path: 8 → 11 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 8 passes to 11, 11 moves up the board to meet the pass; Step 2: 11 carries the ball on the move, A moves back to delay and jockey, 11 moves right to shake off the marker; Step 3: 11 shoots, GK moves left.
How it continues: A rep ends on a shot, a tackle or the ball going out. The attackers rejoin the queue and the next go straight in; the defenders hold for four reps, then swap with the attackers.
Rules: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Coaching point: Attack at speed, change direction once. Two feints give the defender time to recover his balance.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】进攻：练怎么打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出来，再传他让出的那条线。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——磨合球队制造和把握机会的方式。
【组织】一个球门带门将，20 米外一名喂球人，防守者站在进攻者内侧肩位。
【球路】8 → 11 → 球门
【流程】第1步：8号球员把球传给11号球员，11号球员向前移动（迎上去接球）；第2步：11号球员带球推进，A向后移动（拖延，不轻易上抢），11号球员向右移动（摆脱盯防）；第3步：11号球员射门，GK向左移动。
【连贯】一球结束——射门、断球或球出界——进攻方回到队尾，下一组马上进攻；防守方连守四球后与进攻互换。
【规则】进攻者把球从门柱之间打过门将算得分；射门、被断球、门将控住球或球出练习区域，本回合都就此结束。不判越位。
【要点】带速度冲，只变一次向。晃两下，防守人就把重心找回来了。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】進攻：練怎麼打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出來，再傳他讓出的那條線。
【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——磨合球隊製造和把握機會的方式。
【組織】one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder。
【球路】8 → 11 → 球門
【流程】第1步：8號球員把球傳給11號球員，11號球員向前移動（迎上去接球）；第2步：11號球員帶球推進，A向後移動（拖延，不輕易上搶），11號球員向右移動（擺脫盯防）；第3步：11號球員射門，GK向左移動。
【連貫】一球結束——射門、斷球或球出界——進攻方回到隊尾，下一組馬上進攻；防守方連守四球後與進攻互換。
【規則】進攻者把球從門柱之間打過門將算得分；射門、被斷球、門將控住球或球出練習區域，本回合都就此結束。不判越位。
【要點】帶速度衝，只變一次向。晃兩下，防守人就把重心找回來了。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】整った守備を崩す。数的優位を作って使い、守備者に決断を迫り、その動きが空けたパスを通す。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。チャンスの作り方と決め方を磨く。
【準備】one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder。
【ボールの道筋】8 → 11 → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：8番が11番へパス、11番が前方へ移動し、ボールを迎えに行く。ステップ2：11番がボールを運ぶ、Aが後方へ移動し、遅らせて間合いを取る、11番が右へ移動し、マークを外す。ステップ3：11番がシュート、GKが左へ移動。
【続け方】シュート、ボール奪取、ボールアウトで1本終了。攻撃側は列に戻り次の組がすぐ入る。守備側は4本続けてから攻守交代。
【ルール】The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
【ポイント】スピードを持って仕掛け、方向転換は一度。二度フェイントすると相手は体勢を戻す。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】정돈된 수비를 깬다. 수적 우위를 만들고 이용하며, 수비수에게 결정을 강요하고 그 움직임이 여는 패스를 넣는다.
【빈도】주 몇 회 진행하는 전술 블록 — 팀이 기회를 만들고 살리는 법을 다듬는다.
【준비】one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
【볼 경로】8 → 11 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 8번가 11번에게 패스, 11번는 앞으로 이동해 패스를 마중 나간다; 2단계: 11번가 공을 몰고 이동, A는 뒤로 이동해 지연시키며 거리를 유지한다, 11번는 오른쪽으로 이동해 마크를 떨쳐낸다; 3단계: 11번 슛, GK는 왼쪽으로 이동.
【이어가기】슈팅, 태클, 아웃으로 한 세트가 끝난다. 공격은 줄로 돌아가고 다음 조가 바로 들어온다. 수비는 네 번을 막은 뒤 공격과 교대한다.
【규칙】The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
【포인트】속도를 유지하고 방향은 한 번만 바꿔라. 두 번 속이면 수비가 균형을 되찾는다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana, para afinar cómo crea y aprovecha ocasiones.
Montaje: one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Recorrido del balón: 8 → 11 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 8 pasa a 11, 11 se desplaza hacia delante para ir al encuentro del balón; Paso 2: 11 conduce el balón, A se desplaza hacia atrás para temporizar sin entrar, 11 se desplaza a la derecha para desmarcarse; Paso 3: 11 remata, GK se desplaza a la izquierda.
Continuidad: La repetición termina con un tiro, un robo o el balón fuera. Los atacantes vuelven a la fila y entran los siguientes; los defensores aguantan cuatro y luego cambian con los atacantes.
Reglas: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Punto clave: Ataca con velocidad y cambia de dirección una vez. Dos fintas le devuelven el equilibrio al defensor.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Casser une défense en place : créer et exploiter le surnombre, engager un défenseur et jouer la passe que son mouvement ouvre.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine, pour affiner la création et la finition des occasions.
Mise en place : one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Trajet du ballon : 8 → 11 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 8 passe à 11, 11 se déplace vers l'avant pour venir au-devant du ballon ; Étape 2 : 11 conduit le ballon, A se déplace vers l'arrière pour temporiser sans se jeter, 11 se déplace à droite pour se démarquer ; Étape 3 : 11 frappe, GK se déplace à gauche.
Enchaînement : La séquence s'arrête sur un tir, une récupération ou une sortie de balle. Les attaquants rejoignent la file et les suivants enchaînent ; les défenseurs tiennent quatre séquences puis permutent.
Règles : The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Point clé : Attaque en vitesse, un seul changement de direction. Deux feintes lui rendent son équilibre.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Membongkar pertahanan yang tersusun: buat dan manfaatkan overload, paksa bek memutuskan, lalu mainkan umpan yang terbuka.
Frekuensi: Blok taktis beberapa kali seminggu, saat tim mengasah cara menciptakan dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persiapan: one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Jalur bola: 8 → 11 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 8 mengoper ke 11, 11 bergerak ke depan untuk menjemput bola; Langkah 2: 11 menggiring bola, A bergerak ke belakang untuk memperlambat tanpa terburu-buru, 11 bergerak ke kanan untuk lepas dari penjagaan; Langkah 3: 11 menembak, GK bergerak ke kiri.
Kelanjutan: Satu ulangan berakhir dengan tembakan, rebutan, atau bola keluar. Penyerang kembali ke antrean dan yang berikutnya langsung masuk; bek bertahan empat ulangan lalu bertukar dengan penyerang.
Aturan: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Poin utama: Serang dengan kecepatan, ubah arah sekali saja.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Memecahkan pertahanan tersusun: cipta dan guna lebihan pemain, paksa bek membuat keputusan, mainkan hantaran yang terbuka.
Kekerapan: Blok taktikal beberapa kali seminggu, ketika pasukan mengasah cara mencipta dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persediaan: one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Laluan bola: 8 → 11 → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 8 menghantar kepada 11, 11 bergerak ke hadapan untuk menyambut bola; Langkah 2: 11 membawa bola, A bergerak ke belakang untuk melambatkan tanpa terburu-buru, 11 bergerak ke kanan untuk lepas daripada kawalan; Langkah 3: 11 menjaring, GK bergerak ke kiri.
Kesinambungan: Satu ulangan tamat dengan rembatan, rampasan, atau bola keluar. Penyerang kembali ke barisan dan yang seterusnya terus masuk; pemain bertahan kekal empat ulangan kemudian bertukar dengan penyerang.
Peraturan: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Poin utama: Serang dengan kelajuan, tukar arah sekali sahaja.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: เจาะแนวรับที่ตั้งรับ: สร้างและใช้ความได้เปรียบจำนวน บังคับกองหลังให้ตัดสินใจ แล้วจ่ายบอลที่เปิดออก
ความถี่: บล็อกแทคติกสัปดาห์ละไม่กี่ครั้ง เพื่อฝึกการสร้างและใช้โอกาส

note.en:
Purpose: Break a set defence: create and use an overload, commit a defender, and play the pass his movement opens.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week, as the team sharpens how it creates and takes chances.
Setup: one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Ball path: 8 → 11 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 8 passes to 11, 11 moves up the board to meet the pass; Step 2: 11 carries the ball on the move, A moves back to delay and jockey, 11 moves left to shake off the marker; Step 3: 11 shoots, GK moves right.
How it continues: A rep ends on a shot, a tackle or the ball going out. The attackers rejoin the queue and the next go straight in; the defenders hold for four reps, then swap with the attackers.
Rules: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Coaching point: Attack at speed, change direction once. Two feints give the defender time to recover his balance.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】进攻：练怎么打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出来，再传他让出的那条线。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——磨合球队制造和把握机会的方式。
【组织】一个球门带门将，20 米外一名喂球人，防守者站在进攻者内侧肩位。
【球路】8 → 11 → 球门
【流程】第1步：8号球员把球传给11号球员，11号球员向前移动（迎上去接球）；第2步：11号球员带球推进，A向后移动（拖延，不轻易上抢），11号球员向左移动（摆脱盯防）；第3步：11号球员射门，GK向右移动。
【连贯】一球结束——射门、断球或球出界——进攻方回到队尾，下一组马上进攻；防守方连守四球后与进攻互换。
【规则】进攻者把球从门柱之间打过门将算得分；射门、被断球、门将控住球或球出练习区域，本回合都就此结束。不判越位。
【要点】带速度冲，只变一次向。晃两下，防守人就把重心找回来了。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】進攻：練怎麼打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出來，再傳他讓出的那條線。
【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——磨合球隊製造和把握機會的方式。
【組織】one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder。
【球路】8 → 11 → 球門
【流程】第1步：8號球員把球傳給11號球員，11號球員向前移動（迎上去接球）；第2步：11號球員帶球推進，A向後移動（拖延，不輕易上搶），11號球員向左移動（擺脫盯防）；第3步：11號球員射門，GK向右移動。
【連貫】一球結束——射門、斷球或球出界——進攻方回到隊尾，下一組馬上進攻；防守方連守四球後與進攻互換。
【規則】進攻者把球從門柱之間打過門將算得分；射門、被斷球、門將控住球或球出練習區域，本回合都就此結束。不判越位。
【要點】帶速度衝，只變一次向。晃兩下，防守人就把重心找回來了。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】整った守備を崩す。数的優位を作って使い、守備者に決断を迫り、その動きが空けたパスを通す。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。チャンスの作り方と決め方を磨く。
【準備】one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder。
【ボールの道筋】8 → 11 → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：8番が11番へパス、11番が前方へ移動し、ボールを迎えに行く。ステップ2：11番がボールを運ぶ、Aが後方へ移動し、遅らせて間合いを取る、11番が左へ移動し、マークを外す。ステップ3：11番がシュート、GKが右へ移動。
【続け方】シュート、ボール奪取、ボールアウトで1本終了。攻撃側は列に戻り次の組がすぐ入る。守備側は4本続けてから攻守交代。
【ルール】The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
【ポイント】スピードを持って仕掛け、方向転換は一度。二度フェイントすると相手は体勢を戻す。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】정돈된 수비를 깬다. 수적 우위를 만들고 이용하며, 수비수에게 결정을 강요하고 그 움직임이 여는 패스를 넣는다.
【빈도】주 몇 회 진행하는 전술 블록 — 팀이 기회를 만들고 살리는 법을 다듬는다.
【준비】one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
【볼 경로】8 → 11 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 8번가 11번에게 패스, 11번는 앞으로 이동해 패스를 마중 나간다; 2단계: 11번가 공을 몰고 이동, A는 뒤로 이동해 지연시키며 거리를 유지한다, 11번는 왼쪽으로 이동해 마크를 떨쳐낸다; 3단계: 11번 슛, GK는 오른쪽으로 이동.
【이어가기】슈팅, 태클, 아웃으로 한 세트가 끝난다. 공격은 줄로 돌아가고 다음 조가 바로 들어온다. 수비는 네 번을 막은 뒤 공격과 교대한다.
【규칙】The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
【포인트】속도를 유지하고 방향은 한 번만 바꿔라. 두 번 속이면 수비가 균형을 되찾는다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana, para afinar cómo crea y aprovecha ocasiones.
Montaje: one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Recorrido del balón: 8 → 11 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 8 pasa a 11, 11 se desplaza hacia delante para ir al encuentro del balón; Paso 2: 11 conduce el balón, A se desplaza hacia atrás para temporizar sin entrar, 11 se desplaza a la izquierda para desmarcarse; Paso 3: 11 remata, GK se desplaza a la derecha.
Continuidad: La repetición termina con un tiro, un robo o el balón fuera. Los atacantes vuelven a la fila y entran los siguientes; los defensores aguantan cuatro y luego cambian con los atacantes.
Reglas: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Punto clave: Ataca con velocidad y cambia de dirección una vez. Dos fintas le devuelven el equilibrio al defensor.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Casser une défense en place : créer et exploiter le surnombre, engager un défenseur et jouer la passe que son mouvement ouvre.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine, pour affiner la création et la finition des occasions.
Mise en place : one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Trajet du ballon : 8 → 11 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 8 passe à 11, 11 se déplace vers l'avant pour venir au-devant du ballon ; Étape 2 : 11 conduit le ballon, A se déplace vers l'arrière pour temporiser sans se jeter, 11 se déplace à gauche pour se démarquer ; Étape 3 : 11 frappe, GK se déplace à droite.
Enchaînement : La séquence s'arrête sur un tir, une récupération ou une sortie de balle. Les attaquants rejoignent la file et les suivants enchaînent ; les défenseurs tiennent quatre séquences puis permutent.
Règles : The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Point clé : Attaque en vitesse, un seul changement de direction. Deux feintes lui rendent son équilibre.

Kelanjutan: Satu ulangan berakhir dengan tembakan, rebutan, atau bola keluar. Penyerang kembali ke antrean dan yang berikutnya langsung masuk; bek bertahan empat ulangan lalu bertukar dengan penyerang.
Aturan: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Poin utama: Serang dengan kecepatan, ubah arah sekali saja.

Rules: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】进攻：练怎么打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出来，再传他让出的那条线。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——磨合球队制造和把握机会的方式。
【组织】一个球门带门将，20 米外一名喂球人，防守者站在进攻者内侧肩位。
【球路】8 → 11 → 球门
【流程】第1步：8号球员把球传给11号球员，11号球员向前移动（迎上去接球）；第2步：11号球员带球推进，A向后移动（拖延，不轻易上抢），11号球员向右移动（摆脱盯防）；第3步：11号球员射门，GK向右移动。
【连贯】一球结束——射门、断球或球出界——进攻方回到队尾，下一组马上进攻；防守方连守四球后与进攻互换。
【规则】进攻者把球从门柱之间打过门将算得分；射门、被断球、门将控住球或球出练习区域，本回合都就此结束。不判越位。
【要点】带速度冲，只变一次向。晃两下，防守人就把重心找回来了。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】進攻：練怎麼打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出來，再傳他讓出的那條線。
【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——磨合球隊製造和把握機會的方式。
【組織】one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder。

【連貫】一球結束——射門、斷球或球出界——進攻方回到隊尾，下一組馬上進攻；防守方連守四球後與進攻互換。
【規則】進攻者把球從門柱之間打過門將算得分；射門、被斷球、門將控住球或球出練習區域，本回合都就此結束。不判越位。
【要點】帶速度衝，只變一次向。晃兩下，防守人就把重心找回來了。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】整った守備を崩す。数的優位を作って使い、守備者に決断を迫り、その動きが空けたパスを通す。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。チャンスの作り方と決め方を磨く。
【準備】one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder。
【ボールの道筋】8 → 11 → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：8番が11番へパス、11番が前方へ移動し、ボールを迎えに行く。ステップ2：11番がボールを運ぶ、Aが後方へ移動し、遅らせて間合いを取る、11番が右へ移動し、マークを外す。ステップ3：11番がシュート、GKが右へ移動。
【続け方】シュート、ボール奪取、ボールアウトで1本終了。攻撃側は列に戻り次の組がすぐ入る。守備側は4本続けてから攻守交代。
【ルール】The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
【ポイント】スピードを持って仕掛け、方向転換は一度。二度フェイントすると相手は体勢を戻す。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】정돈된 수비를 깬다. 수적 우위를 만들고 이용하며, 수비수에게 결정을 강요하고 그 움직임이 여는 패스를 넣는다.
【빈도】주 몇 회 진행하는 전술 블록 — 팀이 기회를 만들고 살리는 법을 다듬는다.
【준비】one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
【볼 경로】8 → 11 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 8번가 11번에게 패스, 11번는 앞으로 이동해 패스를 마중 나간다; 2단계: 11번가 공을 몰고 이동, A는 뒤로 이동해 지연시키며 거리를 유지한다, 11번는 오른쪽으로 이동해 마크를 떨쳐낸다; 3단계: 11번 슛, GK는 오른쪽으로 이동.
【이어가기】슈팅, 태클, 아웃으로 한 세트가 끝난다. 공격은 줄로 돌아가고 다음 조가 바로 들어온다. 수비는 네 번을 막은 뒤 공격과 교대한다.
【규칙】The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
【포인트】속도를 유지하고 방향은 한 번만 바꿔라. 두 번 속이면 수비가 균형을 되찾는다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana, para afinar cómo crea y aprovecha ocasiones.
Montaje: one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Recorrido del balón: 8 → 11 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 8 pasa a 11, 11 se desplaza hacia delante para ir al encuentro del balón; Paso 2: 11 conduce el balón, A se desplaza hacia atrás para temporizar sin entrar, 11 se desplaza a la derecha para desmarcarse; Paso 3: 11 remata, GK se desplaza a la derecha.
Continuidad: La repetición termina con un tiro, un robo o el balón fuera. Los atacantes vuelven a la fila y entran los siguientes; los defensores aguantan cuatro y luego cambian con los atacantes.
Reglas: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Punto clave: Ataca con velocidad y cambia de dirección una vez. Dos fintas le devuelven el equilibrio al defensor.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Casser une défense en place : créer et exploiter le surnombre, engager un défenseur et jouer la passe que son mouvement ouvre.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine, pour affiner la création et la finition des occasions.
Mise en place : one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Trajet du ballon : 8 → 11 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 8 passe à 11, 11 se déplace vers l'avant pour venir au-devant du ballon ; Étape 2 : 11 conduit le ballon, A se déplace vers l'arrière pour temporiser sans se jeter, 11 se déplace à droite pour se démarquer ; Étape 3 : 11 frappe, GK se déplace à droite.
Enchaînement : La séquence s'arrête sur un tir, une récupération ou une sortie de balle. Les attaquants rejoignent la file et les suivants enchaînent ; les défenseurs tiennent quatre séquences puis permutent.
Règles : The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Point clé : Attaque en vitesse, un seul changement de direction. Deux feintes lui rendent son équilibre.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Membongkar pertahanan yang tersusun: buat dan manfaatkan overload, paksa bek memutuskan, lalu mainkan umpan yang terbuka.
Frekuensi: Blok taktis beberapa kali seminggu, saat tim mengasah cara menciptakan dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persiapan: one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Jalur bola: 8 → 11 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 8 mengoper ke 11, 11 bergerak ke depan untuk menjemput bola; Langkah 2: 11 menggiring bola, A bergerak ke belakang untuk memperlambat tanpa terburu-buru, 11 bergerak ke kanan untuk lepas dari penjagaan; Langkah 3: 11 menembak, GK bergerak ke kanan.
Kelanjutan: Satu ulangan berakhir dengan tembakan, rebutan, atau bola keluar. Penyerang kembali ke antrean dan yang berikutnya langsung masuk; bek bertahan empat ulangan lalu bertukar dengan penyerang.
Aturan: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Poin utama: Serang dengan kecepatan, ubah arah sekali saja.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Memecahkan pertahanan tersusun: cipta dan guna lebihan pemain, paksa bek membuat keputusan, mainkan hantaran yang terbuka.
Kekerapan: Blok taktikal beberapa kali seminggu, ketika pasukan mengasah cara mencipta dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persediaan: one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Laluan bola: 8 → 11 → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 8 menghantar kepada 11, 11 bergerak ke hadapan untuk menyambut bola; Langkah 2: 11 membawa bola, A bergerak ke belakang untuk melambatkan tanpa terburu-buru, 11 bergerak ke kanan untuk lepas daripada kawalan; Langkah 3: 11 menjaring, GK bergerak ke kanan.
Kesinambungan: Satu ulangan tamat dengan rembatan, rampasan, atau bola keluar. Penyerang kembali ke barisan dan yang seterusnya terus masuk; pemain bertahan kekal empat ulangan kemudian bertukar dengan penyerang.
Peraturan: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Poin utama: Serang dengan kelajuan, tukar arah sekali sahaja.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: เจาะแนวรับที่ตั้งรับ: สร้างและใช้ความได้เปรียบจำนวน บังคับกองหลังให้ตัดสินใจ แล้วจ่ายบอลที่เปิดออก
ความถี่: บล็อกแทคติกสัปดาห์ละไม่กี่ครั้ง เพื่อฝึกการสร้างและใช้โอกาส
การจัด: one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder
เส้นทางบอล: 8 → 11 → ประตู
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: 8 จ่ายให้ 11 11 ขยับไปข้างหน้าเพื่อขยับเข้าหาบอล • ขั้นที่ 2: 11 พาบอลไป A ขยับถอยหลังเพื่อถ่วงเวลา ไม่รีบเข้าแย่ง 11 ขยับไปทางขวาเพื่อสลัดตัวประกบ • ขั้นที่ 3: 11 ยิงประตู GK ขยับไปทางขวา
การต่อเนื่อง: จบหนึ่งรอบเมื่อยิง แย่งบอลได้ หรือบอลออก ฝ่ายบุกกลับไปต่อแถวแล้วชุดถัดไปเข้าทันที ฝ่ายรับรับสี่รอบแล้วสลับกับฝ่ายบุก
กติกา: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
จุดเน้น: พุ่งด้วยความเร็ว เปลี่ยนทิศทางครั้งเดียว หลอกสองครั้งกองหลังจะตั้งตัวได้
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Phá vỡ hàng thủ đã dựng: tạo và tận dụng hơn người, buộc hậu vệ quyết định, rồi chuyền vào khoảng trống mở ra.
Tần suất: Khối chiến thuật tập vài lần mỗi tuần, để đội mài giũa cách tạo và tận dụng cơ hội.
Bố trí: one goal with a keeper, a server 20 m out and a defender on the attacker's inside shoulder.
Đường bóng: 8 → 11 → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 8 chuyền cho 11, 11 di chuyển lên phía trước để bước ra đón bóng; Bước 2: 11 dẫn bóng di chuyển, A di chuyển lùi lại để trì hoãn, không vội xoạc, 11 di chuyển sang phải để thoát người kèm; Bước 3: 11 dứt điểm, GK di chuyển sang phải.
Tiếp nối: Một lượt kết thúc khi có cú sút, cướp được bóng hoặc bóng ra ngoài. Bên tấn công về xếp hàng, cặp tiếp theo vào ngay; bên phòng ngự giữ bốn lượt rồi đổi vai.
Luật: The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.
Điểm chính: Tăng tốc và chỉ đổi hướng một lần. Hai động tác giả cho hậu vệ thời gian lấy lại thăng bằng.

mistake.en: Diving in on the first feint — the defender who bites decides the duel for the attacker.
mistake.en-GB: Diving in on the first feint — the defender who bites decides the duel for the attacker.
mistake.zh-CN: 第一个假动作就出脚——扑上去的那一下，替进攻者赢了这次对抗。
mistake.zh-TW: 第一個假動作就出腳——撲上去的那一下，替進攻者贏了這次對抗。
mistake.ja-JP: 最初のフェイントに飛び込む——食いついた守備者が、対決の勝敗を攻撃者に献上する。
mistake.ko-KR: 첫 페인트에 달려든다 — 무는 순간 수비가 공격수 대신 승부를 정해준다.
mistake.es-ES: Tirarse al primer amago: el defensor que pica decide el duelo para el atacante.
mistake.fr-FR: Plonger sur la première feinte — le défenseur qui mord décide le duel pour l'attaquant.
mistake.id-ID: Terpancing gerak tipu pertama.
mistake.ms-MY: Terpedaya dengan tipuan pertama.
mistake.th-TH: พุ่งใส่จังหวะหลอกแรก
mistake.vi-VN: Lao vào cú giả đầu tiên.

note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.

Règles : The attacker scores by putting the ball past the keeper between the posts; the rep ends there, or when the defender wins it, the keeper holds it, or the ball leaves the playing area. Offside is not played.

note.en:
Purpose: Raise the heart rate and sharpen touch before the load comes; it sets the standard the session keeps.
Frequency: Used every session — it opens the training and warms the body and the touch before the work.
Setup: 3 cones in a triangle, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
Equipment: a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
Ball path: A → B → C → D
Sequence: Step 1: A passes to B; Step 2: B passes to C, A, D move back; Step 3: C passes to D, B moves left; Step 4: C follows up behind A.
How it continues: Pass and follow: after your pass, run to the position you passed to and join the back of that line, so the shape rotates by itself; two minutes one way, then reverse the direction.
Coaching point: Every pass into the feet the receiver is turning away from. Speed of ball beats speed of player.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】热身：练球前先把身体活动开、找回球感。热身认真，一整堂课的质量才跟得上。
【频度】热身常用——几乎每堂课的开场，训练前先活动身体、找回球感。
【组织】3 个锥标摆成三角形，间距 8–10 米，一人一锥，第一个锥后面再排一人，一颗球。
【器材】每个站位一个锥标，相邻锥标相距 10–12 米；传给谁就跑到那个锥标排到队尾。
【球路】A → B → C → D
【流程】第1步：A把球传给B；第2步：B把球传给C，A、D向后移动；第3步：C把球传给D，B向左移动；第4步：C跟上去，跑到A身后。
【连贯】传完跟着球跑：传给谁就跑到谁的位置排到队尾，队形自动轮转不停；一个方向转 2 分钟后反方向。
【要点】每一脚都传到接球人转身的反方向那只脚。球速比人速重要。
note.zh-TW:

【連貫】傳完跟著球跑：傳給誰就跑到誰的位置排到隊尾，隊形自動輪轉不停；一個方向轉 2 分鐘後反方向。
【要點】每一腳都傳到接球人轉身的反方向那隻腳。球速比人速重要。
note.ja-JP:

note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Eleva pulsaciones y afina el toque antes de la carga; fija el nivel de la sesión.
Frecuencia: Se usa cada sesión: abre el entrenamiento y calienta cuerpo y toque.
Montaje: 3 cones in a triangle, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
Material: a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
Recorrido del balón: A → B → C → D
Secuencia: Paso 1: A pasa a B; Paso 2: B pasa a C, A, D se desplaza hacia atrás; Paso 3: C pasa a D, B se desplaza a la izquierda; Paso 4: C sube por detrás de A.
Continuidad: Pasa y sigue: tras tu pase corres a la posición a la que pasaste y te pones al final de esa fila, así la figura rota sola; dos minutos en un sentido y luego al contrario.
Punto clave: Siempre al pie contrario al giro del receptor. La velocidad del balón gana a la del jugador.
note.fr-FR:

Mise en place : 3 cones in a triangle, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.

Enchaînement : Passe et suit : après ta passe tu cours vers la position que tu as servie et tu te mets en fin de file, la figure tourne toute seule ; deux minutes dans un sens, puis on inverse.

note.en:
Purpose: Raise the heart rate and sharpen touch before the load comes; it sets the standard the session keeps.
Frequency: Used every session — it opens the training and warms the body and the touch before the work.
Setup: 4 cones in a diamond, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
Equipment: a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
Ball path: A → B → C → D → E
Sequence: Step 1: A passes to B; Step 2: B passes to C, A follows up behind B, E moves back; Step 3: C passes to D, B follows up behind C; Step 4: D passes to E, C follows up behind D; Step 5: D follows up behind A.
How it continues: Pass and follow: after your pass, run to the position you passed to and join the back of that line, so the shape rotates by itself; two minutes one way, then reverse the direction.
Coaching point: Every pass into the feet the receiver is turning away from. Speed of ball beats speed of player.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】热身：练球前先把身体活动开、找回球感。热身认真，一整堂课的质量才跟得上。
【频度】热身常用——几乎每堂课的开场，训练前先活动身体、找回球感。
【组织】4 个锥标摆成菱形，间距 8–10 米，一人一锥，第一个锥后面再排一人，一颗球。
【器材】每个站位一个锥标，相邻锥标相距 10–12 米；传给谁就跑到那个锥标排到队尾。
【球路】A → B → C → D → E
【流程】第1步：A把球传给B；第2步：B把球传给C，A跟上去，跑到B身后，E向后移动；第3步：C把球传给D，B跟上去，跑到C身后；第4步：D把球传给E，C跟上去，跑到D身后；第5步：D跟上去，跑到A身后。
【连贯】传完跟着球跑：传给谁就跑到谁的位置排到队尾，队形自动轮转不停；一个方向转 2 分钟后反方向。
【要点】每一脚都传到接球人转身的反方向那只脚。球速比人速重要。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】熱身：練球前先把身體活動開、找回球感。熱身認真，一整堂課的品質才跟得上。

【器材】每個站位一個錐標，相鄰錐標相距 10–12 米；傳給誰就跑到那個錐標排到隊尾。
【球路】A → B → C → D → E
【流程】第1步：A把球傳給B；第2步：B把球傳給C，A跟上去，跑到B身後，E向後移動；第3步：C把球傳給D，B跟上去，跑到C身後；第4步：D把球傳給E，C跟上去，跑到D身後；第5步：D跟上去，跑到A身後。
【連貫】傳完跟著球跑：傳給誰就跑到誰的位置排到隊尾，隊形自動輪轉不停；一個方向轉 2 分鐘後反方向。
【要點】每一腳都傳到接球人轉身的反方向那隻腳。球速比人速重要。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】負荷が来る前に心拍を上げ、ボールタッチを整える。練習全体の基準を作る。
【頻度】毎回のセッションで使う。練習の入りで、体とタッチを温める。
【準備】4 cones in a diamond, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball。
【用具】a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line。
【ボールの道筋】A → B → C → D → E

【포인트】받는 사람이 도는 반대쪽 발로. 공의 속도가 사람의 속도를 이긴다.

note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Eleva pulsaciones y afina el toque antes de la carga; fija el nivel de la sesión.
Frecuencia: Se usa cada sesión: abre el entrenamiento y calienta cuerpo y toque.
Montaje: 5 cones in a pentagon, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
Material: a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
Recorrido del balón: A → B → C → D → E → F
Secuencia: Paso 1: A pasa a B; Paso 2: B pasa a C, A sube por detrás de B, F se desplaza hacia atrás; Paso 3: C pasa a D, B sube por detrás de C; Paso 4: D pasa a E, C se desplaza a la izquierda; Paso 5: E pasa a F, D se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 6: E sube por detrás de A.
Continuidad: Pasa y sigue: tras tu pase corres a la posición a la que pasaste y te pones al final de esa fila, así la figura rota sola; dos minutos en un sentido y luego al contrario.
Punto clave: Siempre al pie contrario al giro del receptor. La velocidad del balón gana a la del jugador.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Élève le rythme cardiaque et affine la touche avant la charge ; fixe le niveau de la séance.
Fréquence : Utilisé à chaque séance : il ouvre l'entraînement et échauffe le corps et la touche.
Mise en place : 5 cones in a pentagon, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
Matériel : a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
Trajet du ballon : A → B → C → D → E → F
Déroulé : Étape 1 : A passe à B ; Étape 2 : B passe à C, A monte derrière B, F se déplace vers l'arrière ; Étape 3 : C passe à D, B monte derrière C ; Étape 4 : D passe à E, C se déplace à gauche ; Étape 5 : E passe à F, D se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 6 : E monte derrière A.
Enchaînement : Passe et suit : après ta passe tu cours vers la position que tu as servie et tu te mets en fin de file, la figure tourne toute seule ; deux minutes dans un sens, puis on inverse.
Point clé : Toujours sur le pied opposé au tour du receveur. La vitesse du ballon bat celle du joueur.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Menaikkan detak jantung dan menajamkan sentuhan sebelum beban; menetapkan standar sesi.
Frekuensi: Dipakai setiap sesi — membuka latihan dan menghangatkan tubuh dan sentuhan.
Persiapan: 5 cones in a pentagon, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
Perlengkapan: a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
Jalur bola: A → B → C → D → E → F
Urutan: Langkah 1: A mengoper ke B; Langkah 2: B mengoper ke C, A maju di belakang B, F bergerak ke belakang; Langkah 3: C mengoper ke D, B maju di belakang C; Langkah 4: D mengoper ke E, C bergerak ke kiri; Langkah 5: E mengoper ke F, D bergerak ke depan; Langkah 6: E maju di belakang A.
Kelanjutan: Umpan lalu ikuti: setelah mengumpan lari ke posisi yang kamu umpan dan masuk ke belakang barisannya, jadi formasi berputar sendiri; dua menit satu arah, lalu balik arah.
Poin utama: Selalu ke kaki yang berlawanan dengan arah putaran penerima.
note.ms-MY:

Poin utama: Sentiasa ke kaki bertentangan arah pusingan penerima.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: เพิ่มอัตราหัวใจและปรับสัมผัสบอลก่อนโหลดหนัก และตั้งมาตรฐานของการฝึก

การจัด: 5 cones in a pentagon, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball
อุปกรณ์: a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line
เส้นทางบอล: A → B → C → D → E → F
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: A จ่ายให้ B • ขั้นที่ 2: B จ่ายให้ C A ตามขึ้นไปด้านหลังB F ขยับถอยหลัง • ขั้นที่ 3: C จ่ายให้ D B ตามขึ้นไปด้านหลังC • ขั้นที่ 4: D จ่ายให้ E C ขยับไปทางซ้าย • ขั้นที่ 5: E จ่ายให้ F D ขยับไปข้างหน้า • ขั้นที่ 6: E ตามขึ้นไปด้านหลังA

note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Tăng nhịp tim và làm nhạy cảm giác bóng trước khi vào tải; đặt chuẩn cho cả buổi.
Tần suất: Dùng mỗi buổi — mở đầu buổi tập, làm nóng người và cảm giác bóng.
Bố trí: 5 cones in a pentagon, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
Dụng cụ: a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
Đường bóng: A → B → C → D → E → F
Trình tự: Bước 1: A chuyền cho B; Bước 2: B chuyền cho C, A theo lên phía sau B, F di chuyển lùi lại; Bước 3: C chuyền cho D, B theo lên phía sau C; Bước 4: D chuyền cho E, C di chuyển sang trái; Bước 5: E chuyền cho F, D di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 6: E theo lên phía sau A.
Tiếp nối: Chuyền rồi chạy theo: chuyền cho ai thì chạy đến vị trí đó và xếp cuối hàng, đội hình tự xoay; hai phút một chiều rồi đổi chiều.
Điểm chính: Luôn chuyền vào chân ngược hướng xoay của người nhận. Tốc độ bóng hơn tốc độ người.

mistake.es-ES: Correr el dibujo sin escanear: el patrón enseña el pase, mirar lo encuentra en el partido.
mistake.fr-FR: Dérouler la figure sans scanner — le schéma apprend la passe, le regard la trouve en match.
mistake.id-ID: Menjalani pola tanpa memindai sekeliling.
mistake.ms-MY: Menjalankan corak tanpa mengimbas.
mistake.th-TH: วิ่งตามรูปแบบโดยไม่หันมอง
mistake.vi-VN: Chạy đúng hình mà không quan sát.

【준비】6 cones in a hexagon, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
【장비】a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
【볼 경로】A → B → C → D → E → F → G
【진행】1단계: A가 B에게 패스; 2단계: B가 C에게 패스, A가 B 뒤로 따라 들어간다, G는 뒤로 이동; 3단계: C가 D에게 패스, B는 뒤로 이동; 4단계: D가 E에게 패스, C가 D 뒤로 따라 들어간다; 5단계: E가 F에게 패스, D가 E 뒤로 따라 들어간다; 6단계: F가 G에게 패스, E는 앞으로 이동; 7단계: F가 A 뒤로 따라 들어간다.
【이어가기】패스 앤 팔로우: 패스한 뒤 받은 사람의 자리 줄 맨 뒤로 달려가 대형이 저절로 돈다. 한 방향 2분 후 반대 방향.
【포인트】받는 사람이 도는 반대쪽 발로. 공의 속도가 사람의 속도를 이긴다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Eleva pulsaciones y afina el toque antes de la carga; fija el nivel de la sesión.
Frecuencia: Se usa cada sesión: abre el entrenamiento y calienta cuerpo y toque.
Montaje: 6 cones in a hexagon, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
Material: a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
Recorrido del balón: A → B → C → D → E → F → G
Secuencia: Paso 1: A pasa a B; Paso 2: B pasa a C, A sube por detrás de B, G se desplaza hacia atrás; Paso 3: C pasa a D, B se desplaza hacia atrás; Paso 4: D pasa a E, C sube por detrás de D; Paso 5: E pasa a F, D sube por detrás de E; Paso 6: F pasa a G, E se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 7: F sube por detrás de A.
Continuidad: Pasa y sigue: tras tu pase corres a la posición a la que pasaste y te pones al final de esa fila, así la figura rota sola; dos minutos en un sentido y luego al contrario.
Punto clave: Siempre al pie contrario al giro del receptor. La velocidad del balón gana a la del jugador.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Élève le rythme cardiaque et affine la touche avant la charge ; fixe le niveau de la séance.
Fréquence : Utilisé à chaque séance : il ouvre l'entraînement et échauffe le corps et la touche.
Mise en place : 6 cones in a hexagon, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
Matériel : a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
Trajet du ballon : A → B → C → D → E → F → G
Déroulé : Étape 1 : A passe à B ; Étape 2 : B passe à C, A monte derrière B, G se déplace vers l'arrière ; Étape 3 : C passe à D, B se déplace vers l'arrière ; Étape 4 : D passe à E, C monte derrière D ; Étape 5 : E passe à F, D monte derrière E ; Étape 6 : F passe à G, E se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 7 : F monte derrière A.
Enchaînement : Passe et suit : après ta passe tu cours vers la position que tu as servie et tu te mets en fin de file, la figure tourne toute seule ; deux minutes dans un sens, puis on inverse.
Point clé : Toujours sur le pied opposé au tour du receveur. La vitesse du ballon bat celle du joueur.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Menaikkan detak jantung dan menajamkan sentuhan sebelum beban; menetapkan standar sesi.
Frekuensi: Dipakai setiap sesi — membuka latihan dan menghangatkan tubuh dan sentuhan.
Persiapan: 6 cones in a hexagon, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
Perlengkapan: a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
Jalur bola: A → B → C → D → E → F → G
Urutan: Langkah 1: A mengoper ke B; Langkah 2: B mengoper ke C, A maju di belakang B, G bergerak ke belakang; Langkah 3: C mengoper ke D, B bergerak ke belakang; Langkah 4: D mengoper ke E, C maju di belakang D; Langkah 5: E mengoper ke F, D maju di belakang E; Langkah 6: F mengoper ke G, E bergerak ke depan; Langkah 7: F maju di belakang A.
Kelanjutan: Umpan lalu ikuti: setelah mengumpan lari ke posisi yang kamu umpan dan masuk ke belakang barisannya, jadi formasi berputar sendiri; dua menit satu arah, lalu balik arah.
Poin utama: Selalu ke kaki yang berlawanan dengan arah putaran penerima.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Menaikkan degupan jantung dan menajamkan sentuhan sebelum beban; menetapkan piawaian sesi.
Kekerapan: Digunakan setiap sesi — membuka latihan dan memanaskan badan dan sentuhan.
Persediaan: 6 cones in a hexagon, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
Peralatan: a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
Laluan bola: A → B → C → D → E → F → G
Urutan: Langkah 1: A menghantar kepada B; Langkah 2: B menghantar kepada C, A naik di belakang B, G bergerak ke belakang; Langkah 3: C menghantar kepada D, B bergerak ke belakang; Langkah 4: D menghantar kepada E, C naik di belakang D; Langkah 5: E menghantar kepada F, D naik di belakang E; Langkah 6: F menghantar kepada G, E bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 7: F naik di belakang A.
Kesinambungan: Hantar lalu ikut: selepas menghantar, lari ke posisi yang kamu hantar dan masuk ke belakang barisannya, jadi bentuk berputar sendiri; dua minit satu arah, kemudian terbalikkan arah.
Poin utama: Sentiasa ke kaki bertentangan arah pusingan penerima.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: เพิ่มอัตราหัวใจและปรับสัมผัสบอลก่อนโหลดหนัก และตั้งมาตรฐานของการฝึก
ความถี่: ใช้ทุกครั้ง — เปิดการฝึกและอุ่นร่างกายกับสัมผัสก่อนเริ่ม
การจัด: 6 cones in a hexagon, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball
อุปกรณ์: a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line
เส้นทางบอล: A → B → C → D → E → F → G
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: A จ่ายให้ B • ขั้นที่ 2: B จ่ายให้ C A ตามขึ้นไปด้านหลังB G ขยับถอยหลัง • ขั้นที่ 3: C จ่ายให้ D B ขยับถอยหลัง • ขั้นที่ 4: D จ่ายให้ E C ตามขึ้นไปด้านหลังD • ขั้นที่ 5: E จ่ายให้ F D ตามขึ้นไปด้านหลังE • ขั้นที่ 6: F จ่ายให้ G E ขยับไปข้างหน้า • ขั้นที่ 7: F ตามขึ้นไปด้านหลังA
การต่อเนื่อง: ส่งแล้วตาม: ส่งให้ใครก็วิ่งไปต่อท้ายแถวตำแหน่งนั้น รูปแบบจะหมุนไปเอง หมุนทางเดียว 2 นาทีแล้วกลับทิศ
จุดเน้น: จ่ายไปที่เท้าฝั่งตรงข้ามกับทิศที่คนรับจะหมุน ความเร็วบอลชนะความเร็วคน
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Tăng nhịp tim và làm nhạy cảm giác bóng trước khi vào tải; đặt chuẩn cho cả buổi.
Tần suất: Dùng mỗi buổi — mở đầu buổi tập, làm nóng người và cảm giác bóng.
Bố trí: 6 cones in a hexagon, 8–10 m apart, one player on each and a spare behind the first, one ball.
Dụng cụ: a cone at each station of the shape, 10 to 12 m apart; the passer runs to the cone he passed to and joins that line.
Đường bóng: A → B → C → D → E → F → G
Trình tự: Bước 1: A chuyền cho B; Bước 2: B chuyền cho C, A theo lên phía sau B, G di chuyển lùi lại; Bước 3: C chuyền cho D, B di chuyển lùi lại; Bước 4: D chuyền cho E, C theo lên phía sau D; Bước 5: E chuyền cho F, D theo lên phía sau E; Bước 6: F chuyền cho G, E di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 7: F theo lên phía sau A.
Tiếp nối: Chuyền rồi chạy theo: chuyền cho ai thì chạy đến vị trí đó và xếp cuối hàng, đội hình tự xoay; hai phút một chiều rồi đổi chiều.
Điểm chính: Luôn chuyền vào chân ngược hướng xoay của người nhận. Tốc độ bóng hơn tốc độ người.

mistake.en: Running the shape without scanning — patterns teach the pass, the head-check finds it in a game.
mistake.en-GB: Running the shape without scanning — patterns teach the pass, the head-check finds it in a game.
mistake.zh-CN: 只跑图形不观察——图形教你怎么传，比赛里靠回头看才找得到那条线。
mistake.zh-TW: 只跑圖形不觀察——圖形教你怎麼傳，比賽裡靠回頭看才找得到那條線。
mistake.ja-JP: 形をなぞるだけで首を振らない——形はパスを教え、首振りが試合でそれを見つける。
mistake.ko-KR: 고개 확인 없이 모양만 돈다 — 패턴은 패스를 가르치고, 스캔이 경기에서 그것을 찾는다.
mistake.es-ES: Correr el dibujo sin escanear: el patrón enseña el pase, mirar lo encuentra en el partido.
mistake.fr-FR: Dérouler la figure sans scanner — le schéma apprend la passe, le regard la trouve en match.
mistake.id-ID: Menjalani pola tanpa memindai sekeliling.
mistake.ms-MY: Menjalankan corak tanpa mengimbas.
mistake.th-TH: วิ่งตามรูปแบบโดยไม่หันมอง
mistake.vi-VN: Chạy đúng hình mà không quan sát.

note.en:
Purpose: Break a set defence: create and use an overload, commit a defender, and play the pass his movement opens.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week, as the team sharpens how it creates and takes chances.
Setup: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Ball path: 7 → 9 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 carries the ball on the move; Step 2: 7 passes to 9, 9 moves up the board to attack the near post, 10 moves up the board to attack the far post, 8 moves up the board to wait on the edge for the second ball, GK moves up the board; Step 3: 9 shoots.
How it continues: Back to the end of the line when your rep is done and the next player goes; six to eight each, then switch sides or roles.
Coaching point: Look up once before you cross, then hit the space you saw — not the shirt, which has already moved.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】进攻：练怎么打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出来，再传他让出的那条线。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——磨合球队制造和把握机会的方式。
【组织】一个球门带门将，两名中卫；进攻方三人包抄：前点、后点和禁区前沿。
【球路】7 → 9 → 球门
【流程】第1步：7号球员带球推进；第2步：7号球员把球传给9号球员，9号球员向前移动（抢前点），10号球员向前移动（抢后点），8号球员向前移动（在禁区边缘等第二落点），GK向前移动；第3步：9号球员射门。
【连贯】做完一次回到队尾，下一人出发；每人 6–8 次后换边或换角色。
【要点】传中前抬头看一次，然后传你看到的那片空当 —— 别传人，人已经跑掉了。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】進攻：練怎麼打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出來，再傳他讓出的那條線。
【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——磨合球隊製造和把握機會的方式。
【組織】one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge。
【球路】7 → 9 → 球門
【流程】第1步：7號球員帶球推進；第2步：7號球員把球傳給9號球員，9號球員向前移動（搶前點），10號球員向前移動（搶後點），8號球員向前移動（在禁區邊緣等第二落點），GK向前移動；第3步：9號球員射門。
【連貫】做完一次回到隊尾，下一人出發；每人 6–8 次後換邊或換角色。
【要點】傳中前抬頭看一次，然後傳你看到的那片空檔 —— 別傳人，人已經跑掉了。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】整った守備を崩す。数的優位を作って使い、守備者に決断を迫り、その動きが空けたパスを通す。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。チャンスの作り方と決め方を磨く。
【準備】one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge。
【ボールの道筋】7 → 9 → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：7番がボールを運ぶ。ステップ2：7番が9番へパス、9番が前方へ移動し、ニアに飛び込む、10番が前方へ移動し、ファーに飛び込む、8番が前方へ移動し、ペナルティエリア外でこぼれ球を待つ、GKが前方へ移動。ステップ3：9番がシュート。
【続け方】1本終えたら列の最後尾へ戻り、次の選手が出る。1人6〜8本で左右か役割を交代。
【ポイント】上げる前に一度顔を上げ、見えたスペースへ。人は既に動いている。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】정돈된 수비를 깬다. 수적 우위를 만들고 이용하며, 수비수에게 결정을 강요하고 그 움직임이 여는 패스를 넣는다.
【빈도】주 몇 회 진행하는 전술 블록 — 팀이 기회를 만들고 살리는 법을 다듬는다.
【준비】one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
【볼 경로】7 → 9 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 7번가 공을 몰고 이동; 2단계: 7번가 9번에게 패스, 9번는 앞으로 이동해 니어 포스트를 공략한다, 10번는 앞으로 이동해 파 포스트를 공략한다, 8번는 앞으로 이동해 박스 밖에서 세컨드 볼을 기다린다, GK는 앞으로 이동; 3단계: 9번 슛.
【이어가기】한 번 마치면 줄 맨 뒤로 가고 다음 선수가 출발한다. 한 사람당 6~8회 후 방향이나 역할을 바꾼다.
【포인트】올리기 전에 한 번 보고, 본 공간으로 보내라. 사람은 이미 움직였다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana, para afinar cómo crea y aprovecha ocasiones.
Montaje: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Recorrido del balón: 7 → 9 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 7 conduce el balón; Paso 2: 7 pasa a 9, 9 se desplaza hacia delante para atacar el primer palo, 10 se desplaza hacia delante para atacar el segundo palo, 8 se desplaza hacia delante para esperar el rechace en la frontal, GK se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 3: 9 remata.
Continuidad: Al terminar tu repetición vuelves al final de la fila y sale el siguiente; seis a ocho cada uno, luego cambio de lado o de rol.
Punto clave: Levanta la cabeza una vez y centra al espacio que viste, no a la camiseta: ya se movió.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Casser une défense en place : créer et exploiter le surnombre, engager un défenseur et jouer la passe que son mouvement ouvre.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine, pour affiner la création et la finition des occasions.
Mise en place : one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Trajet du ballon : 7 → 9 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 7 conduit le ballon ; Étape 2 : 7 passe à 9, 9 se déplace vers l'avant pour attaquer le premier poteau, 10 se déplace vers l'avant pour attaquer le deuxième poteau, 8 se déplace vers l'avant pour attendre le second ballon à l'entrée de la surface, GK se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 3 : 9 frappe.
Enchaînement : Ta répétition finie, tu retournes en fin de file et le suivant part ; six à huit chacun, puis on change de côté ou de rôle.
Point clé : Lève la tête une fois, puis centre dans l'espace vu — pas sur le maillot, déjà parti.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Membongkar pertahanan yang tersusun: buat dan manfaatkan overload, paksa bek memutuskan, lalu mainkan umpan yang terbuka.
Frekuensi: Blok taktis beberapa kali seminggu, saat tim mengasah cara menciptakan dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persiapan: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Jalur bola: 7 → 9 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 menggiring bola; Langkah 2: 7 mengoper ke 9, 9 bergerak ke depan untuk menyerang tiang dekat, 10 bergerak ke depan untuk menyerang tiang jauh, 8 bergerak ke depan untuk menunggu bola kedua di tepi kotak, GK bergerak ke depan; Langkah 3: 9 menembak.
Kelanjutan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain berikutnya berangkat; enam sampai delapan kali tiap orang, lalu ganti sisi atau peran.
Poin utama: Angkat kepala sekali sebelum menyilang, lalu kirim ke ruang yang kamu lihat.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Memecahkan pertahanan tersusun: cipta dan guna lebihan pemain, paksa bek membuat keputusan, mainkan hantaran yang terbuka.
Kekerapan: Blok taktikal beberapa kali seminggu, ketika pasukan mengasah cara mencipta dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persediaan: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Laluan bola: 7 → 9 → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 membawa bola; Langkah 2: 7 menghantar kepada 9, 9 bergerak ke hadapan untuk menyerang tiang dekat, 10 bergerak ke hadapan untuk menyerang tiang jauh, 8 bergerak ke hadapan untuk menunggu bola kedua di tepi kotak, GK bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 3: 9 menjaring.
Kesinambungan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain seterusnya bermula; enam hingga lapan kali setiap orang, kemudian tukar sisi atau peranan.
Poin utama: Angkat kepala sekali sebelum melambung, kemudian hantar ke ruang.

note.en:
Purpose: Break a set defence: create and use an overload, commit a defender, and play the pass his movement opens.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week, as the team sharpens how it creates and takes chances.
Setup: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Ball path: 7 → 9 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 carries the ball on the move; Step 2: 7 passes to 9, 9 moves up the board to attack the far post, 10 moves up the board to attack the near post, 8 moves up the board to wait on the edge for the second ball, GK moves up the board; Step 3: 9 shoots.
How it continues: Back to the end of the line when your rep is done and the next player goes; six to eight each, then switch sides or roles.
Coaching point: Look up once before you cross, then hit the space you saw — not the shirt, which has already moved.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】进攻：练怎么打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出来，再传他让出的那条线。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——磨合球队制造和把握机会的方式。
【组织】一个球门带门将，两名中卫；进攻方三人包抄：前点、后点和禁区前沿。
【球路】7 → 9 → 球门
【流程】第1步：7号球员带球推进；第2步：7号球员把球传给9号球员，9号球员向前移动（抢后点），10号球员向前移动（抢前点），8号球员向前移动（在禁区边缘等第二落点），GK向前移动；第3步：9号球员射门。
【连贯】做完一次回到队尾，下一人出发；每人 6–8 次后换边或换角色。
【要点】传中前抬头看一次，然后传你看到的那片空当 —— 别传人，人已经跑掉了。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】進攻：練怎麼打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出來，再傳他讓出的那條線。
【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——磨合球隊製造和把握機會的方式。
【組織】one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge。
【球路】7 → 9 → 球門
【流程】第1步：7號球員帶球推進；第2步：7號球員把球傳給9號球員，9號球員向前移動（搶後點），10號球員向前移動（搶前點），8號球員向前移動（在禁區邊緣等第二落點），GK向前移動；第3步：9號球員射門。
【連貫】做完一次回到隊尾，下一人出發；每人 6–8 次後換邊或換角色。
【要點】傳中前抬頭看一次，然後傳你看到的那片空檔 —— 別傳人，人已經跑掉了。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】整った守備を崩す。数的優位を作って使い、守備者に決断を迫り、その動きが空けたパスを通す。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。チャンスの作り方と決め方を磨く。
【準備】one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge。
【ボールの道筋】7 → 9 → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：7番がボールを運ぶ。ステップ2：7番が9番へパス、9番が前方へ移動し、ファーに飛び込む、10番が前方へ移動し、ニアに飛び込む、8番が前方へ移動し、ペナルティエリア外でこぼれ球を待つ、GKが前方へ移動。ステップ3：9番がシュート。
【続け方】1本終えたら列の最後尾へ戻り、次の選手が出る。1人6〜8本で左右か役割を交代。
【ポイント】上げる前に一度顔を上げ、見えたスペースへ。人は既に動いている。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】정돈된 수비를 깬다. 수적 우위를 만들고 이용하며, 수비수에게 결정을 강요하고 그 움직임이 여는 패스를 넣는다.
【빈도】주 몇 회 진행하는 전술 블록 — 팀이 기회를 만들고 살리는 법을 다듬는다.
【준비】one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
【볼 경로】7 → 9 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 7번가 공을 몰고 이동; 2단계: 7번가 9번에게 패스, 9번는 앞으로 이동해 파 포스트를 공략한다, 10번는 앞으로 이동해 니어 포스트를 공략한다, 8번는 앞으로 이동해 박스 밖에서 세컨드 볼을 기다린다, GK는 앞으로 이동; 3단계: 9번 슛.
【이어가기】한 번 마치면 줄 맨 뒤로 가고 다음 선수가 출발한다. 한 사람당 6~8회 후 방향이나 역할을 바꾼다.
【포인트】올리기 전에 한 번 보고, 본 공간으로 보내라. 사람은 이미 움직였다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana, para afinar cómo crea y aprovecha ocasiones.
Montaje: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Recorrido del balón: 7 → 9 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 7 conduce el balón; Paso 2: 7 pasa a 9, 9 se desplaza hacia delante para atacar el segundo palo, 10 se desplaza hacia delante para atacar el primer palo, 8 se desplaza hacia delante para esperar el rechace en la frontal, GK se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 3: 9 remata.
Continuidad: Al terminar tu repetición vuelves al final de la fila y sale el siguiente; seis a ocho cada uno, luego cambio de lado o de rol.
Punto clave: Levanta la cabeza una vez y centra al espacio que viste, no a la camiseta: ya se movió.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Casser une défense en place : créer et exploiter le surnombre, engager un défenseur et jouer la passe que son mouvement ouvre.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine, pour affiner la création et la finition des occasions.
Mise en place : one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Trajet du ballon : 7 → 9 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 7 conduit le ballon ; Étape 2 : 7 passe à 9, 9 se déplace vers l'avant pour attaquer le deuxième poteau, 10 se déplace vers l'avant pour attaquer le premier poteau, 8 se déplace vers l'avant pour attendre le second ballon à l'entrée de la surface, GK se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 3 : 9 frappe.
Enchaînement : Ta répétition finie, tu retournes en fin de file et le suivant part ; six à huit chacun, puis on change de côté ou de rôle.
Point clé : Lève la tête une fois, puis centre dans l'espace vu — pas sur le maillot, déjà parti.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Membongkar pertahanan yang tersusun: buat dan manfaatkan overload, paksa bek memutuskan, lalu mainkan umpan yang terbuka.
Frekuensi: Blok taktis beberapa kali seminggu, saat tim mengasah cara menciptakan dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persiapan: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Jalur bola: 7 → 9 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 menggiring bola; Langkah 2: 7 mengoper ke 9, 9 bergerak ke depan untuk menyerang tiang jauh, 10 bergerak ke depan untuk menyerang tiang dekat, 8 bergerak ke depan untuk menunggu bola kedua di tepi kotak, GK bergerak ke depan; Langkah 3: 9 menembak.
Kelanjutan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain berikutnya berangkat; enam sampai delapan kali tiap orang, lalu ganti sisi atau peran.
Poin utama: Angkat kepala sekali sebelum menyilang, lalu kirim ke ruang yang kamu lihat.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Memecahkan pertahanan tersusun: cipta dan guna lebihan pemain, paksa bek membuat keputusan, mainkan hantaran yang terbuka.
Kekerapan: Blok taktikal beberapa kali seminggu, ketika pasukan mengasah cara mencipta dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persediaan: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Laluan bola: 7 → 9 → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 membawa bola; Langkah 2: 7 menghantar kepada 9, 9 bergerak ke hadapan untuk menyerang tiang jauh, 10 bergerak ke hadapan untuk menyerang tiang dekat, 8 bergerak ke hadapan untuk menunggu bola kedua di tepi kotak, GK bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 3: 9 menjaring.
Kesinambungan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain seterusnya bermula; enam hingga lapan kali setiap orang, kemudian tukar sisi atau peranan.
Poin utama: Angkat kepala sekali sebelum melambung, kemudian hantar ke ruang.

note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana, para afinar cómo crea y aprovecha ocasiones.
Montaje: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Recorrido del balón: 7 → 9 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 7 conduce el balón; Paso 2: 7 pasa a 9, 9 se desplaza hacia delante para atacar el primer palo, 10 se desplaza hacia delante para atacar el segundo palo, 8 se desplaza hacia delante para esperar el rechace en la frontal, GK se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 3: 9 remata.
Continuidad: Al terminar tu repetición vuelves al final de la fila y sale el siguiente; seis a ocho cada uno, luego cambio de lado o de rol.
Punto clave: Levanta la cabeza una vez y centra al espacio que viste, no a la camiseta: ya se movió.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Casser une défense en place : créer et exploiter le surnombre, engager un défenseur et jouer la passe que son mouvement ouvre.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine, pour affiner la création et la finition des occasions.
Mise en place : one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Trajet du ballon : 7 → 9 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 7 conduit le ballon ; Étape 2 : 7 passe à 9, 9 se déplace vers l'avant pour attaquer le premier poteau, 10 se déplace vers l'avant pour attaquer le deuxième poteau, 8 se déplace vers l'avant pour attendre le second ballon à l'entrée de la surface, GK se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 3 : 9 frappe.
Enchaînement : Ta répétition finie, tu retournes en fin de file et le suivant part ; six à huit chacun, puis on change de côté ou de rôle.
Point clé : Lève la tête une fois, puis centre dans l'espace vu — pas sur le maillot, déjà parti.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Membongkar pertahanan yang tersusun: buat dan manfaatkan overload, paksa bek memutuskan, lalu mainkan umpan yang terbuka.
Frekuensi: Blok taktis beberapa kali seminggu, saat tim mengasah cara menciptakan dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persiapan: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Jalur bola: 7 → 9 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 menggiring bola; Langkah 2: 7 mengoper ke 9, 9 bergerak ke depan untuk menyerang tiang dekat, 10 bergerak ke depan untuk menyerang tiang jauh, 8 bergerak ke depan untuk menunggu bola kedua di tepi kotak, GK bergerak ke depan; Langkah 3: 9 menembak.
Kelanjutan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain berikutnya berangkat; enam sampai delapan kali tiap orang, lalu ganti sisi atau peran.
Poin utama: Angkat kepala sekali sebelum menyilang, lalu kirim ke ruang yang kamu lihat.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Memecahkan pertahanan tersusun: cipta dan guna lebihan pemain, paksa bek membuat keputusan, mainkan hantaran yang terbuka.
Kekerapan: Blok taktikal beberapa kali seminggu, ketika pasukan mengasah cara mencipta dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persediaan: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Laluan bola: 7 → 9 → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 membawa bola; Langkah 2: 7 menghantar kepada 9, 9 bergerak ke hadapan untuk menyerang tiang dekat, 10 bergerak ke hadapan untuk menyerang tiang jauh, 8 bergerak ke hadapan untuk menunggu bola kedua di tepi kotak, GK bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 3: 9 menjaring.
Kesinambungan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain seterusnya bermula; enam hingga lapan kali setiap orang, kemudian tukar sisi atau peranan.
Poin utama: Angkat kepala sekali sebelum melambung, kemudian hantar ke ruang.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: เจาะแนวรับที่ตั้งรับ: สร้างและใช้ความได้เปรียบจำนวน บังคับกองหลังให้ตัดสินใจ แล้วจ่ายบอลที่เปิดออก
ความถี่: บล็อกแทคติกสัปดาห์ละไม่กี่ครั้ง เพื่อฝึกการสร้างและใช้โอกาส
การจัด: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge
เส้นทางบอล: 7 → 9 → ประตู
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: 7 พาบอลไป • ขั้นที่ 2: 7 จ่ายให้ 9 9 ขยับไปข้างหน้าเพื่อวิ่งเข้าเสาแรก 10 ขยับไปข้างหน้าเพื่อวิ่งเข้าเสาสอง 8 ขยับไปข้างหน้าเพื่อรอบอลสองที่หน้าเขตโทษ GK ขยับไปข้างหน้า • ขั้นที่ 3: 9 ยิงประตู
การต่อเนื่อง: ทำเสร็จหนึ่งรอบกลับไปต่อท้ายแถว คนถัดไปออกตัว คนละ 6–8 รอบแล้วสลับข้างหรือสลับหน้าที่
จุดเน้น: เงยหน้าหนึ่งครั้งก่อนครอส แล้วส่งไปยังพื้นที่ที่เห็น ไม่ใช่ที่ตัวคน
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Phá vỡ hàng thủ đã dựng: tạo và tận dụng hơn người, buộc hậu vệ quyết định, rồi chuyền vào khoảng trống mở ra.
Tần suất: Khối chiến thuật tập vài lần mỗi tuần, để đội mài giũa cách tạo và tận dụng cơ hội.
Bố trí: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Đường bóng: 7 → 9 → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 7 dẫn bóng di chuyển; Bước 2: 7 chuyền cho 9, 9 di chuyển lên phía trước để băng vào cột gần, 10 di chuyển lên phía trước để băng vào cột xa, 8 di chuyển lên phía trước để chờ bóng hai ở rìa vòng cấm, GK di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 3: 9 dứt điểm.
Tiếp nối: Xong lượt của mình thì về cuối hàng, người tiếp theo xuất phát; mỗi người 6–8 lượt rồi đổi bên hoặc đổi vai.
Điểm chính: Ngẩng đầu một lần trước khi tạt, rồi đưa bóng vào khoảng trống đã thấy.

note.en:
Purpose: Break a set defence: create and use an overload, commit a defender, and play the pass his movement opens.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week, as the team sharpens how it creates and takes chances.
Setup: one goal with a keeper, two centre-backs and a three-man box: near post, far post and the edge.
Ball path: 7 → 9 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 carries the ball on the move; Step 2: 7 passes to 9, 9 moves up the board to attack the far post, 10 moves up the board to attack the near post, 8 moves up the board to wait on the edge for the second ball, GK moves up the board; Step 3: 9 shoots.
How it continues: Back to the end of the line when your rep is done and the next player goes; six to eight each, then switch sides or roles.
Coaching point: Look up once before you cross, then hit the space you saw — not the shirt, which has already moved.

note.en:
Purpose: Deny space as a unit — the whole line shifts with the ball, closes the pass on either side of the presser, and covers behind.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week — defensive shape is drilled regularly because it is the habit a match tests most.
Setup: a back four with a midfield three ten metres in front of it, against two who move the ball across.
Ball path: 10 → 9
Sequence: Step 1: 10 carries the ball on the move, 6, 7, 8 move right; Step 2: 10 passes to 9, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9 move right.
How it continues: Getting the ball over halfway counts as a success; a turnover or the ball out counts for the pressers. Either way it goes back to the keeper and starts again; six reps, then the sides swap.
Rules: The defence scores by keeping the ball in front of the line and winning it; the attack scores by playing a pass that goes behind the last defender with a runner onto it.
Coaching point: Move as the ball travels, not when it arrives. The distance between your lines matters more than where the lines are.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】防守：练整条线一起动。球到哪边就往哪边压，上抢的人两侧有人封传球线，身后有人保护。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——防守站位要常练，因为它是比赛最常考验的习惯。
【组织】四后卫加身前十米的三中场，对方两人来回倒球。
【球路】10 → 9
【流程】第1步：10号球员带球推进，6号球员、7号球员、8号球员向右移动；第2步：10号球员把球传给9号球员，2号球员、3号球员、4号球员、5号球员、9号球员向右移动。
【连贯】球过中线算出球成功，被断或出界算压迫方得分；无论哪种，球回门将重新开始，连做 6 次后攻守互换。
【规则】防守方把球挡在防线之前并断下算一分；进攻方传出一脚越过最后一名防守者、且有人跟上算一分。
【要点】球在飞的时候就动，不是等它落地。两条线之间的距离，比线站在哪儿更重要。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】防守：練整條線一起動。球到哪邊就往哪邊壓，上搶的人兩側有人封傳球線，身後有人保護。
【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——防守站位要常練，因為它是比賽最常考驗的習慣。
【組織】a back four with a midfield three ten metres in front of it, against two who move the ball across。
【球路】10 → 9
【流程】第1步：10號球員帶球推進，6號球員、7號球員、8號球員向右移動；第2步：10號球員把球傳給9號球員，2號球員、3號球員、4號球員、5號球員、9號球員向右移動。
【連貫】球過中線算出球成功，被斷或出界算壓迫方得分；無論哪種，球回門將重新開始，連做 6 次後攻守互換。
【規則】防守方把球擋在防線之前並斷下算一分；進攻方傳出一腳越過最後一名防守者、且有人跟上算一分。
【要點】球在飛的時候就動，不是等它落地。兩條線之間的距離，比線站在哪兒更重要。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】組織として空間を消す。ラインが球に合わせてスライドし、プレスした選手の両脇のパスを封じ、背後をカバーする。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。守備の形は試合が最も試す習慣なので、定期的に反復する。
【準備】a back four with a midfield three ten metres in front of it, against two who move the ball across。
【ボールの道筋】10 → 9
【流れ】ステップ1：10番がボールを運ぶ、6番・7番・8番が右へ移動。ステップ2：10番が9番へパス、2番・3番・4番・5番・9番が右へ移動。
【続け方】ハーフウェーを越えれば成功、奪われるかアウトならプレス側の得点。どちらでもキーパーに戻して再開。6本で攻守交代。
【ルール】The defence scores by keeping the ball in front of the line and winning it; the attack scores by playing a pass that goes behind the last defender with a runner onto it.
【ポイント】ボールが動いている間に動く。ライン間の距離こそが、ラインの位置より重要。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】조직적으로 공간을 지운다. 라인 전체가 공을 따라 이동하고, 압박한 선수 양옆의 패스를 막고, 뒤를 커버한다.
【빈도】주 몇 회의 전술 블록 — 수비 형태는 경기가 가장 자주 시험하는 습관이라 정기적으로 훈련한다.
【준비】a back four with a midfield three ten metres in front of it, against two who move the ball across.
【볼 경로】10 → 9
【진행】1단계: 10번가 공을 몰고 이동, 6번, 7번, 8번는 오른쪽으로 이동; 2단계: 10번가 9번에게 패스, 2번, 3번, 4번, 5번, 9번는 오른쪽으로 이동.
【이어가기】하프라인을 넘기면 성공, 빼앗기거나 아웃되면 압박하는 쪽의 득점이다. 어느 쪽이든 공은 골키퍼에게 돌아가 다시 시작한다. 6회 후 공수 교대.
【규칙】The defence scores by keeping the ball in front of the line and winning it; the attack scores by playing a pass that goes behind the last defender with a runner onto it.
【포인트】공이 이동하는 동안 움직여라. 라인 간 간격이 라인의 위치보다 중요하다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Negar el espacio como bloque: la línea bascula con el balón, cierra el pase a ambos lados del que presiona y cubre por detrás.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana: la estructura defensiva se ensaya a menudo porque es lo que más pone a prueba el partido.
Montaje: a back four with a midfield three ten metres in front of it, against two who move the ball across.
Recorrido del balón: 10 → 9
Secuencia: Paso 1: 10 conduce el balón, 6, 7, 8 se desplaza a la derecha; Paso 2: 10 pasa a 9, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9 se desplaza a la derecha.
Continuidad: Superar el medio campo es un éxito; una pérdida o el balón fuera puntúa para los presionadores. En ambos casos vuelve al portero y se reinicia; seis repeticiones y cambio de roles.
Reglas: The defence scores by keeping the ball in front of the line and winning it; the attack scores by playing a pass that goes behind the last defender with a runner onto it.
Punto clave: Muévete mientras viaja el balón. La distancia entre líneas importa más que dónde están.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Refuser l'espace en bloc : la ligne coulisse avec le ballon, ferme la passe de chaque côté du presseur et couvre derrière.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine : la structure défensive se travaille souvent, car c'est l'habitude que le match teste le plus.
Mise en place : a back four with a midfield three ten metres in front of it, against two who move the ball across.
Trajet du ballon : 10 → 9
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 10 conduit le ballon, 6, 7, 8 se déplace à droite ; Étape 2 : 10 passe à 9, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9 se déplace à droite.
Enchaînement : Passer la ligne médiane, c'est réussi ; une perte ou une sortie, c'est un point pour le pressing. Dans les deux cas retour au gardien et on repart ; six fois, puis on inverse les rôles.
Règles : The defence scores by keeping the ball in front of the line and winning it; the attack scores by playing a pass that goes behind the last defender with a runner onto it.
Point clé : Bouge pendant le trajet du ballon. La distance entre les lignes compte plus que leur position.
note.id-ID:

Frekuensi: Blok taktis beberapa kali seminggu — bentuk bertahan dilatih rutin karena itu kebiasaan yang paling diuji pertandingan.
Persiapan: a back four with a midfield three ten metres in front of it, against two who move the ball across.

Kelanjutan: Bola melewati garis tengah berarti berhasil; bola direbut atau keluar berarti poin untuk penekan. Apa pun hasilnya bola kembali ke kiper dan mulai lagi; enam ulangan, lalu tukar peran.
Aturan: The defence scores by keeping the ball in front of the line and winning it; the attack scores by playing a pass that goes behind the last defender with a runner onto it.
Poin utama: Bergerak saat bola melaju, bukan saat tiba. Jarak antarlini lebih penting dari posisinya.

note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Bịt không gian như một khối — cả tuyến dịch theo bóng, chặn đường chuyền hai bên người áp sát, và bọc lót phía sau.

Trình tự: Bước 1: 10 dẫn bóng di chuyển, 6, 7, 8 di chuyển sang phải; Bước 2: 10 chuyền cho 9, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9 di chuyển sang phải.

note.en:
Purpose: Deny space as a unit — the whole line shifts with the ball, closes the pass on either side of the presser, and covers behind.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week — defensive shape is drilled regularly because it is the habit a match tests most.
Setup: a back four with a midfield three ten metres in front of it, against two who move the ball across.
Ball path: 10 → 9
Sequence: Step 1: 10 carries the ball on the move, 6, 7, 8 move right; Step 2: 10 passes to 9, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9 move right.
How it continues: Getting the ball over halfway counts as a success; a turnover or the ball out counts for the pressers. Either way it goes back to the keeper and starts again; six reps, then the sides swap.
Rules: The defence scores by keeping the ball in front of the line and winning it; the attack scores by playing a pass that goes behind the last defender with a runner onto it.
Coaching point: Move as the ball travels, not when it arrives. The distance between your lines matters more than where the lines are.
