note.zh-CN:
【目的】进攻：练怎么打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出来，再传他让出的那条线。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——磨合球队制造和把握机会的方式。
【组织】进攻半场一条边路通道，三打一，一颗球。
【球路】7 → 10 → 7 → 球门
【流程】第1步：7号球员把球传给10号球员；第2步：10号球员把球传给7号球员，7号球员、2号球员、A向前移动；第3步：7号球员带球推进；第4步：7号球员射门。
【连贯】一次配合完成后球回到起点，所有人顺时针换一个位置，每人轮到每个角色；做 8 次后镜像到另一侧。
【要点】三个人、每人两脚、必须有一个人跑到球的前面去。没人越过球，那就只是传球练习，不是足球。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】進攻：練怎麼打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出來，再傳他讓出的那條線。
【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——磨合球隊製造和把握機會的方式。
【組織】a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball。
【球路】7 → 10 → 7 → 球門
【流程】第1步：7號球員把球傳給10號球員；第2步：10號球員把球傳給7號球員，7號球員、2號球員、A向前移動；第3步：7號球員帶球推進；第4步：7號球員射門。
【連貫】一次配合完成後球回到起點，所有人順時針換一個位置，每人輪到每個角色；做 8 次後鏡像到另一側。
【要點】三個人、每人兩腳、必須有一個人跑到球的前面去。沒人越過球，那就只是傳球練習，不是足球。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】整った守備を崩す。数的優位を作って使い、守備者に決断を迫り、その動きが空けたパスを通す。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。チャンスの作り方と決め方を磨く。
【準備】a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball。
【ボールの道筋】7 → 10 → 7 → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：7番が10番へパス。ステップ2：10番が7番へパス、7番・2番・Aが前方へ移動。ステップ3：7番がボールを運ぶ。ステップ4：7番がシュート。
【続け方】1回終えたらボールをスタートに戻し、全員が1つずつ位置をずらして全役割を回る。8回やったら逆サイドで鏡写しに。
【ポイント】3人、各2タッチ、1人はボールを追い越す。誰も越えなければ、それはパス練習でサッカーではない。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】정돈된 수비를 깬다. 수적 우위를 만들고 이용하며, 수비수에게 결정을 강요하고 그 움직임이 여는 패스를 넣는다.
【빈도】주 몇 회 진행하는 전술 블록 — 팀이 기회를 만들고 살리는 법을 다듬는다.
【준비】a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
【볼 경로】7 → 10 → 7 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 7번가 10번에게 패스; 2단계: 10번가 7번에게 패스, 7번, 2번, A는 앞으로 이동; 3단계: 7번가 공을 몰고 이동; 4단계: 7번 슛.
【이어가기】한 번 끝나면 공은 출발점으로 돌아가고 모두 한 자리씩 이동해 모든 역할을 거친다. 8회 후 반대쪽으로 거울처럼 바꾼다.
【포인트】세 명, 각 두 번 터치, 한 명은 공을 앞질러 달린다. 아무도 앞서지 않으면 그건 패스 연습이다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana, para afinar cómo crea y aprovecha ocasiones.
Montaje: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Recorrido del balón: 7 → 10 → 7 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 7 pasa a 10; Paso 2: 10 pasa a 7, 7, 2, A se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 3: 7 conduce el balón; Paso 4: 7 remata.
Continuidad: Terminado el patrón, el balón vuelve al inicio y todos rotan una posición, así cada uno pasa por cada papel; ocho veces y luego en espejo hacia el otro lado.
Punto clave: Tres jugadores, dos toques, uno que rebasa el balón. Si nadie lo rebasa, es un rondo, no fútbol.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Casser une défense en place : créer et exploiter le surnombre, engager un défenseur et jouer la passe que son mouvement ouvre.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine, pour affiner la création et la finition des occasions.
Mise en place : a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Trajet du ballon : 7 → 10 → 7 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 7 passe à 10 ; Étape 2 : 10 passe à 7, 7, 2, A se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 3 : 7 conduit le ballon ; Étape 4 : 7 frappe.
Enchaînement : Le schéma terminé, le ballon revient au départ et chacun avance d'une position pour tenir tous les rôles ; huit passages, puis en miroir de l'autre côté.
Point clé : Trois joueurs, deux touches, un qui dépasse le ballon. Sinon c'est de la passe, pas du football.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Membongkar pertahanan yang tersusun: buat dan manfaatkan overload, paksa bek memutuskan, lalu mainkan umpan yang terbuka.
Frekuensi: Blok taktis beberapa kali seminggu, saat tim mengasah cara menciptakan dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persiapan: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Jalur bola: 7 → 10 → 7 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 mengoper ke 10; Langkah 2: 10 mengoper ke 7, 7, 2, A bergerak ke depan; Langkah 3: 7 menggiring bola; Langkah 4: 7 menembak.
Kelanjutan: Setelah pola selesai bola kembali ke awal dan semua bergeser satu posisi agar tiap pemain mencoba setiap peran; delapan kali, lalu cerminkan ke sisi lain.
Poin utama: Tiga pemain, dua sentuhan, satu berlari melewati bola.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Memecahkan pertahanan tersusun: cipta dan guna lebihan pemain, paksa bek membuat keputusan, mainkan hantaran yang terbuka.
Kekerapan: Blok taktikal beberapa kali seminggu, ketika pasukan mengasah cara mencipta dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persediaan: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Laluan bola: 7 → 10 → 7 → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 menghantar kepada 10; Langkah 2: 10 menghantar kepada 7, 7, 2, A bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 3: 7 membawa bola; Langkah 4: 7 menjaring.
Kesinambungan: Selepas corak selesai bola kembali ke permulaan dan semua beralih satu posisi supaya setiap pemain mencuba setiap peranan; lapan kali, kemudian cerminkan ke sisi lain.
Poin utama: Tiga pemain, dua sentuhan, seorang berlari melepasi bola.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: เจาะแนวรับที่ตั้งรับ: สร้างและใช้ความได้เปรียบจำนวน บังคับกองหลังให้ตัดสินใจ แล้วจ่ายบอลที่เปิดออก
ความถี่: บล็อกแทคติกสัปดาห์ละไม่กี่ครั้ง เพื่อฝึกการสร้างและใช้โอกาส
การจัด: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball
เส้นทางบอล: 7 → 10 → 7 → ประตู
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: 7 จ่ายให้ 10 • ขั้นที่ 2: 10 จ่ายให้ 7 7, 2, A ขยับไปข้างหน้า • ขั้นที่ 3: 7 พาบอลไป • ขั้นที่ 4: 7 ยิงประตู
การต่อเนื่อง: จบหนึ่งแพตเทิร์นบอลกลับไปจุดเริ่ม ทุกคนขยับไปหนึ่งตำแหน่งเพื่อให้ได้เล่นทุกบทบาท ทำ 8 รอบแล้วสลับไปอีกฝั่งแบบกระจก
จุดเน้น: สามคน คนละสองแตะ และต้องมีคนวิ่งแซงบอล ถ้าไม่มีก็เป็นแค่การฝึกจ่าย
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Phá vỡ hàng thủ đã dựng: tạo và tận dụng hơn người, buộc hậu vệ quyết định, rồi chuyền vào khoảng trống mở ra.
Tần suất: Khối chiến thuật tập vài lần mỗi tuần, để đội mài giũa cách tạo và tận dụng cơ hội.
Bố trí: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Đường bóng: 7 → 10 → 7 → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 7 chuyền cho 10; Bước 2: 10 chuyền cho 7, 7, 2, A di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 3: 7 dẫn bóng di chuyển; Bước 4: 7 dứt điểm.
Tiếp nối: Xong một bài phối hợp, bóng về điểm xuất phát và mọi người dịch một vị trí để ai cũng qua từng vai; làm 8 lần rồi đổi sang bên kia theo kiểu đối xứng.
Điểm chính: Ba người, mỗi người hai chạm, một người chạy vượt bóng.

mistake.en: Both players improvising — a wall pass where neither knows who runs is a turnover with extra steps.
mistake.en-GB: Both players improvising — a wall pass where neither knows who runs is a turnover with extra steps.
mistake.zh-CN: 两个人都在即兴——谁也不知道谁跑的撞墙配合，就是绕了个弯的丢球。
mistake.zh-TW: 兩個人都在即興——誰也不知道誰跑的撞牆配合，就是繞了個彎的丟球。
mistake.ja-JP: 2人とも即興——誰が走るか決まっていないワンツーは、回り道のロストだ。
mistake.ko-KR: 둘 다 즉흥 — 누가 뛰는지 모르는 원투는 돌아가는 턴오버다.
mistake.es-ES: Los dos improvisan: una pared sin saber quién corre es una pérdida con pasos de más.
mistake.fr-FR: Les deux improvisent — un une-deux sans savoir qui court est une perte déguisée.
mistake.id-ID: Keduanya berimprovisasi.
mistake.ms-MY: Kedua-duanya improvisasi.
mistake.th-TH: ต่างคนต่างด้น ไม่รู้ใครวิ่ง
mistake.vi-VN: Cả hai cùng ứng biến — chẳng ai biết ai chạy.

note.en:
Purpose: Break a set defence: create and use an overload, commit a defender, and play the pass his movement opens.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week, as the team sharpens how it creates and takes chances.
Setup: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Ball path: 7 → 10 → 7 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 passes to 10; Step 2: 10 passes to 7, 7, 2, A move up the board; Step 3: 7 carries the ball on the move; Step 4: 7 shoots.
How it continues: When the pattern is done the ball goes back to the start and everyone moves round one position, so each player takes every part; eight runs, then mirror it to the other side.
Coaching point: Three players, two touches each, one runner beyond the ball. If nobody runs past it, it is passing practice, not football.

note.en:
Purpose: Break a set defence: create and use an overload, commit a defender, and play the pass his movement opens.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week, as the team sharpens how it creates and takes chances.
Setup: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Ball path: 7 → 10 → 2 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 passes to 10, 7, 10, 2 move up the board; Step 2: 10 passes to 2, A moves up the board; Step 3: 2 carries the ball on the move; Step 4: 2 shoots.
How it continues: When the pattern is done the ball goes back to the start and everyone moves round one position, so each player takes every part; eight runs, then mirror it to the other side.
Coaching point: Three players, two touches each, one runner beyond the ball. If nobody runs past it, it is passing practice, not football.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】进攻：练怎么打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出来，再传他让出的那条线。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——磨合球队制造和把握机会的方式。
【组织】进攻半场一条边路通道，三打一，一颗球。
【球路】7 → 10 → 2 → 球门
【流程】第1步：7号球员把球传给10号球员，7号球员、10号球员、2号球员向前移动；第2步：10号球员把球传给2号球员，A向前移动；第3步：2号球员带球推进；第4步：2号球员射门。
【连贯】一次配合完成后球回到起点，所有人顺时针换一个位置，每人轮到每个角色；做 8 次后镜像到另一侧。
【要点】三个人、每人两脚、必须有一个人跑到球的前面去。没人越过球，那就只是传球练习，不是足球。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】進攻：練怎麼打穿站好位的防守。做出以多打少，把防守人引出來，再傳他讓出的那條線。
【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——磨合球隊製造和把握機會的方式。
【組織】a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball。
【球路】7 → 10 → 2 → 球門
【流程】第1步：7號球員把球傳給10號球員，7號球員、10號球員、2號球員向前移動；第2步：10號球員把球傳給2號球員，A向前移動；第3步：2號球員帶球推進；第4步：2號球員射門。
【連貫】一次配合完成後球回到起點，所有人順時針換一個位置，每人輪到每個角色；做 8 次後鏡像到另一側。
【要點】三個人、每人兩腳、必須有一個人跑到球的前面去。沒人越過球，那就只是傳球練習，不是足球。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】整った守備を崩す。数的優位を作って使い、守備者に決断を迫り、その動きが空けたパスを通す。
【頻度】週に数回の戦術ブロック。チャンスの作り方と決め方を磨く。
【準備】a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball。
【ボールの道筋】7 → 10 → 2 → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：7番が10番へパス、7番・10番・2番が前方へ移動。ステップ2：10番が2番へパス、Aが前方へ移動。ステップ3：2番がボールを運ぶ。ステップ4：2番がシュート。
【続け方】1回終えたらボールをスタートに戻し、全員が1つずつ位置をずらして全役割を回る。8回やったら逆サイドで鏡写しに。
【ポイント】3人、各2タッチ、1人はボールを追い越す。誰も越えなければ、それはパス練習でサッカーではない。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】정돈된 수비를 깬다. 수적 우위를 만들고 이용하며, 수비수에게 결정을 강요하고 그 움직임이 여는 패스를 넣는다.
【빈도】주 몇 회 진행하는 전술 블록 — 팀이 기회를 만들고 살리는 법을 다듬는다.
【준비】a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
【볼 경로】7 → 10 → 2 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 7번가 10번에게 패스, 7번, 10번, 2번는 앞으로 이동; 2단계: 10번가 2번에게 패스, A는 앞으로 이동; 3단계: 2번가 공을 몰고 이동; 4단계: 2번 슛.
【이어가기】한 번 끝나면 공은 출발점으로 돌아가고 모두 한 자리씩 이동해 모든 역할을 거친다. 8회 후 반대쪽으로 거울처럼 바꾼다.
【포인트】세 명, 각 두 번 터치, 한 명은 공을 앞질러 달린다. 아무도 앞서지 않으면 그건 패스 연습이다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana, para afinar cómo crea y aprovecha ocasiones.
Montaje: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Recorrido del balón: 7 → 10 → 2 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 7 pasa a 10, 7, 10, 2 se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 2: 10 pasa a 2, A se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 3: 2 conduce el balón; Paso 4: 2 remata.
Continuidad: Terminado el patrón, el balón vuelve al inicio y todos rotan una posición, así cada uno pasa por cada papel; ocho veces y luego en espejo hacia el otro lado.
Punto clave: Tres jugadores, dos toques, uno que rebasa el balón. Si nadie lo rebasa, es un rondo, no fútbol.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Casser une défense en place : créer et exploiter le surnombre, engager un défenseur et jouer la passe que son mouvement ouvre.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine, pour affiner la création et la finition des occasions.
Mise en place : a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Trajet du ballon : 7 → 10 → 2 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 7 passe à 10, 7, 10, 2 se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 2 : 10 passe à 2, A se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 3 : 2 conduit le ballon ; Étape 4 : 2 frappe.
Enchaînement : Le schéma terminé, le ballon revient au départ et chacun avance d'une position pour tenir tous les rôles ; huit passages, puis en miroir de l'autre côté.
Point clé : Trois joueurs, deux touches, un qui dépasse le ballon. Sinon c'est de la passe, pas du football.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Membongkar pertahanan yang tersusun: buat dan manfaatkan overload, paksa bek memutuskan, lalu mainkan umpan yang terbuka.
Frekuensi: Blok taktis beberapa kali seminggu, saat tim mengasah cara menciptakan dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persiapan: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Jalur bola: 7 → 10 → 2 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 mengoper ke 10, 7, 10, 2 bergerak ke depan; Langkah 2: 10 mengoper ke 2, A bergerak ke depan; Langkah 3: 2 menggiring bola; Langkah 4: 2 menembak.
Kelanjutan: Setelah pola selesai bola kembali ke awal dan semua bergeser satu posisi agar tiap pemain mencoba setiap peran; delapan kali, lalu cerminkan ke sisi lain.
Poin utama: Tiga pemain, dua sentuhan, satu berlari melewati bola.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Memecahkan pertahanan tersusun: cipta dan guna lebihan pemain, paksa bek membuat keputusan, mainkan hantaran yang terbuka.
Kekerapan: Blok taktikal beberapa kali seminggu, ketika pasukan mengasah cara mencipta dan memanfaatkan peluang.
Persediaan: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Laluan bola: 7 → 10 → 2 → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 7 menghantar kepada 10, 7, 10, 2 bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 2: 10 menghantar kepada 2, A bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 3: 2 membawa bola; Langkah 4: 2 menjaring.
Kesinambungan: Selepas corak selesai bola kembali ke permulaan dan semua beralih satu posisi supaya setiap pemain mencuba setiap peranan; lapan kali, kemudian cerminkan ke sisi lain.
Poin utama: Tiga pemain, dua sentuhan, seorang berlari melepasi bola.

Objetivo: Romper una defensa colocada: crea y usa la superioridad, obliga al defensa a decidir y juega el pase que abre su movimiento.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana, para afinar cómo crea y aprovecha ocasiones.
Montaje: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Recorrido del balón: 7 → 10 → 2 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 7 pasa a 10, 7, 10, 2 se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 2: 10 pasa a 2, A se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 3: 2 conduce el balón; Paso 4: 2 remata.
Continuidad: Terminado el patrón, el balón vuelve al inicio y todos rotan una posición, así cada uno pasa por cada papel; ocho veces y luego en espejo hacia el otro lado.
Punto clave: Tres jugadores, dos toques, uno que rebasa el balón. Si nadie lo rebasa, es un rondo, no fútbol.

Objectif : Casser une défense en place : créer et exploiter le surnombre, engager un défenseur et jouer la passe que son mouvement ouvre.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine, pour affiner la création et la finition des occasions.
Mise en place : a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Trajet du ballon : 7 → 10 → 2 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 7 passe à 10, 7, 10, 2 se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 2 : 10 passe à 2, A se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 3 : 2 conduit le ballon ; Étape 4 : 2 frappe.
Enchaînement : Le schéma terminé, le ballon revient au départ et chacun avance d'une position pour tenir tous les rôles ; huit passages, puis en miroir de l'autre côté.
Point clé : Trois joueurs, deux touches, un qui dépasse le ballon. Sinon c'est de la passe, pas du football.

Poin utama: Tiga pemain, dua sentuhan, satu berlari melewati bola.

Bố trí: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Đường bóng: 7 → 10 → 2 → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 7 chuyền cho 10, 7, 10, 2 di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 2: 10 chuyền cho 2, A di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 3: 2 dẫn bóng di chuyển; Bước 4: 2 dứt điểm.

note.en:
Purpose: Break a set defence: create and use an overload, commit a defender, and play the pass his movement opens.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week, as the team sharpens how it creates and takes chances.
Setup: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Ball path: 7 → 10 → 2 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 passes to 10, 7, 2 move up the board; Step 2: 10 passes to 2, A moves up the board; Step 3: 2 carries the ball on the move; Step 4: 2 shoots.
How it continues: When the pattern is done the ball goes back to the start and everyone moves round one position, so each player takes every part; eight runs, then mirror it to the other side.
Coaching point: Three players, two touches each, one runner beyond the ball. If nobody runs past it, it is passing practice, not football.

การต่อเนื่อง: จบหนึ่งแพตเทิร์นบอลกลับไปจุดเริ่ม ทุกคนขยับไปหนึ่งตำแหน่งเพื่อให้ได้เล่นทุกบทบาท ทำ 8 รอบแล้วสลับไปอีกฝั่งแบบกระจก
จุดเน้น: สามคน คนละสองแตะ และต้องมีคนวิ่งแซงบอล ถ้าไม่มีก็เป็นแค่การฝึกจ่าย
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Phá vỡ hàng thủ đã dựng: tạo và tận dụng hơn người, buộc hậu vệ quyết định, rồi chuyền vào khoảng trống mở ra.
Tần suất: Khối chiến thuật tập vài lần mỗi tuần, để đội mài giũa cách tạo và tận dụng cơ hội.
Bố trí: a wide channel in the attacking half, three attackers against one defender, one ball.
Đường bóng: 7 → 10 → 2 → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 7 chuyền cho 10, 7, 2 di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 2: 10 chuyền cho 2, A di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 3: 2 dẫn bóng di chuyển; Bước 4: 2 dứt điểm.
Tiếp nối: Xong một bài phối hợp, bóng về điểm xuất phát và mọi người dịch một vị trí để ai cũng qua từng vai; làm 8 lần rồi đổi sang bên kia theo kiểu đối xứng.
Điểm chính: Ba người, mỗi người hai chạm, một người chạy vượt bóng.

note.en:
Purpose: Rehearse a restart until it runs without a word — everyone knows the movement before the whistle, so the delivery, not the decision, is the hard part.
Frequency: Rehearsed weekly and hard before a match — set pieces decide a large share of goals, so the routines are drilled until automatic.
Setup: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Ball path: 10 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 10 shoots, 7 moves right, GK moves up the board; Step 2: 8, 9 move up the board.
How it continues: After each delivery everyone resets to the starting positions and the next taker steps up; eight in a row, half from the left and half from the right.
Coaching point: Everyone knows the routine before the whistle. Deciding at the ball tells the defence as much as it tells your own players.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】定位球：把套路练到不用喊、大家都知道往哪跑。难点只在传球质量，不在临场想。
【频度】每周练、赛前重点练——定位球贡献了很大比例的进球，所以套路要练到自动化。
【组织】球距门 22–25 米，4 人人墙站在 9.15 米处，一名门将，两名球员跟进抢第二点。
【球路】10 → 球门
【流程】第1步：10号球员射门，7号球员向右移动，GK向前移动；第2步：8号球员、9号球员向前移动。
【连贯】每罚一次，所有人回到起始站位，换下一名主罚；连续 8 次，一半从左边一半从右边。
【要点】哨响之前全队就知道要打哪套。站到球边才商量，等于同时告诉了对方防守。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】定位球：把套路練到不用喊、大家都知道往哪跑。難點只在傳球品質，不在臨場想。
【頻度】每週練、賽前重點練——定位球貢獻了很大比例的進球，所以套路要練到自動化。

【球路】10 → 球門

【連貫】每罰一次，所有人回到起始站位，換下一名主罰；連續 8 次，一半從左邊一半從右邊。
【要點】哨響之前全隊就知道要打哪套。站到球邊才商量，等於同時告訴了對方防守。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】セットプレーを声なしで回るまで反復する。笛の前に全員が動きを知っているから、難しいのは配球であって判断ではない。
【頻度】毎週、試合前は特に反復する。セットプレーは得点の多くを占めるので、型が自動化するまで仕込む。
【準備】the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound。
【ボールの道筋】10 → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：10番がシュート、7番が右へ移動、GKが前方へ移動。ステップ2：8番・9番が前方へ移動。
【続け方】1本蹴るごとに全員がスタート位置に戻り、次のキッカーに交代。8本続けて、半分は左から半分は右から。
【ポイント】笛の前に全員が段取りを知っている。ボールの横で決めるのは相手にも教えること。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】세트피스를 말 없이 돌아갈 때까지 반복한다. 휘슬 전에 모두가 움직임을 알기에 어려운 건 배급이지 판단이 아니다.
【빈도】매주, 경기 전에는 집중적으로 반복 — 세트피스는 득점의 큰 비중을 차지하므로 자동화될 때까지 훈련한다.
【준비】the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
【볼 경로】10 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 10번 슛, 7번는 오른쪽으로 이동, GK는 앞으로 이동; 2단계: 8번, 9번는 앞으로 이동.
【이어가기】한 번 찰 때마다 모두 처음 위치로 돌아가고 다음 키커가 나선다. 연속 8회, 절반은 왼쪽에서 절반은 오른쪽에서.
【포인트】휘슬 전에 모두가 루틴을 안다. 공 앞에서 정하는 것은 수비에게도 알려주는 것이다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Ensayar la jugada a balón parado hasta que salga sin hablar: todos saben el movimiento antes del pitido; lo difícil es el envío, no la decisión.
Frecuencia: Se ensaya semanalmente y a fondo antes del partido: el balón parado decide muchos goles, así que las jugadas se drillan hasta automatizarse.
Montaje: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Recorrido del balón: 10 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 10 remata, 7 se desplaza a la derecha, GK se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 2: 8, 9 se desplaza hacia delante.
Continuidad: Tras cada saque todos vuelven a la posición inicial y lanza el siguiente; ocho seguidos, la mitad desde la izquierda y la mitad desde la derecha.
Punto clave: Todos saben la jugada antes del pitido. Decidir junto al balón se lo cuenta también a la defensa.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Répéter le coup de pied arrêté jusqu'à ce qu'il tourne sans un mot : chacun connaît le mouvement avant le sifflet ; le difficile, c'est la transmission.
Fréquence : Répété chaque semaine et intensément avant un match : les coups de pied arrêtés décident une grande part des buts.
Mise en place : the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Trajet du ballon : 10 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 10 frappe, 7 se déplace à droite, GK se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 2 : 8, 9 se déplace vers l'avant.
Enchaînement : Après chaque frappe tout le monde se replace au départ et le tireur suivant s'avance ; huit d'affilée, moitié de gauche, moitié de droite.
Point clé : Tout le monde connaît la combinaison avant le coup de sifflet. Décider au ballon, c'est prévenir la défense.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Melatih bola mati sampai jalan tanpa kata — semua tahu pergerakan sebelum peluit; yang sulit adalah pengiriman, bukan keputusan.
Frekuensi: Dilatih mingguan dan intensif sebelum pertandingan — bola mati menentukan banyak gol, jadi rutinitas dilatih sampai otomatis.
Persiapan: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Jalur bola: 10 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 10 menembak, 7 bergerak ke kanan, GK bergerak ke depan; Langkah 2: 8, 9 bergerak ke depan.
Kelanjutan: Setelah tiap eksekusi semua kembali ke posisi awal dan pengeksekusi berikutnya maju; delapan berturut-turut, separuh dari kiri dan separuh dari kanan.
Poin utama: Semua tahu rutinnya sebelum peluit. Memutuskan di dekat bola juga memberi tahu lawan.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Melatih bola mati sehingga berjalan tanpa sepatah kata — semua tahu pergerakan sebelum wisel; yang sukar ialah penghantaran, bukan keputusan.
Kekerapan: Dilatih mingguan dan intensif sebelum perlawanan — bola mati menentukan banyak gol, jadi rutin dilatih sehingga automatik.
Persediaan: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Laluan bola: 10 → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 10 menjaring, 7 bergerak ke kanan, GK bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 2: 8, 9 bergerak ke hadapan.
Kesinambungan: Selepas setiap sepakan semua kembali ke posisi permulaan dan penyepak seterusnya maju; lapan berturut-turut, separuh dari kiri dan separuh dari kanan.
Poin utama: Semua tahu rutin sebelum wisel.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: ซ้อมลูกตั้งเตะจนเล่นได้โดยไม่ต้องพูด — ทุกคนรู้การเคลื่อนที่ก่อนเป่านกหวีด สิ่งที่ยากคือการจ่าย ไม่ใช่การตัดสินใจ
ความถี่: ซ้อมทุกสัปดาห์และเข้มก่อนแข่ง — ลูกตั้งเตะทำประตูสัดส่วนมาก จึงซ้อมจนเป็นอัตโนมัติ
การจัด: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound
เส้นทางบอล: 10 → ประตู
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: 10 ยิงประตู 7 ขยับไปทางขวา GK ขยับไปข้างหน้า • ขั้นที่ 2: 8, 9 ขยับไปข้างหน้า
การต่อเนื่อง: หลังเตะแต่ละครั้งทุกคนกลับไปตำแหน่งเริ่มต้นและเปลี่ยนคนเตะคนถัดไป ทำติดกัน 8 ครั้ง ครึ่งหนึ่งจากฝั่งซ้าย ครึ่งหนึ่งจากฝั่งขวา
จุดเน้น: ทุกคนรู้แผนก่อนเสียงนกหวีด ตัดสินใจข้างบอลเท่ากับบอกฝ่ายตรงข้ามด้วย
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Tập bóng cố định đến khi chạy không cần nói — ai cũng biết di chuyển trước tiếng còi; cái khó là đường bóng, không phải quyết định.
Tần suất: Tập hàng tuần và kỹ trước trận — bóng cố định quyết định phần lớn bàn thắng, nên các bài được tập đến mức tự động.
Bố trí: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Đường bóng: 10 → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 10 dứt điểm, 7 di chuyển sang phải, GK di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 2: 8, 9 di chuyển lên phía trước.
Tiếp nối: Sau mỗi quả đá, mọi người về vị trí ban đầu và người đá tiếp theo bước lên; 8 quả liên tiếp, một nửa từ bên trái, một nửa từ bên phải.
Điểm chính: Mọi người biết bài trước tiếng còi. Bàn bạc cạnh bóng là báo cho cả hàng thủ đối phương.

【빈도】매주, 경기 전에는 집중적으로 반복 — 세트피스는 득점의 큰 비중을 차지하므로 자동화될 때까지 훈련한다.
【준비】the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
【볼 경로】10 → 8 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 10번가 8번에게 패스, 7번는 오른쪽으로 이동, 8번, GK는 앞으로 이동; 2단계: 8번 슛, 9번는 앞으로 이동.
【이어가기】한 번 찰 때마다 모두 처음 위치로 돌아가고 다음 키커가 나선다. 연속 8회, 절반은 왼쪽에서 절반은 오른쪽에서.
【포인트】휘슬 전에 모두가 루틴을 안다. 공 앞에서 정하는 것은 수비에게도 알려주는 것이다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Ensayar la jugada a balón parado hasta que salga sin hablar: todos saben el movimiento antes del pitido; lo difícil es el envío, no la decisión.
Frecuencia: Se ensaya semanalmente y a fondo antes del partido: el balón parado decide muchos goles, así que las jugadas se drillan hasta automatizarse.
Montaje: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Recorrido del balón: 10 → 8 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 10 pasa a 8, 7 se desplaza a la derecha, 8, GK se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 2: 8 remata, 9 se desplaza hacia delante.
Continuidad: Tras cada saque todos vuelven a la posición inicial y lanza el siguiente; ocho seguidos, la mitad desde la izquierda y la mitad desde la derecha.
Punto clave: Todos saben la jugada antes del pitido. Decidir junto al balón se lo cuenta también a la defensa.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Répéter le coup de pied arrêté jusqu'à ce qu'il tourne sans un mot : chacun connaît le mouvement avant le sifflet ; le difficile, c'est la transmission.
Fréquence : Répété chaque semaine et intensément avant un match : les coups de pied arrêtés décident une grande part des buts.
Mise en place : the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Trajet du ballon : 10 → 8 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 10 passe à 8, 7 se déplace à droite, 8, GK se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 2 : 8 frappe, 9 se déplace vers l'avant.
Enchaînement : Après chaque frappe tout le monde se replace au départ et le tireur suivant s'avance ; huit d'affilée, moitié de gauche, moitié de droite.
Point clé : Tout le monde connaît la combinaison avant le coup de sifflet. Décider au ballon, c'est prévenir la défense.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Melatih bola mati sampai jalan tanpa kata — semua tahu pergerakan sebelum peluit; yang sulit adalah pengiriman, bukan keputusan.
Frekuensi: Dilatih mingguan dan intensif sebelum pertandingan — bola mati menentukan banyak gol, jadi rutinitas dilatih sampai otomatis.
Persiapan: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Jalur bola: 10 → 8 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 10 mengoper ke 8, 7 bergerak ke kanan, 8, GK bergerak ke depan; Langkah 2: 8 menembak, 9 bergerak ke depan.
Kelanjutan: Setelah tiap eksekusi semua kembali ke posisi awal dan pengeksekusi berikutnya maju; delapan berturut-turut, separuh dari kiri dan separuh dari kanan.
Poin utama: Semua tahu rutinnya sebelum peluit. Memutuskan di dekat bola juga memberi tahu lawan.
note.ms-MY:

การจัด: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound
เส้นทางบอล: 10 → 8 → ประตู

note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Tập bóng cố định đến khi chạy không cần nói — ai cũng biết di chuyển trước tiếng còi; cái khó là đường bóng, không phải quyết định.
Tần suất: Tập hàng tuần và kỹ trước trận — bóng cố định quyết định phần lớn bàn thắng, nên các bài được tập đến mức tự động.
Bố trí: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Đường bóng: 10 → 8 → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 10 chuyền cho 8, 7 di chuyển sang phải, 8, GK di chuyển lên phía trước; Bước 2: 8 dứt điểm, 9 di chuyển lên phía trước.
Tiếp nối: Sau mỗi quả đá, mọi người về vị trí ban đầu và người đá tiếp theo bước lên; 8 quả liên tiếp, một nửa từ bên trái, một nửa từ bên phải.
Điểm chính: Mọi người biết bài trước tiếng còi. Bàn bạc cạnh bóng là báo cho cả hàng thủ đối phương.

note.en:
Purpose: Rehearse a restart until it runs without a word — everyone knows the movement before the whistle, so the delivery, not the decision, is the hard part.
Frequency: Rehearsed weekly and hard before a match — set pieces decide a large share of goals, so the routines are drilled until automatic.
Setup: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Ball path: 10 → 8 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 10 passes to 8, 7 moves left, 8 moves right, GK moves up the board; Step 2: 8 shoots, 9 moves up the board.
How it continues: After each delivery everyone resets to the starting positions and the next taker steps up; eight in a row, half from the left and half from the right.
Coaching point: Everyone knows the routine before the whistle. Deciding at the ball tells the defence as much as it tells your own players.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】定位球：把套路练到不用喊、大家都知道往哪跑。难点只在传球质量，不在临场想。
【频度】每周练、赛前重点练——定位球贡献了很大比例的进球，所以套路要练到自动化。
【组织】球距门 22–25 米，4 人人墙站在 9.15 米处，一名门将，两名球员跟进抢第二点。
【球路】10 → 8 → 球门
【流程】第1步：10号球员把球传给8号球员，7号球员向左移动，8号球员向右移动，GK向前移动；第2步：8号球员射门，9号球员向前移动。
【连贯】每罚一次，所有人回到起始站位，换下一名主罚；连续 8 次，一半从左边一半从右边。
【要点】哨响之前全队就知道要打哪套。站到球边才商量，等于同时告诉了对方防守。
note.zh-TW:

【頻度】每週練、賽前重點練——定位球貢獻了很大比例的進球，所以套路要練到自動化。
【組織】the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound。
【球路】10 → 8 → 球門
【流程】第1步：10號球員把球傳給8號球員，7號球員向左移動，8號球員向右移動，GK向前移動；第2步：8號球員射門，9號球員向前移動。
【連貫】每罰一次，所有人回到起始站位，換下一名主罰；連續 8 次，一半從左邊一半從右邊。
【要點】哨響之前全隊就知道要打哪套。站到球邊才商量，等於同時告訴了對方防守。

【準備】the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 4 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound。
【ボールの道筋】10 → 8 → ゴール

【続け方】1本蹴るごとに全員がスタート位置に戻り、次のキッカーに交代。8本続けて、半分は左から半分は右から。
【ポイント】笛の前に全員が段取りを知っている。ボールの横で決めるのは相手にも教えること。

note.zh-CN:
【目的】定位球：把套路练到不用喊、大家都知道往哪跑。难点只在传球质量，不在临场想。
【频度】每周练、赛前重点练——定位球贡献了很大比例的进球，所以套路要练到自动化。
【组织】球距门 22–25 米，3 人人墙站在 9.15 米处，一名门将，两名球员跟进抢第二点。
【球路】10 → 9 → 球门
【流程】第1步：10号球员把球传给9号球员，7号球员向右移动，8号球员、GK向左移动；第2步：9号球员射门，9号球员向前移动。
【连贯】每罚一次，所有人回到起始站位，换下一名主罚；连续 8 次，一半从左边一半从右边。
【要点】哨响之前全队就知道要打哪套。站到球边才商量，等于同时告诉了对方防守。

【目的】セットプレーを声なしで回るまで反復する。笛の前に全員が動きを知っているから、難しいのは配球であって判断ではない。
【頻度】毎週、試合前は特に反復する。セットプレーは得点の多くを占めるので、型が自動化するまで仕込む。
【準備】the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 3 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound。
【ボールの道筋】10 → 9 → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：10番が9番へパス、7番が右へ移動、8番・GKが左へ移動。ステップ2：9番がシュート、9番が前方へ移動。
【続け方】1本蹴るごとに全員がスタート位置に戻り、次のキッカーに交代。8本続けて、半分は左から半分は右から。
【ポイント】笛の前に全員が段取りを知っている。ボールの横で決めるのは相手にも教えること。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】세트피스를 말 없이 돌아갈 때까지 반복한다. 휘슬 전에 모두가 움직임을 알기에 어려운 건 배급이지 판단이 아니다.
【빈도】매주, 경기 전에는 집중적으로 반복 — 세트피스는 득점의 큰 비중을 차지하므로 자동화될 때까지 훈련한다.
【준비】the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 3 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
【볼 경로】10 → 9 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 10번가 9번에게 패스, 7번는 오른쪽으로 이동, 8번, GK는 왼쪽으로 이동; 2단계: 9번 슛, 9번는 앞으로 이동.
【이어가기】한 번 찰 때마다 모두 처음 위치로 돌아가고 다음 키커가 나선다. 연속 8회, 절반은 왼쪽에서 절반은 오른쪽에서.
【포인트】휘슬 전에 모두가 루틴을 안다. 공 앞에서 정하는 것은 수비에게도 알려주는 것이다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Ensayar la jugada a balón parado hasta que salga sin hablar: todos saben el movimiento antes del pitido; lo difícil es el envío, no la decisión.
Frecuencia: Se ensaya semanalmente y a fondo antes del partido: el balón parado decide muchos goles, así que las jugadas se drillan hasta automatizarse.
Montaje: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 3 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Recorrido del balón: 10 → 9 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 10 pasa a 9, 7 se desplaza a la derecha, 8, GK se desplaza a la izquierda; Paso 2: 9 remata, 9 se desplaza hacia delante.
Continuidad: Tras cada saque todos vuelven a la posición inicial y lanza el siguiente; ocho seguidos, la mitad desde la izquierda y la mitad desde la derecha.
Punto clave: Todos saben la jugada antes del pitido. Decidir junto al balón se lo cuenta también a la defensa.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Répéter le coup de pied arrêté jusqu'à ce qu'il tourne sans un mot : chacun connaît le mouvement avant le sifflet ; le difficile, c'est la transmission.
Fréquence : Répété chaque semaine et intensément avant un match : les coups de pied arrêtés décident une grande part des buts.
Mise en place : the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 3 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Trajet du ballon : 10 → 9 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 10 passe à 9, 7 se déplace à droite, 8, GK se déplace à gauche ; Étape 2 : 9 frappe, 9 se déplace vers l'avant.
Enchaînement : Après chaque frappe tout le monde se replace au départ et le tireur suivant s'avance ; huit d'affilée, moitié de gauche, moitié de droite.
Point clé : Tout le monde connaît la combinaison avant le coup de sifflet. Décider au ballon, c'est prévenir la défense.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Melatih bola mati sampai jalan tanpa kata — semua tahu pergerakan sebelum peluit; yang sulit adalah pengiriman, bukan keputusan.
Frekuensi: Dilatih mingguan dan intensif sebelum pertandingan — bola mati menentukan banyak gol, jadi rutinitas dilatih sampai otomatis.
Persiapan: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 3 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Jalur bola: 10 → 9 → gawang
Urutan: Langkah 1: 10 mengoper ke 9, 7 bergerak ke kanan, 8, GK bergerak ke kiri; Langkah 2: 9 menembak, 9 bergerak ke depan.
Kelanjutan: Setelah tiap eksekusi semua kembali ke posisi awal dan pengeksekusi berikutnya maju; delapan berturut-turut, separuh dari kiri dan separuh dari kanan.
Poin utama: Semua tahu rutinnya sebelum peluit. Memutuskan di dekat bola juga memberi tahu lawan.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Melatih bola mati sehingga berjalan tanpa sepatah kata — semua tahu pergerakan sebelum wisel; yang sukar ialah penghantaran, bukan keputusan.
Kekerapan: Dilatih mingguan dan intensif sebelum perlawanan — bola mati menentukan banyak gol, jadi rutin dilatih sehingga automatik.
Persediaan: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 3 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Laluan bola: 10 → 9 → gol
Urutan: Langkah 1: 10 menghantar kepada 9, 7 bergerak ke kanan, 8, GK bergerak ke kiri; Langkah 2: 9 menjaring, 9 bergerak ke hadapan.
Kesinambungan: Selepas setiap sepakan semua kembali ke posisi permulaan dan penyepak seterusnya maju; lapan berturut-turut, separuh dari kiri dan separuh dari kanan.
Poin utama: Semua tahu rutin sebelum wisel.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: ซ้อมลูกตั้งเตะจนเล่นได้โดยไม่ต้องพูด — ทุกคนรู้การเคลื่อนที่ก่อนเป่านกหวีด สิ่งที่ยากคือการจ่าย ไม่ใช่การตัดสินใจ
ความถี่: ซ้อมทุกสัปดาห์และเข้มก่อนแข่ง — ลูกตั้งเตะทำประตูสัดส่วนมาก จึงซ้อมจนเป็นอัตโนมัติ
การจัด: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 3 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound
เส้นทางบอล: 10 → 9 → ประตู
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: 10 จ่ายให้ 9 7 ขยับไปทางขวา 8, GK ขยับไปทางซ้าย • ขั้นที่ 2: 9 ยิงประตู 9 ขยับไปข้างหน้า
การต่อเนื่อง: หลังเตะแต่ละครั้งทุกคนกลับไปตำแหน่งเริ่มต้นและเปลี่ยนคนเตะคนถัดไป ทำติดกัน 8 ครั้ง ครึ่งหนึ่งจากฝั่งซ้าย ครึ่งหนึ่งจากฝั่งขวา
จุดเน้น: ทุกคนรู้แผนก่อนเสียงนกหวีด ตัดสินใจข้างบอลเท่ากับบอกฝ่ายตรงข้ามด้วย
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Tập bóng cố định đến khi chạy không cần nói — ai cũng biết di chuyển trước tiếng còi; cái khó là đường bóng, không phải quyết định.
Tần suất: Tập hàng tuần và kỹ trước trận — bóng cố định quyết định phần lớn bàn thắng, nên các bài được tập đến mức tự động.
Bố trí: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 3 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Đường bóng: 10 → 9 → khung thành
Trình tự: Bước 1: 10 chuyền cho 9, 7 di chuyển sang phải, 8, GK di chuyển sang trái; Bước 2: 9 dứt điểm, 9 di chuyển lên phía trước.
Tiếp nối: Sau mỗi quả đá, mọi người về vị trí ban đầu và người đá tiếp theo bước lên; 8 quả liên tiếp, một nửa từ bên trái, một nửa từ bên phải.
Điểm chính: Mọi người biết bài trước tiếng còi. Bàn bạc cạnh bóng là báo cho cả hàng thủ đối phương.

Montaje: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 3 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Recorrido del balón: 10 → 9 → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: 10 pasa a 9, 7 se desplaza a la izquierda, 8, GK se desplaza a la derecha; Paso 2: 9 remata, 9 se desplaza hacia delante.
Continuidad: Tras cada saque todos vuelven a la posición inicial y lanza el siguiente; ocho seguidos, la mitad desde la izquierda y la mitad desde la derecha.
Punto clave: Todos saben la jugada antes del pitido. Decidir junto al balón se lo cuenta también a la defensa.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Répéter le coup de pied arrêté jusqu'à ce qu'il tourne sans un mot : chacun connaît le mouvement avant le sifflet ; le difficile, c'est la transmission.
Fréquence : Répété chaque semaine et intensément avant un match : les coups de pied arrêtés décident une grande part des buts.
Mise en place : the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 3 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.
Trajet du ballon : 10 → 9 → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 10 passe à 9, 7 se déplace à gauche, 8, GK se déplace à droite ; Étape 2 : 9 frappe, 9 se déplace vers l'avant.
Enchaînement : Après chaque frappe tout le monde se replace au départ et le tireur suivant s'avance ; huit d'affilée, moitié de gauche, moitié de droite.
Point clé : Tout le monde connaît la combinaison avant le coup de sifflet. Décider au ballon, c'est prévenir la défense.
note.id-ID:

Frekuensi: Dilatih mingguan dan intensif sebelum pertandingan — bola mati menentukan banyak gol, jadi rutinitas dilatih sampai otomatis.
Persiapan: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 3 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.

Urutan: Langkah 1: 10 mengoper ke 9, 7 bergerak ke kiri, 8, GK bergerak ke kanan; Langkah 2: 9 menembak, 9 bergerak ke depan.

Poin utama: Semua tahu rutinnya sebelum peluit. Memutuskan di dekat bola juga memberi tahu lawan.

note.vi-VN:

Tần suất: Tập hàng tuần và kỹ trước trận — bóng cố định quyết định phần lớn bàn thắng, nên các bài được tập đến mức tự động.
Bố trí: the ball 22-25 m from goal, a wall of 3 at its nine metres, a keeper, and two runners for the rebound.

Tiếp nối: Sau mỗi quả đá, mọi người về vị trí ban đầu và người đá tiếp theo bước lên; 8 quả liên tiếp, một nửa từ bên trái, một nửa từ bên phải.
Điểm chính: Mọi người biết bài trước tiếng còi. Bàn bạc cạnh bóng là báo cho cả hàng thủ đối phương.

note.en:
Purpose: A small-sided game: fewer players, so the ball and every decision arrive faster and nobody can hide from the play.
Frequency: A session-ender used most days — the small-sided game is where everything trained gets played out under pressure.
Setup: the same 24x20 m area, 4 v 4; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it.
Equipment: four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
Ball path: X4 → D → B → goal
Sequence: Step 1: D wins the ball off X4, D moves up the board to step in and win the ball; Step 2: D passes to B, B moves up the board to run in behind the defence, X4 runs up in support; Step 3: B shoots.
How it continues: After a goal the team that conceded restarts from its own end line; when the ball goes out the other team brings it in from where it left, and the coach has spares ready so nothing stops. Four-minute games, then swap ends or opponents.
Rules: A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
Coaching point: The five seconds after the turnover decide it. Win it back or get behind the ball — standing still does neither.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】小场比赛：人少场地小，球来得快、决定也快，每个人都得参与，没法躲。
【频度】几乎每天用来收尾——小场比赛让练过的一切在压力下落地。
【组织】同样约 24×20 米的场地，4 对 4；每次转换都真打五秒，教练再重新发球。
【器材】四个锥标标出场地四角（尺寸见【组织】），两个方块是两端线上各 2 米宽的小球门。
【球路】X4 → D → B → 球门
【流程】第1步：D断下X4的球，D向前移动（上脚断球）；第2步：D把球传给B，B向前移动（插入防线身后），X4跑上去接应；第3步：B射门。
【连贯】进球后由失球方从本方端线开球；球出界由对方在出界处发球，教练备好几个球随时补上，比赛不停。每局 4 分钟，局间换边或换对手。
【规则】球贴地整体穿过小球门算进球。球越过两个角上锥标之间的连线算出界；在那里得球的一方立刻向另一侧进攻。
【要点】转换后的五秒钟决定一切。要么抢回来，要么全体退到球后面 —— 站着不动两样都做不到。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】小場比賽：人少場地小，球來得快、決定也快，每個人都得參與，沒法躲。
【頻度】幾乎每天用來收尾——小場比賽讓練過的一切在壓力下落地。
【組織】the same 24x20 m area, 4 v 4; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it。
【器材】四個錐標標出場地四角（尺寸見【組織】），兩個方塊是兩端線上各 2 米寬的小球門。
【球路】X4 → D → B → 球門
【流程】第1步：D斷下X4的球，D向前移動（上腳斷球）；第2步：D把球傳給B，B向前移動（插入防線身後），X4跑上去接應；第3步：B射門。
【連貫】進球後由失球方從本方端線開球；球出界由對方在出界處發球，教練備好幾個球隨時補上，比賽不停。每局 4 分鐘，局間換邊或換對手。
【規則】球貼地整體穿過小球門算進球。球越過兩個角上錐標之間的連線算出界；在那裡得球的一方立刻向另一側進攻。
【要點】轉換後的五秒鐘決定一切。要麼搶回來，要麼全體退到球後面 —— 站著不動兩樣都做不到。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】ミニゲーム。人数が少ない分、ボールも判断も速く来て、誰もプレーから隠れられない。
【頻度】ほぼ毎日の締め。ミニゲームで、練習したすべてがプレッシャー下に出る。
【準備】the same 24x20 m area, 4 v 4; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it。
【用具】four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines。
【ボールの道筋】X4 → D → B → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：DがX4からボールを奪う、Dが前方へ移動し、足を出してボールを奪う。ステップ2：DがBへパス、Bが前方へ移動し、最終ラインの裏へ抜ける、X4がサポートに上がる。ステップ3：Bがシュート。
【続け方】得点後は失点した側が自陣エンドラインから再開。ボールが出たら相手が出た地点から入れ、コーチが予備球をすぐ入れて止めない。1ゲーム4分で、エンドか相手を交代。
【ルール】A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
【ポイント】切り替え後の5秒が全て。奪い返すか、ボールより後ろに戻るか。立ち止まればどちらも不可能。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】미니 게임: 인원이 적어 공과 모든 결정이 더 빨리 오고, 누구도 플레이에서 숨을 수 없다.
【빈도】거의 매일 세션 마무리로 사용 — 미니 게임에서 훈련한 모든 것이 압박 속에 나온다.
【준비】the same 24x20 m area, 4 v 4; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it.
【장비】four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
【볼 경로】X4 → D → B → 골문
【진행】1단계: D가 X4에게서 공을 빼앗는다, D는 앞으로 이동해 발을 넣어 공을 빼앗는다; 2단계: D가 B에게 패스, B는 앞으로 이동해 수비 뒷공간으로 침투한다, X4가 지원하러 올라간다; 3단계: B 슛.
【이어가기】골이 들어가면 실점한 팀이 자기 엔드라인에서 재개하고, 공이 나가면 상대가 나간 지점에서 넣는다. 코치가 여분의 공을 바로 넣어 멈추지 않는다. 한 게임 4분 후 진영이나 상대를 바꾼다.
【규칙】A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
【포인트】전환 후 5초가 결정한다. 되찾거나 공 뒤로 내려가라. 서 있으면 둘 다 못한다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Juego reducido: menos jugadores, así el balón y cada decisión llegan antes y nadie se esconde.
Frecuencia: Un cierre de sesión casi diario: el juego reducido es donde todo lo entrenado se pone en juego bajo presión.
Montaje: the same 24x20 m area, 4 v 4; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it.
Material: four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
Recorrido del balón: X4 → D → B → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: D le roba el balón a X4, D se desplaza hacia delante para entrar y robar el balón; Paso 2: D pasa a B, B se desplaza hacia delante para desmarcarse a la espalda de la defensa, X4 sube en apoyo; Paso 3: B remata.
Continuidad: Tras un gol reanuda el equipo que lo encajó desde su línea de fondo; si la bola sale, la mete el rival desde donde salió, y el entrenador tiene balones listos para que no se pare. Partidos de cuatro minutos y cambio de campo o de rival.
Reglas: A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
Punto clave: Los cinco segundos tras la pérdida deciden: recupera o ponte por detrás del balón.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Jeu réduit : moins de joueurs, donc le ballon et chaque décision arrivent plus vite et personne ne se cache.
Fréquence : Une fin de séance presque quotidienne : le jeu réduit est là où tout le travail se joue sous pression.
Mise en place : the same 24x20 m area, 4 v 4; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it.
Matériel : four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
Trajet du ballon : X4 → D → B → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : D récupère le ballon sur X4, D se déplace vers l'avant pour intervenir et récupérer le ballon ; Étape 2 : D passe à B, B se déplace vers l'avant pour prendre la profondeur, X4 monte en soutien ; Étape 3 : B frappe.
Enchaînement : Après un but, l'équipe encaissée relance de sa ligne de fond ; ballon sorti, l'adversaire le remet là où il est sorti, et l'entraîneur a des ballons prêts pour que rien ne s'arrête. Matchs de quatre minutes, puis on change de côté ou d'adversaire.
Règles : A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
Point clé : Les cinq secondes après la perte décident : récupère ou repasse derrière le ballon.

note.en:
Purpose: A small-sided game: fewer players, so the ball and every decision arrive faster and nobody can hide from the play.
Frequency: A session-ender used most days — the small-sided game is where everything trained gets played out under pressure.
Setup: the same 30x25 m area, 5 v 5; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it.
Equipment: four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
Ball path: X5 → E → C → goal
Sequence: Step 1: E wins the ball off X5, E moves up the board to step in and win the ball; Step 2: E passes to C, C moves up the board to run in behind the defence, X5 runs up in support; Step 3: C shoots.
How it continues: After a goal the team that conceded restarts from its own end line; when the ball goes out the other team brings it in from where it left, and the coach has spares ready so nothing stops. Four-minute games, then swap ends or opponents.
Rules: A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
Coaching point: The five seconds after the turnover decide it. Win it back or get behind the ball — standing still does neither.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】小场比赛：人少场地小，球来得快、决定也快，每个人都得参与，没法躲。
【频度】几乎每天用来收尾——小场比赛让练过的一切在压力下落地。
【组织】同样约 30×25 米的场地，5 对 5；每次转换都真打五秒，教练再重新发球。
【器材】四个锥标标出场地四角（尺寸见【组织】），两个方块是两端线上各 2 米宽的小球门。
【球路】X5 → E → C → 球门
【流程】第1步：E断下X5的球，E向前移动（上脚断球）；第2步：E把球传给C，C向前移动（插入防线身后），X5跑上去接应；第3步：C射门。
【连贯】进球后由失球方从本方端线开球；球出界由对方在出界处发球，教练备好几个球随时补上，比赛不停。每局 4 分钟，局间换边或换对手。
【规则】球贴地整体穿过小球门算进球。球越过两个角上锥标之间的连线算出界；在那里得球的一方立刻向另一侧进攻。
【要点】转换后的五秒钟决定一切。要么抢回来，要么全体退到球后面 —— 站着不动两样都做不到。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】小場比賽：人少場地小，球來得快、決定也快，每個人都得參與，沒法躲。
【頻度】幾乎每天用來收尾——小場比賽讓練過的一切在壓力下落地。

【球路】X5 → E → C → 球門
【流程】第1步：E斷下X5的球，E向前移動（上腳斷球）；第2步：E把球傳給C，C向前移動（插入防線身後），X5跑上去接應；第3步：C射門。
【連貫】進球後由失球方從本方端線開球；球出界由對方在出界處發球，教練備好幾個球隨時補上，比賽不停。每局 4 分鐘，局間換邊或換對手。
【規則】球貼地整體穿過小球門算進球。球越過兩個角上錐標之間的連線算出界；在那裡得球的一方立刻向另一側進攻。

note.ja-JP:
【目的】ミニゲーム。人数が少ない分、ボールも判断も速く来て、誰もプレーから隠れられない。
【頻度】ほぼ毎日の締め。ミニゲームで、練習したすべてがプレッシャー下に出る。
【準備】the same 30x25 m area, 5 v 5; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it。
【用具】four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines。
【ボールの道筋】X5 → E → C → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：EがX5からボールを奪う、Eが前方へ移動し、足を出してボールを奪う。ステップ2：EがCへパス、Cが前方へ移動し、最終ラインの裏へ抜ける、X5がサポートに上がる。ステップ3：Cがシュート。
【続け方】得点後は失点した側が自陣エンドラインから再開。ボールが出たら相手が出た地点から入れ、コーチが予備球をすぐ入れて止めない。1ゲーム4分で、エンドか相手を交代。
【ルール】A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
【ポイント】切り替え後の5秒が全て。奪い返すか、ボールより後ろに戻るか。立ち止まればどちらも不可能。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】미니 게임: 인원이 적어 공과 모든 결정이 더 빨리 오고, 누구도 플레이에서 숨을 수 없다.
【빈도】거의 매일 세션 마무리로 사용 — 미니 게임에서 훈련한 모든 것이 압박 속에 나온다.
【준비】the same 30x25 m area, 5 v 5; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it.
【장비】four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
【볼 경로】X5 → E → C → 골문
【진행】1단계: E가 X5에게서 공을 빼앗는다, E는 앞으로 이동해 발을 넣어 공을 빼앗는다; 2단계: E가 C에게 패스, C는 앞으로 이동해 수비 뒷공간으로 침투한다, X5가 지원하러 올라간다; 3단계: C 슛.
【이어가기】골이 들어가면 실점한 팀이 자기 엔드라인에서 재개하고, 공이 나가면 상대가 나간 지점에서 넣는다. 코치가 여분의 공을 바로 넣어 멈추지 않는다. 한 게임 4분 후 진영이나 상대를 바꾼다.
【규칙】A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
【포인트】전환 후 5초가 결정한다. 되찾거나 공 뒤로 내려가라. 서 있으면 둘 다 못한다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Juego reducido: menos jugadores, así el balón y cada decisión llegan antes y nadie se esconde.
Frecuencia: Un cierre de sesión casi diario: el juego reducido es donde todo lo entrenado se pone en juego bajo presión.
Montaje: the same 30x25 m area, 5 v 5; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it.
Material: four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
Recorrido del balón: X5 → E → C → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: E le roba el balón a X5, E se desplaza hacia delante para entrar y robar el balón; Paso 2: E pasa a C, C se desplaza hacia delante para desmarcarse a la espalda de la defensa, X5 sube en apoyo; Paso 3: C remata.
Continuidad: Tras un gol reanuda el equipo que lo encajó desde su línea de fondo; si la bola sale, la mete el rival desde donde salió, y el entrenador tiene balones listos para que no se pare. Partidos de cuatro minutos y cambio de campo o de rival.
Reglas: A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
Punto clave: Los cinco segundos tras la pérdida deciden: recupera o ponte por detrás del balón.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Jeu réduit : moins de joueurs, donc le ballon et chaque décision arrivent plus vite et personne ne se cache.
Fréquence : Une fin de séance presque quotidienne : le jeu réduit est là où tout le travail se joue sous pression.
Mise en place : the same 30x25 m area, 5 v 5; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it.
Matériel : four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
Trajet du ballon : X5 → E → C → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : E récupère le ballon sur X5, E se déplace vers l'avant pour intervenir et récupérer le ballon ; Étape 2 : E passe à C, C se déplace vers l'avant pour prendre la profondeur, X5 monte en soutien ; Étape 3 : C frappe.
Enchaînement : Après un but, l'équipe encaissée relance de sa ligne de fond ; ballon sorti, l'adversaire le remet là où il est sorti, et l'entraîneur a des ballons prêts pour que rien ne s'arrête. Matchs de quatre minutes, puis on change de côté ou d'adversaire.

Point clé : Les cinq secondes après la perte décident : récupère ou repasse derrière le ballon.

note.en:
Purpose: A small-sided game: fewer players, so the ball and every decision arrive faster and nobody can hide from the play.
Frequency: A session-ender used most days — the small-sided game is where everything trained gets played out under pressure.
Setup: the same 36x30 m area, 6 v 6; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it.
Equipment: four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
Ball path: X6 → F → C → goal
Sequence: Step 1: F wins the ball off X6, F moves up the board to step in and win the ball; Step 2: F passes to C, C moves up the board to run in behind the defence, X6 runs up in support; Step 3: C shoots.
How it continues: After a goal the team that conceded restarts from its own end line; when the ball goes out the other team brings it in from where it left, and the coach has spares ready so nothing stops. Four-minute games, then swap ends or opponents.
Rules: A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
Coaching point: The five seconds after the turnover decide it. Win it back or get behind the ball — standing still does neither.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】小场比赛：人少场地小，球来得快、决定也快，每个人都得参与，没法躲。
【频度】几乎每天用来收尾——小场比赛让练过的一切在压力下落地。
【组织】同样约 36×30 米的场地，6 对 6；每次转换都真打五秒，教练再重新发球。
【器材】四个锥标标出场地四角（尺寸见【组织】），两个方块是两端线上各 2 米宽的小球门。
【球路】X6 → F → C → 球门
【流程】第1步：F断下X6的球，F向前移动（上脚断球）；第2步：F把球传给C，C向前移动（插入防线身后），X6跑上去接应；第3步：C射门。
【连贯】进球后由失球方从本方端线开球；球出界由对方在出界处发球，教练备好几个球随时补上，比赛不停。每局 4 分钟，局间换边或换对手。
【规则】球贴地整体穿过小球门算进球。球越过两个角上锥标之间的连线算出界；在那里得球的一方立刻向另一侧进攻。
【要点】转换后的五秒钟决定一切。要么抢回来，要么全体退到球后面 —— 站着不动两样都做不到。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】小場比賽：人少場地小，球來得快、決定也快，每個人都得參與，沒法躲。
【頻度】幾乎每天用來收尾——小場比賽讓練過的一切在壓力下落地。
【組織】the same 36x30 m area, 6 v 6; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it。
【器材】四個錐標標出場地四角（尺寸見【組織】），兩個方塊是兩端線上各 2 米寬的小球門。
【球路】X6 → F → C → 球門
【流程】第1步：F斷下X6的球，F向前移動（上腳斷球）；第2步：F把球傳給C，C向前移動（插入防線身後），X6跑上去接應；第3步：C射門。
【連貫】進球後由失球方從本方端線開球；球出界由對方在出界處發球，教練備好幾個球隨時補上，比賽不停。每局 4 分鐘，局間換邊或換對手。
【規則】球貼地整體穿過小球門算進球。球越過兩個角上錐標之間的連線算出界；在那裡得球的一方立刻向另一側進攻。
【要點】轉換後的五秒鐘決定一切。要麼搶回來，要麼全體退到球後面 —— 站著不動兩樣都做不到。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】ミニゲーム。人数が少ない分、ボールも判断も速く来て、誰もプレーから隠れられない。
【頻度】ほぼ毎日の締め。ミニゲームで、練習したすべてがプレッシャー下に出る。
【準備】the same 36x30 m area, 6 v 6; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it。
【用具】four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines。
【ボールの道筋】X6 → F → C → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：FがX6からボールを奪う、Fが前方へ移動し、足を出してボールを奪う。ステップ2：FがCへパス、Cが前方へ移動し、最終ラインの裏へ抜ける、X6がサポートに上がる。ステップ3：Cがシュート。
【続け方】得点後は失点した側が自陣エンドラインから再開。ボールが出たら相手が出た地点から入れ、コーチが予備球をすぐ入れて止めない。1ゲーム4分で、エンドか相手を交代。
【ルール】A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
【ポイント】切り替え後の5秒が全て。奪い返すか、ボールより後ろに戻るか。立ち止まればどちらも不可能。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】미니 게임: 인원이 적어 공과 모든 결정이 더 빨리 오고, 누구도 플레이에서 숨을 수 없다.
【빈도】거의 매일 세션 마무리로 사용 — 미니 게임에서 훈련한 모든 것이 압박 속에 나온다.
【준비】the same 36x30 m area, 6 v 6; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it.
【장비】four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
【볼 경로】X6 → F → C → 골문
【진행】1단계: F가 X6에게서 공을 빼앗는다, F는 앞으로 이동해 발을 넣어 공을 빼앗는다; 2단계: F가 C에게 패스, C는 앞으로 이동해 수비 뒷공간으로 침투한다, X6가 지원하러 올라간다; 3단계: C 슛.
【이어가기】골이 들어가면 실점한 팀이 자기 엔드라인에서 재개하고, 공이 나가면 상대가 나간 지점에서 넣는다. 코치가 여분의 공을 바로 넣어 멈추지 않는다. 한 게임 4분 후 진영이나 상대를 바꾼다.
【규칙】A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
【포인트】전환 후 5초가 결정한다. 되찾거나 공 뒤로 내려가라. 서 있으면 둘 다 못한다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Juego reducido: menos jugadores, así el balón y cada decisión llegan antes y nadie se esconde.
Frecuencia: Un cierre de sesión casi diario: el juego reducido es donde todo lo entrenado se pone en juego bajo presión.
Montaje: the same 36x30 m area, 6 v 6; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it.
Material: four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
Recorrido del balón: X6 → F → C → portería
Secuencia: Paso 1: F le roba el balón a X6, F se desplaza hacia delante para entrar y robar el balón; Paso 2: F pasa a C, C se desplaza hacia delante para desmarcarse a la espalda de la defensa, X6 sube en apoyo; Paso 3: C remata.
Continuidad: Tras un gol reanuda el equipo que lo encajó desde su línea de fondo; si la bola sale, la mete el rival desde donde salió, y el entrenador tiene balones listos para que no se pare. Partidos de cuatro minutos y cambio de campo o de rival.
Reglas: A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
Punto clave: Los cinco segundos tras la pérdida deciden: recupera o ponte por detrás del balón.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Jeu réduit : moins de joueurs, donc le ballon et chaque décision arrivent plus vite et personne ne se cache.
Fréquence : Une fin de séance presque quotidienne : le jeu réduit est là où tout le travail se joue sous pression.
Mise en place : the same 36x30 m area, 6 v 6; every turnover is played out for five seconds before the coach restarts it.
Matériel : four cones mark the corners of the pitch — its size is in the set-up line — and the two squares are 2 m goals on the two end lines.
Trajet du ballon : X6 → F → C → but
Déroulé : Étape 1 : F récupère le ballon sur X6, F se déplace vers l'avant pour intervenir et récupérer le ballon ; Étape 2 : F passe à C, C se déplace vers l'avant pour prendre la profondeur, X6 monte en soutien ; Étape 3 : C frappe.
Enchaînement : Après un but, l'équipe encaissée relance de sa ligne de fond ; ballon sorti, l'adversaire le remet là où il est sorti, et l'entraîneur a des ballons prêts pour que rien ne s'arrête. Matchs de quatre minutes, puis on change de côté ou d'adversaire.
Règles : A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
Point clé : Les cinq secondes après la perte décident : récupère ou repasse derrière le ballon.

Frekuensi: Penutup sesi hampir tiap hari — permainan kecil adalah tempat semua yang dilatih diuji di bawah tekanan.

note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Trò chơi sân nhỏ: ít người hơn nên bóng và mọi quyết định đến nhanh hơn, không ai trốn khỏi trận đấu được.

Luật: A goal is the whole ball through a mini-goal along the ground. The ball is out when it crosses the line between two corner cones; whoever wins it there attacks the other way at once.
Điểm chính: Năm giây sau khi mất bóng quyết định tất cả: đoạt lại hoặc lùi về sau bóng.

note.en:
Purpose: Raise the heart rate and sharpen touch before the load comes; it sets the standard the session keeps.
Frequency: Used every session — it opens the training and warms the body and the touch before the work.
Setup: two players 20 m apart inside a 20 m square of cones, one or two pressers, one ball.
Equipment: four cones mark a box 10 m square; the first touch has to keep the ball inside it, and a ball that crosses a cone line is a loss.
Ball path: A → B
Sequence: Step 1: A passes to B, B moves back, X1 moves up the board; Step 2: B carries the ball on the move.
How it continues: Back to the end of the line when your rep is done and the next player goes; six to eight each, then switch sides or roles.
Coaching point: The first touch is a pass to yourself. Put it where the second touch is already free.

【目的】热身：练球前先把身体活动开、找回球感。热身认真，一整堂课的质量才跟得上。
【频度】热身常用——几乎每堂课的开场，训练前先活动身体、找回球感。

mistake.en: Killing the ball dead under your feet — a perfect touch into your own shadow is still a lost tempo.
mistake.en-GB: Killing the ball dead under your feet — a perfect touch into your own shadow is still a lost tempo.
mistake.zh-CN: 把球停死在脚下——停进自己影子里的完美一停，也还是丢了一拍。
mistake.zh-TW: 把球停死在腳下——停進自己影子裡的完美一停，也還是丟了一拍。
mistake.ja-JP: 足元にピタリと止める——自分の影に止めた完璧なトラップも、テンポの損失だ。
mistake.ko-KR: 발밑에 죽여 놓는다 — 제 그림자 속의 완벽한 터치도 한 박자 손해다.
mistake.es-ES: Matar el balón bajo los pies: un control perfecto hacia tu propia sombra sigue perdiendo un tiempo.
mistake.fr-FR: Tuer le ballon sous ses pieds — un contrôle parfait dans son ombre perd quand même un temps.
mistake.id-ID: Menghentikan bola mati di bawah kaki.
mistake.ms-MY: Mematikan bola di bawah kaki.
mistake.th-TH: หยุดบอลตายใต้เท้า
mistake.vi-VN: Ghìm chết bóng dưới chân.

note.en:
Purpose: Raise the heart rate and sharpen touch before the load comes; it sets the standard the session keeps.
Frequency: Used every session — it opens the training and warms the body and the touch before the work.
Setup: two players 20 m apart inside a 20 m square of cones, one or two pressers, one ball.
Equipment: four cones mark a box 10 m square; the first touch has to keep the ball inside it, and a ball that crosses a cone line is a loss.
Ball path: A → B
Sequence: Step 1: A passes to B, B moves back, X1 moves up the board; Step 2: B carries the ball on the move.
How it continues: Back to the end of the line when your rep is done and the next player goes; six to eight each, then switch sides or roles.
Coaching point: The first touch is a pass to yourself. Put it where the second touch is already free.

note.en:
Purpose: Raise the heart rate and sharpen touch before the load comes; it sets the standard the session keeps.
Frequency: Used every session — it opens the training and warms the body and the touch before the work.
Setup: two players 20 m apart inside a 20 m square of cones, one or two pressers, one ball.
Equipment: four cones mark a box 10 m square; the first touch has to keep the ball inside it, and a ball that crosses a cone line is a loss.
Ball path: A → B
Sequence: Step 1: A passes to B, B moves back, X1 moves up the board; Step 2: B carries the ball on the move.
How it continues: Back to the end of the line when your rep is done and the next player goes; six to eight each, then switch sides or roles.
Coaching point: The first touch is a pass to yourself. Put it where the second touch is already free.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】热身：练球前先把身体活动开、找回球感。热身认真，一整堂课的质量才跟得上。
【频度】热身常用——几乎每堂课的开场，训练前先活动身体、找回球感。
【组织】20 米见方的锥标区，两名球员相距 20 米，另有 1–2 名施压者，一颗球。
【器材】四个锥标围出 10 米见方的区域；第一脚触球要把球留在区域内，球越过锥标连线算丢球。
【球路】A → B
【流程】第1步：A把球传给B，B向后移动，X1向前移动；第2步：B带球推进。
【连贯】做完一次回到队尾，下一人出发；每人 6–8 次后换边或换角色。
【要点】第一脚是传给自己的球。要停到第二脚已经没人干扰的位置。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】熱身：練球前先把身體活動開、找回球感。熱身認真，一整堂課的品質才跟得上。
【頻度】熱身常用——幾乎每堂課的開場，訓練前先活動身體、找回球感。
【組織】two players 20 m apart inside a 20 m square of cones, one or two pressers, one ball。
【器材】四個錐標圍出 10 米見方的區域；第一腳觸球要把球留在區域內，球越過錐標連線算丟球。
【球路】A → B
【流程】第1步：A把球傳給B，B向後移動，X1向前移動；第2步：B帶球推進。
【連貫】做完一次回到隊尾，下一人出發；每人 6–8 次後換邊或換角色。
【要點】第一腳是傳給自己的球。要停到第二腳已經沒人干擾的位置。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】負荷が来る前に心拍を上げ、ボールタッチを整える。練習全体の基準を作る。
【頻度】毎回のセッションで使う。練習の入りで、体とタッチを温める。
【準備】two players 20 m apart inside a 20 m square of cones, one or two pressers, one ball。
【用具】four cones mark a box 10 m square; the first touch has to keep the ball inside it, and a ball that crosses a cone line is a loss。
【ボールの道筋】A → B
【流れ】ステップ1：AがBへパス、Bが後方へ移動、X1が前方へ移動。ステップ2：Bがボールを運ぶ。
【続け方】1本終えたら列の最後尾へ戻り、次の選手が出る。1人6〜8本で左右か役割を交代。
【ポイント】ファーストタッチは自分へのパス。2タッチ目が自由になる場所に置く。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】본격적인 부하 전에 심박수를 올리고 볼 감각을 살린다. 세션 전체의 기준을 세운다.
【빈도】매 세션마다 사용 — 훈련의 시작으로, 본격 운동 전에 몸과 감각을 데운다.
【준비】two players 20 m apart inside a 20 m square of cones, one or two pressers, one ball.
【장비】four cones mark a box 10 m square; the first touch has to keep the ball inside it, and a ball that crosses a cone line is a loss.
【볼 경로】A → B
【진행】1단계: A가 B에게 패스, B는 뒤로 이동, X1는 앞으로 이동; 2단계: B가 공을 몰고 이동.
【이어가기】한 번 마치면 줄 맨 뒤로 가고 다음 선수가 출발한다. 한 사람당 6~8회 후 방향이나 역할을 바꾼다.
【포인트】첫 터치는 자신에게 하는 패스다. 두 번째 터치가 이미 자유로운 곳에 놓아라.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Eleva pulsaciones y afina el toque antes de la carga; fija el nivel de la sesión.
Frecuencia: Se usa cada sesión: abre el entrenamiento y calienta cuerpo y toque.
Montaje: two players 20 m apart inside a 20 m square of cones, one or two pressers, one ball.
Material: four cones mark a box 10 m square; the first touch has to keep the ball inside it, and a ball that crosses a cone line is a loss.
Recorrido del balón: A → B
Secuencia: Paso 1: A pasa a B, B se desplaza hacia atrás, X1 se desplaza hacia delante; Paso 2: B conduce el balón.
Continuidad: Al terminar tu repetición vuelves al final de la fila y sale el siguiente; seis a ocho cada uno, luego cambio de lado o de rol.
Punto clave: El primer control es un pase a ti mismo: déjalo donde el segundo toque ya esté libre.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Élève le rythme cardiaque et affine la touche avant la charge ; fixe le niveau de la séance.
Fréquence : Utilisé à chaque séance : il ouvre l'entraînement et échauffe le corps et la touche.
Mise en place : two players 20 m apart inside a 20 m square of cones, one or two pressers, one ball.
Matériel : four cones mark a box 10 m square; the first touch has to keep the ball inside it, and a ball that crosses a cone line is a loss.
Trajet du ballon : A → B
Déroulé : Étape 1 : A passe à B, B se déplace vers l'arrière, X1 se déplace vers l'avant ; Étape 2 : B conduit le ballon.
Enchaînement : Ta répétition finie, tu retournes en fin de file et le suivant part ; six à huit chacun, puis on change de côté ou de rôle.
Point clé : Le premier contrôle est une passe à soi-même : place-le là où le second est déjà libre.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Menaikkan detak jantung dan menajamkan sentuhan sebelum beban; menetapkan standar sesi.
Frekuensi: Dipakai setiap sesi — membuka latihan dan menghangatkan tubuh dan sentuhan.
Persiapan: two players 20 m apart inside a 20 m square of cones, one or two pressers, one ball.
Perlengkapan: four cones mark a box 10 m square; the first touch has to keep the ball inside it, and a ball that crosses a cone line is a loss.
Jalur bola: A → B
Urutan: Langkah 1: A mengoper ke B, B bergerak ke belakang, X1 bergerak ke depan; Langkah 2: B menggiring bola.
Kelanjutan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain berikutnya berangkat; enam sampai delapan kali tiap orang, lalu ganti sisi atau peran.
Poin utama: Sentuhan pertama adalah umpan untuk diri sendiri.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Menaikkan degupan jantung dan menajamkan sentuhan sebelum beban; menetapkan piawaian sesi.
Kekerapan: Digunakan setiap sesi — membuka latihan dan memanaskan badan dan sentuhan.
Persediaan: two players 20 m apart inside a 20 m square of cones, one or two pressers, one ball.
Peralatan: four cones mark a box 10 m square; the first touch has to keep the ball inside it, and a ball that crosses a cone line is a loss.
Laluan bola: A → B
Urutan: Langkah 1: A menghantar kepada B, B bergerak ke belakang, X1 bergerak ke hadapan; Langkah 2: B membawa bola.
Kesinambungan: Selesai satu ulangan kembali ke belakang barisan dan pemain seterusnya bermula; enam hingga lapan kali setiap orang, kemudian tukar sisi atau peranan.
Poin utama: Sentuhan pertama ialah hantaran kepada diri sendiri.

เส้นทางบอล: A → B

name.ja-JP: ヘディング 攻撃
name.th-TH: ลูกโหม่ง เกมรุก

note.en:
Purpose: Turn a chance into a goal: arrive with the feet set, strike early and low, and hit the space rather than the shirt.
Frequency: A technical block coaches run often — the finish is what the whole attack is for, so it is rehearsed regularly.
Setup: a server on the wing, a striker on the penalty spot and a centre-back on him; one goal with a keeper.
Ball path: 7 → 9 → goal
Sequence: Step 1: 7 passes to 9, 7, 9 move up the board, 5 moves back; Step 2: 9 shoots.
How it continues: Back to the end of the line when your rep is done and the next player goes; six to eight each, then switch sides or roles.
Rules: The attacker scores by heading the ball down and on target; the defender scores by heading it high, wide and away from goal — first contact is the whole contest.
Coaching point: Attack the ball, don't wait for it. Whoever is moving when they meet it wins the header.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】射门：练怎么把机会打进。跑到位时脚要站好，早点出脚、打低平球，瞄空当不瞄人。
【频度】技术训练，教练常练——终结是整个进攻的目的，所以要反复练。
【组织】边路一名传中人，一名前锋站点球点、一名中卫贴身，一个球门带门将。
【球路】7 → 9 → 球门
【流程】第1步：7号球员把球传给9号球员，7号球员、9号球员向前移动，5号球员向后移动；第2步：9号球员射门。
【连贯】做完一次回到队尾，下一人出发；每人 6–8 次后换边或换角色。
【规则】进攻方把头球顶下压、顶正球门算得分；防守方把球顶高、顶远、顶离球门算成功——争的就是第一点。
【要点】去争球，不要等球。碰到球那一刻还在移动的人，就赢下这个头球。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】射門：練怎麼把機會打進。跑到位時腳要站好，早點出腳、打低平球，瞄空檔不瞄人。
【頻度】技術訓練，教練常練——終結是整個進攻的目的，所以要反覆練。
【組織】a server on the wing, a striker on the penalty spot and a centre-back on him; one goal with a keeper。
【球路】7 → 9 → 球門
【流程】第1步：7號球員把球傳給9號球員，7號球員、9號球員向前移動，5號球員向後移動；第2步：9號球員射門。
【連貫】做完一次回到隊尾，下一人出發；每人 6–8 次後換邊或換角色。
【規則】進攻方把頭球頂下壓、頂正球門算得分；防守方把球頂高、頂遠、頂離球門算成功——爭的就是第一點。
【要點】去爭球，不要等球。碰到球那一刻還在移動的人，就贏下這個頭球。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】チャンスを得点に変える。足を作って到達し、早く低く打ち、人ではなくスペースを狙う。
【頻度】指導者が頻繁に行う技術ブロック。フィニッシュは攻撃全体の目的なので、繰り返し反復する。
【準備】a server on the wing, a striker on the penalty spot and a centre-back on him; one goal with a keeper。
【ボールの道筋】7 → 9 → ゴール
【流れ】ステップ1：7番が9番へパス、7番・9番が前方へ移動、5番が後方へ移動。ステップ2：9番がシュート。
【続け方】1本終えたら列の最後尾へ戻り、次の選手が出る。1人6〜8本で左右か役割を交代。
【ルール】The attacker scores by heading the ball down and on target; the defender scores by heading it high, wide and away from goal — first contact is the whole contest.
【ポイント】待たずに競りに行く。当たる瞬間に動いている方が競り勝つ。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】기회를 골로 바꾼다. 발을 갖춰 도착하고, 빠르고 낮게 슛하며, 사람이 아니라 공간을 노린다.
【빈도】지도자가 자주 하는 기술 블록 — 마무리는 공격 전체의 목적이라 정기적으로 반복한다.
【준비】a server on the wing, a striker on the penalty spot and a centre-back on him; one goal with a keeper.
【볼 경로】7 → 9 → 골문
【진행】1단계: 7번가 9번에게 패스, 7번, 9번는 앞으로 이동, 5번는 뒤로 이동; 2단계: 9번 슛.
【이어가기】한 번 마치면 줄 맨 뒤로 가고 다음 선수가 출발한다. 한 사람당 6~8회 후 방향이나 역할을 바꾼다.
【규칙】The attacker scores by heading the ball down and on target; the defender scores by heading it high, wide and away from goal — first contact is the whole contest.
【포인트】기다리지 말고 공을 향해 가라. 맞는 순간 움직이는 쪽이 이긴다.
note.es-ES:

name.ja-JP: ヘディング 守備
name.th-TH: ลูกโหม่ง เกมรับ

note.en:
Purpose: Deny space as a unit — the whole line shifts with the ball, closes the pass on either side of the presser, and covers behind.
Frequency: A tactical block run a few times a week — defensive shape is drilled regularly because it is the habit a match tests most.
Setup: a server crossing from the wing, a striker attacking it and a centre-back in front of him, with a full-back wide as the outlet.
Ball path: 7 → 5 → 3 → the open space
Sequence: Step 1: 5 wins the ball off 7, 7, 9 move up the board, 5 moves back; Step 2: 5 passes to 3; Step 3: 3 plays the ball into space.
How it continues: A rep ends on a shot, a tackle or the ball going out. The attackers rejoin the queue and the next go straight in; the defenders hold for four reps, then swap with the attackers.
Rules: The attacker scores by heading the ball down and on target; the defender scores by heading it high, wide and away from goal — first contact is the whole contest.
Coaching point: Attack the ball, don't wait for it. Whoever is moving when they meet it wins the header.

Sequence: Step 1: 5 wins the ball off 7, 7, 9 move up the board, 5 moves back; Step 2: 5 passes to 3; Step 3: 3 plays the ball into space.
How it continues: A rep ends on a shot, a tackle or the ball going out. The attackers rejoin the queue and the next go straight in; the defenders hold for four reps, then swap with the attackers.
Rules: The attacker scores by heading the ball down and on target; the defender scores by heading it high, wide and away from goal — first contact is the whole contest.
Coaching point: Attack the ball, don't wait for it. Whoever is moving when they meet it wins the header.
note.zh-CN:
【目的】防守：练整条线一起动。球到哪边就往哪边压，上抢的人两侧有人封传球线，身后有人保护。
【频度】战术训练，每周练几次——防守站位要常练，因为它是比赛最常考验的习惯。
【组织】边路一名传中人，一名前锋抢点、一名中卫抢在他身前，边路另有一名边后卫作为解围目标。
【球路】7 → 5 → 3 → 空当
【流程】第1步：5号球员断下7号球员的球，7号球员、9号球员向前移动，5号球员向后移动；第2步：5号球员把球传给3号球员；第3步：3号球员把球送进空当。
【连贯】一球结束——射门、断球或球出界——进攻方回到队尾，下一组马上进攻；防守方连守四球后与进攻互换。
【规则】进攻方把头球顶下压、顶正球门算得分；防守方把球顶高、顶远、顶离球门算成功——争的就是第一点。
【要点】去争球，不要等球。碰到球那一刻还在移动的人，就赢下这个头球。
note.zh-TW:

【頻度】戰術訓練，每週練幾次——防守站位要常練，因為它是比賽最常考驗的習慣。
【組織】a server crossing from the wing, a striker attacking it and a centre-back in front of him, with a full-back wide as the outlet。

note.ja-JP:

note.ko-KR:

note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Negar el espacio como bloque: la línea bascula con el balón, cierra el pase a ambos lados del que presiona y cubre por detrás.
Frecuencia: Un bloque táctico varias veces por semana: la estructura defensiva se ensaya a menudo porque es lo que más pone a prueba el partido.
Montaje: a server crossing from the wing, a striker attacking it and a centre-back in front of him, with a full-back wide as the outlet.
Recorrido del balón: 7 → 5 → 3 → el espacio libre
Secuencia: Paso 1: 5 le roba el balón a 7, 7, 9 se desplaza hacia delante, 5 se desplaza hacia atrás; Paso 2: 5 pasa a 3; Paso 3: 3 envía el balón al siguiente punto.
Continuidad: La repetición termina con un tiro, un robo o el balón fuera. Los atacantes vuelven a la fila y entran los siguientes; los defensores aguantan cuatro y luego cambian con los atacantes.
Reglas: The attacker scores by heading the ball down and on target; the defender scores by heading it high, wide and away from goal — first contact is the whole contest.
Punto clave: Ataca el balón, no lo esperes: gana el que llega en movimiento.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Refuser l'espace en bloc : la ligne coulisse avec le ballon, ferme la passe de chaque côté du presseur et couvre derrière.
Fréquence : Un bloc tactique quelques fois par semaine : la structure défensive se travaille souvent, car c'est l'habitude que le match teste le plus.
Mise en place : a server crossing from the wing, a striker attacking it and a centre-back in front of him, with a full-back wide as the outlet.
Trajet du ballon : 7 → 5 → 3 → l'espace libre
Déroulé : Étape 1 : 5 récupère le ballon sur 7, 7, 9 se déplace vers l'avant, 5 se déplace vers l'arrière ; Étape 2 : 5 passe à 3 ; Étape 3 : 3 envoie le ballon au point suivant.
Enchaînement : La séquence s'arrête sur un tir, une récupération ou une sortie de balle. Les attaquants rejoignent la file et les suivants enchaînent ; les défenseurs tiennent quatre séquences puis permutent.
Règles : The attacker scores by heading the ball down and on target; the defender scores by heading it high, wide and away from goal — first contact is the whole contest.
Point clé : Attaque le ballon, ne l'attends pas : celui qui bouge gagne le duel.
note.id-ID:

note.vi-VN:

note.en:
Purpose: Rehearse a restart until it runs without a word — everyone knows the movement before the whistle, so the delivery, not the decision, is the hard part.
Frequency: Rehearsed weekly and hard before a match — set pieces decide a large share of goals, so the routines are drilled until automatic.
Setup: a keeper, two centre-backs, a holding midfielder and one outlet up the pitch, against two who press.
Ball path: GK → 4 → 6 → 8 → the open space
Sequence: Step 1: GK passes to 4, 4, 5, 9, 10 move up the board; Step 2: 4 passes to 6, 6, 8 move up the board; Step 3: 6 passes to 8; Step 4: 8 plays the ball into space.
How it continues: Getting the ball over halfway counts as a success; a turnover or the ball out counts for the pressers. Either way it goes back to the keeper and starts again; six reps, then the sides swap.
Rules: The goal kick has worked when the ball is under control in the other half; it has failed if it is won back, if it goes out, or if the keeper has to hit it long because nobody showed.
Coaching point: Decide the route before the ball is placed. A goal kick that gets discussed on the six-yard box is already a turnover.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】定位球：把套路练到不用喊、大家都知道往哪跑。难点只在传球质量，不在临场想。
【频度】每周练、赛前重点练——定位球贡献了很大比例的进球，所以套路要练到自动化。
【组织】门将、两名中卫、一名后腰，前场一名接应点，对方两人上抢。
【球路】GK → 4 → 6 → 8 → 空当
【流程】第1步：GK把球传给4号球员，4号球员、5号球员、9号球员、10号球员向前移动；第2步：4号球员把球传给6号球员，6号球员、8号球员向前移动；第3步：6号球员把球传给8号球员；第4步：8号球员把球送进空当。
【连贯】球过中线算出球成功，被断或出界算压迫方得分；无论哪种，球回门将重新开始，连做 6 次后攻守互换。
【规则】球门球把球控住送过中线算成功；被断、球出界，或因为无人接应只能大脚开出，都算失败。
【要点】摆球之前就决定走哪条线路。在小禁区边上才开始商量的球门球，等于已经丢球了。
note.zh-TW:

note.ja-JP:

note.ko-KR:

note.en:
Purpose: Rehearse a restart until it runs without a word — everyone knows the movement before the whistle, so the delivery, not the decision, is the hard part.
Frequency: Rehearsed weekly and hard before a match — set pieces decide a large share of goals, so the routines are drilled until automatic.
Setup: a keeper, two centre-backs, a holding midfielder and one outlet up the pitch, against two who press.
Ball path: GK → 4 → 8 → 6 → the open space
Sequence: Step 1: GK passes to 4, 4 moves left, 5 moves right, 9, 10 move up the board; Step 2: 4 passes to 8, 6, 8 move up the board; Step 3: 8 passes to 6; Step 4: 6 plays the ball into space.
How it continues: Getting the ball over halfway counts as a success; a turnover or the ball out counts for the pressers. Either way it goes back to the keeper and starts again; six reps, then the sides swap.
Rules: The goal kick has worked when the ball is under control in the other half; it has failed if it is won back, if it goes out, or if the keeper has to hit it long because nobody showed.
Coaching point: Decide the route before the ball is placed. A goal kick that gets discussed on the six-yard box is already a turnover.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】定位球：把套路练到不用喊、大家都知道往哪跑。难点只在传球质量，不在临场想。
【频度】每周练、赛前重点练——定位球贡献了很大比例的进球，所以套路要练到自动化。
【组织】门将、两名中卫、一名后腰，前场一名接应点，对方两人上抢。
【球路】GK → 4 → 8 → 6 → 空当
【流程】第1步：GK把球传给4号球员，4号球员向左移动，5号球员向右移动，9号球员、10号球员向前移动；第2步：4号球员把球传给8号球员，6号球员、8号球员向前移动；第3步：8号球员把球传给6号球员；第4步：6号球员把球送进空当。
【连贯】球过中线算出球成功，被断或出界算压迫方得分；无论哪种，球回门将重新开始，连做 6 次后攻守互换。
【规则】球门球把球控住送过中线算成功；被断、球出界，或因为无人接应只能大脚开出，都算失败。
【要点】摆球之前就决定走哪条线路。在小禁区边上才开始商量的球门球，等于已经丢球了。

note.en:
Purpose: Rehearse a restart until it runs without a word — everyone knows the movement before the whistle, so the delivery, not the decision, is the hard part.
Frequency: Rehearsed weekly and hard before a match — set pieces decide a large share of goals, so the routines are drilled until automatic.
Setup: a keeper, two centre-backs, a holding midfielder and one outlet up the pitch, against two who press.
Ball path: GK → 8 → 6 → the open space
Sequence: Step 1: GK passes to 8, 4, 5, 9, 10 move back; Step 2: 8 passes to 6, 6, 8 move back; Step 3: 6 plays the ball into space.
How it continues: Getting the ball over halfway counts as a success; a turnover or the ball out counts for the pressers. Either way it goes back to the keeper and starts again; six reps, then the sides swap.
Rules: The goal kick has worked when the ball is under control in the other half; it has failed if it is won back, if it goes out, or if the keeper has to hit it long because nobody showed.
Coaching point: Decide the route before the ball is placed. A goal kick that gets discussed on the six-yard box is already a turnover.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】定位球：把套路练到不用喊、大家都知道往哪跑。难点只在传球质量，不在临场想。
【频度】每周练、赛前重点练——定位球贡献了很大比例的进球，所以套路要练到自动化。
【组织】门将、两名中卫、一名后腰，前场一名接应点，对方两人上抢。
【球路】GK → 8 → 6 → 空当
【流程】第1步：GK把球传给8号球员，4号球员、5号球员、9号球员、10号球员向后移动；第2步：8号球员把球传给6号球员，6号球员、8号球员向后移动；第3步：6号球员把球送进空当。
【连贯】球过中线算出球成功，被断或出界算压迫方得分；无论哪种，球回门将重新开始，连做 6 次后攻守互换。
【规则】球门球把球控住送过中线算成功；被断、球出界，或因为无人接应只能大脚开出，都算失败。
【要点】摆球之前就决定走哪条线路。在小禁区边上才开始商量的球门球，等于已经丢球了。
note.zh-TW:
